jem_advancements.patchouli.name: JEM Handbook
jem_advancements.patchouli.subtitle: Bosses, enchantments and items
jem_advancements.patchouli.landing_text: Choose a section or a colored ribbon. The green ribbon opens the complete searchable index. Boss instructions are available before your first victory.
jem_advancements.patchouli.open_failed: This guide entry could not be opened. Advancement progression is unaffected.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.root.title: Life Just Got Easier!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.root.descripti: Little conveniences can change a big adventure.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Little conveniences make every expedition smoother.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.1.title: ENHANCE!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.1.description: Look at a living creature through a Spyglass.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Take a Spyglass and look at any living creature through it.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13.title: Do I Have to Fall?
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13_3_1.title: Four of a Kind
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13_3_1.descrip: Collect enough Spirit Orbs for one real choice.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect four Spirit Orbs—enough for one upgrade at a Goddess Statue.
At a Goddess Statue, spend four Spirit Orbs on a permanent health increase.
At a Goddess Statue, spend four Spirit Orbs on a permanent stamina increase.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7.title: What's On Your Back?
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Equip a backpack in its equipment slot. Simply carrying it in your inventory is not enough.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_1.title: Never Enough Room
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_1.descriptio: Spend earned backpack experience on your first useful unlock.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Earn backpack experience and spend it on any first upgrade.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_3.title: Another One?!
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Unlock another backpack slot and wear two backpacks at the same time.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8.title: TIMBEEEER!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8.description: Fell an entire tree through one shared chopping process.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Chop a tree with TreeChop until the whole tree falls.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8_3.title: Mushroom? Close Enough.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8_3.descriptio: Fell a giant mushroom or fungus through TreeChop.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Find a giant mushroom that TreeChop can fell as a whole and bring it down like a tree.
Get a Nature's Compass and keep it in your inventory.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.universal_leas: Leash an entity that normally refuses a lead.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Use a normal Lead on a mob that vanilla Minecraft normally refuses to leash.
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.root.title: They’re Here for a Reason
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.root.descript: Every good creature has a reason to exist.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Learn what the creatures around you can actually do.
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.8_4_1.title: Sweet Dreams
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.8_4_1.descrip: Make a Dreamcatcher using an antler from another part of the pack’s ecosystem.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft a Dreamcatcher using a Caribou, Elk or White-Tailed Deer Antler. Other types of antler do not count.
Caribou, Elk and White-Tailed Deer Antlers
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.root.title: More Than Sharp
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.root.descr: Good gear changes more than numbers — it changes your decisions.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Master unusual weapons, clever shots, and heavy machinery.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.ballista.d: Get your hands on a Ballista.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.catapult.d: Get your hands on a Catapult.
Obtain any Ruinfighter or Duskfire armor piece.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Obtain any Ruinfighter or Duskfire armor piece.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_armor_: Collect both complete Ruinfighter and Duskfire armor sets.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect the helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots from both the Ruinfighter and Duskfire sets.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_weapon: Complete the collection of twenty-one obtainable weapons.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect one of each of the twenty-one obtainable weapons, from the Ruins Greatsword to Excalibur. Internal states, hidden variants, and test items do not count.
Complete collection of obtainable weapon forms
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_weapon: Obtain a weapon such as the Ruins Greatsword or Duskfire.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Obtain a collectible weapon such as the Ruins Greatsword, Duskfire or Ancient Sculk Twinblades. Internal weapon-state items are excluded.
Collectible weapons and their base forms
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.root.title: Something’s Biting!
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.root.descr: Cast a line and find out how deep this hobby really goes.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Cast into stranger waters and see what answers.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.4_3.title: A Rod Caught a Rod
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.4_3.descri: Fish up a rare fishing rod, then catch a fish with the rod you caught.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: In the appropriate conditions, fish up the rare Suncatcher rod as a fishing reward. Then equip that exact rod and successfully catch a fish with it.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.5_6.title: All That Glitters
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.5_6.descri: Catch the Midas Fish while actually meeting its Luck requirement.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Raise your Luck to the level required by the installed version and catch the Midas Fish through normal fishing. A chest or command item does not count.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.6_2.title: Net Result
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.6_2.descri: Capture a Barracuda with a net and move it alive.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Use Spawn’s intended net on a living Barracuda. Complete the achievement when the creature is actually captured by the net system rather than killed for an item.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.root.title: So Who's the Boss?
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.root.descri: Some health bars clearly want to get acquainted.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Find the great threats of each dimension and bring them down.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1.title: Star of the Show
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1.descripti: Defeat the Wither and obtain a Nether Star; more than one boss gate will want it.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Summon and defeat the Wither normally. Recover its Nether Star; later boss systems use it as a genuine progression key.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_4.des: Defeat the Ancient Remnant in the Cursed Pyramid.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Reach the boss inside a real Cursed Pyramid and defeat the Ancient Remnant. The Pyramid's individual rooms and general structure discovery are not separate Bosses achievements.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_5.des: Defeat the Leviathan in the Sunken City.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Progress through the Sunken City to its primary boss and defeat the Leviathan. No rods, catches, or fishing progression are involved; this is purely the dungeon's boss completion.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_7.des: Defeat Maledictus in the Frosted Prison.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Reach the Frosted Prison's main encounter and defeat Maledictus.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_2_1.title: Architect Laid Off
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_2_1.descr: Defeat Netherman, the Architect of Chaos.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Defeat Netherman completely. Chaotic Essence then hands off to Arsenal for weapon ability progression.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.2_1.title: Yeti Another One
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.2_2.title: Well Done
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_2.title: That's a Wrap
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Land the killing blow on a Mummy yourself.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_7.title: Something Stalks the Dark
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_7.descrip: Defeat a Stalker from either installed Deep Dark expansion.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Kill a Deep Dark Regrowth Stalker yourself.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.5_1.title: Extinction Event
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Finish the summoned volcanic encounter and defeat Luxtructosaurus. The post-boss Atlatitan world unlock belongs to Mobs, while Tectonic Shard and Extinction Spear usage belongs to Arsenal.
jem_guide.advancement.building.root.desc: Turn a pile of blocks into a place with character.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Turn a shelter into a place worth returning to.
jem_guide.advancement.building.1.title: Not Everything Needs to Be a Cube
jem_guide.advancement.building.1.descrip: Place your first real timber beam.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft and place a Woodworks Beam. The achievement is about the dedicated building beam, not a normal log.
jem_guide.advancement.building.14.title: Holidays Don't Decorate Themselves
jem_guide.advancement.building.14.descri: Make your first batch of holiday gems.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Combine Magenta Dye and an Emerald using the Holidays Gem recipe and obtain the first batch of nine Gems.
jem_guide.advancement.building.4.title: Now We Can Live Here
jem_guide.advancement.building.4.descrip: Place the first piece of furniture that makes a room feel lived in.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Place any modded furniture block: a table, chair, bench, couch, cabinet, nightstand, shelf, or another furnishing.
jem_guide.advancement.building.7.title: The House Has a Voice
jem_guide.advancement.building.7.descrip: Hang a working wind chime at your home.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft any Chime and hang it outside or beside the entrance of a build.
jem_guide.advancement.building.7_4.title: Glow and Chime
jem_guide.advancement.building.7_4.descr: Hang a chime that decorates the area and provides light.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft and hang an Amethyst Crystal Wind Chime. It must be placed in the world as part of a build, not merely carried in inventory.
jem_guide.advancement.building.8.title: Smoke Goes Up
jem_guide.advancement.building.8.descrip: Build a chimney that genuinely emits smoke.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Place a Chimney above a suitable smoke or fire source so smoke genuinely exits through the chimney.
jem.advancement.engineering.root.title: Engineering
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Begin with Create, then learn what hard work does to a drill.
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_work.d: Let a moving drilling machine cut through rock on its own.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Build a moving contraption with a Mechanical Drill and use it to bore through a normal natural rock block. The drill must break the block as part of the moving contraption.
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_servic: Stop the machine and service a worn drill with iron.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Fully stop the drilling machine and use an Iron Ingot to service a worn Mechanical Drill. One repaired drill must consume one Iron Ingot.
Repairing a Mechanical Drill with an iron ingot
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_replac: Replace an exhausted drill and keep the same machine working.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Wear out a Mechanical Drill with no repairs remaining, replace it with a fresh Mechanical Drill, and resume drilling with the same machine.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.root.ti: What Else Is There to Do?
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.root.de: Not every good day has to move you closer to an ending.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Make music, take photographs, collect oddities, and enjoy the ride.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.cool_de: Kill a living entity with freezing caused by a snowball.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Kill a living entity with freezing damage built up by your snowballs. The snowball impact itself deals no damage.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.4_4.des: Make a new Photograph look like an old discovery.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Take a finished Photograph and turn it into an Aged Photograph using the current recipe that requires a Brush. Older recipes without the Brush do not apply to this version.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.play_a_: Play a live note on a musical instrument.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Play a live note on a musical instrument.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Successfully attach to a cable with Zipline.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Successfully attach to a cable with Zipline.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Release your grip while actively attached to a Zipline cable.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Release your grip while actively attached to a Zipline cable.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Transfer directly from one valid Zipline cable to another.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Transfer directly from one valid Zipline cable to another.

jem.quests.races.intro.title: Choosing a Race
jem.quests.races.intro.description.1: Open F6 to compare five races, their advantages, drawbacks, powers and earned stages. Confirm your choice on the server. An ordinary change is available once per Minecraft day; previews never grant powers.
jem.quests.races.ancestors.title: Ancestors
jem.quests.races.ancestors.description.1: Choose this race in F6. Heal nearby allies with Life Chorus and defend yourself with the automatic guardian. This objective records your confirmed race choice.
jem.quests.races.void_walkers.title: Void Walkers
jem.quests.races.void_walkers.descriptio: Choose this race in F6. Use the rift, charged pearl and gravity utility while respecting real targets and safe destinations. This objective records your confirmed race choice.
jem.quests.races.born_in_bloom.title: Born in Bloom
jem.quests.races.born_in_bloom.descripti: Choose this race in F6. Bind enemies with roots, develop Bloom upgrades and make temporary leaf paths. This objective records your confirmed race choice.
jem.quests.races.infected_by_sculk.title: Infected by Sculk
jem.quests.races.infected_by_sculk.descr: Choose this race in F6. Build resonance, use the sonic wave and develop its darkness and temporary territory. This objective records your confirmed race choice.
jem.quests.races.nether_hearteds.title: Nether Hearteds
jem.quests.races.nether_hearteds.descrip: Choose this race in F6. Use eruptions and three fiery slashes; lava and environmental passives keep their native authority. This objective records your confirmed race choice.
jem.quests.campaign.complete.title: Complete the Twelve Eyes Journey
jem.quests.campaign.complete.description: Complete the same twelve original campaign bosses and their prerequisites. Only the canonical world campaign record can complete this objective. Ordinary Eyes of Ender do not count. A new world missing required content leaves this campaign inactive and vanilla End access available.
jem.quests.welcome.title: Welcome to Just Enough Mods
jem.quests.welcome.description.1: Races, towns, available bosses and the enabled economy share one server-authoritative implementation in solo and multiplayer. Content appears when its required features are installed. Hosted events appear only on a dedicated host that enables them.
jem.quests.welcome.description.2: This guide observes your journey. It never replaces inventory, money, race, boss or town state.
jem.quests.rotation.title: Rotational Power
jem.quests.rotation.description.1: Generate rotational force with a Water Wheel, then connect real components. Connect the components into a working machine using their native rules.
jem.quests.supplies.title: Supplies and Workforce / Запасы
jem.quests.supplies.description.1: Sneak-use the Town bell with a nearby loaded container to link physical supplies. Sneak-use while looking at an owned Recruit or adult villager to register it.
jem.quests.payroll.title: Recruit Payroll
jem.quests.payroll.description.1: Registered Recruits retain native AI and one town payroll. Fund the town treasury in its active currency. Economy-enabled towns use backed Coins; other towns use the existing emerald treasury. Wages are due every seven Minecraft days, and a short treasury never double-charges.
jem.quests.return.title: Return to Your Town
jem.quests.return.description.1: Exploring does not force your town chunks to remain loaded. Return to the actual linked storage and residents to continue town management. Retired worker automation is not a production source of goods.
jem.quests.races.confirm.title: Confirm Your Race
jem.quests.races.confirm.description.1: Choose and confirm one of the five races in F6. This objective records a real confirmed choice, then the optional paths can record which races your team tries.
jem.handbook.manual.status.read: Opens the native manual with its own navigation.
jem.handbook.manual.status.discoveries: Personal discoveries remain locked until their normal conditions are met.
jem.handbook.manual.status.caves: Research cave tablets at the Spelunkery Table and use the resulting cave codices. Native research remains required.
jem.handbook.manual.status.logbook_missi: Find a logbook and carry it to read that document's own entries.
jem.handbook.manual.status.logbook: Reads the acquired logbook with its original text.
jem.handbook.manual.status.carry_handboo: Carry the JEM Handbook to open this manual.
jem.handbook.manual.status.close_contain: Close the current container before opening this manual.
jem.handbook.manual.failed: Could not open %s. See the client or server log for the cause.
jem_advancements.handbook.manual_unavail: This manual is unavailable in the current world inventory.

jem.questbook.unavailable.reason: Required content or feature is unavailable in this world

jem.atlas.card.H09.08.tip: Mounts and wagons serve roads, chain lines cross short gaps, gliders descend and aircraft travel farther. This reference does not pretend to detect an operating transport network.

jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_field_01.title: A Little Direction
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_field_01.condit: Right-click Nature’s Compass in the air once.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_field_01.purpos: Choose a destination before walking into the unknown.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_field_01.tip: Craft the compass using its recipe, choose a biome in its menu, then follow its bearing. The task counts the right-click, not arrival.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_field_01.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Little Direction”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_scenic_detour.cond: Visit a Redwood Forest, White Cliffs or Wisteria Forest; any one counts.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_scenic_detour.purp: Discover a distinct natural landscape, then choose the next destination.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_scenic_detour.tip: Walk into any one of the named biomes. The journal checks your actual location, not wood in your inventory. Its compass reward helps you search for the next biome.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_scenic_detour.rewa: 1 × Nature's Compass; 4 × Grilled Salmon Sandwich; 20 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_scenic_detour.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Take the Scenic Route”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_13.title: A Door With Teeth
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_13.purpose: Discover a structure reward with a real acquisition challenge.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_13.tip: Trial Keys belong to trial chambers. Obtain yours through their native trial rules; the journal does not supply a key or open a vault for you.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_03.title: Another Forest, Same Roof
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_03.conditi: Obtain redwood planks and willow planks, one of each.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_03.purpose: Bring two contrasting forest materials home.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_03.tip: Find the corresponding trees and process their logs. These are material samples, not a demand to catalogue every wood species.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_04.title: Soft Stone, Bright Ideas
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_04.conditi: Obtain any chalk block and one kaolin block.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_04.purpose: Find a second natural building palette beyond wood.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_04.tip: Look for the corresponding natural deposits. Any listed chalk color qualifies; there is no color checklist. Use the samples in a small base accent.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_04.reward: 32 × Kaolin Bricks; 16 × White Kaolin Bricks; 30 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_06.title: A Bloom Above Water
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_06.purpose: Try a waterside plant with more than decorative appeal.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_06.tip: Find a lotus in the world and inspect its placement and behavior. The objective checks placement only; testing its movement interaction is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_land_06.reward: 4 × Lush Lily Pad; 8 × Lotus Stem; 28 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_01.title: A Softer Landing
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_01.conditio: Obtain one Paraglider or Deku Leaf.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_01.purpose: Make early journeys vertical without waiting for the boss campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_01.tip: Craft either glider through its recipe. Open it from a safe height and watch stamina; this goal is acquiring the glider, not measuring a flight.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_01.reward: 1 × Roadrunner Boots; 6 × Grilled Bacon Sandwich; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_04.title: The Short Way Across
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_04.conditio: Right-click a wooden fence with a chain.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_04.purpose: Start experimenting with a suspended crossing.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_04.tip: The task checks the chain-on-fence interaction, not a completed zipline. Check the compatible cable controls in the guide, finish the second anchor and use the native attach/dismount controls.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_07.title: Window Seat
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_07.purpose: Use an aircraft as a transport choice, not a free shortcut.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h09_07.tip: Craft the biplane with its listed components and fuel it as its interface requires. Boarding counts; a long or dangerous flight is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_01.title: All Aboard
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_01.conditio: Board any Cog, Brigg, Drakkar or Galley.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_01.purpose: Open sea travel with a real ship.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_01.tip: Build a ship using its recipe, launch it in sufficient water and board it. The hull types are alternatives; one is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_02.title: Room in the Hold
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_02.conditio: Sneak-right-click a ship with an empty main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_02.purpose: Learn the cargo interaction before a long voyage.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_02.tip: Use the same ship as before. This goal checks the empty-hand interaction, not the contents of the hold or a completed delivery.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_05.title: A Little Broadside
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_05.conditio: Obtain one ship cannon and one cannonball.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_05.purpose: Prepare a ship for more dangerous voyages.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_h10_05.tip: Use the native cannon and ammunition recipes, then inspect how the cannon mounts on your ship. Firing and hitting a target are not checked here.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wo26.title: Colors on the Wind
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wo26.condition: Right-click a Hullback with a white banner in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wo26.purpose: Discover a ship interaction beyond ordinary crafting.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wo26.tip: Find the vessel through the world’s maritime content. The banner interaction is checked; successful appearance changes depend on its native rules.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_04.co: Obtain the ship, outpost and shelter logbook entries.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_04.pu: Use three distinct clues to understand the frozen expedition.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_04.ti: The entries have different topics, not merely three copies of the same book. Read their clues to plan the next site. The journals are obtained in the corresponding locations. In Ice Maze, the ship’s captain-cabin pillager supplies the Shell Horn. Follow the horn’s local water/summoning rules for Captain Cornelia; her Frozen Key leads to the shelter chest. Boss combat remains in Boss Busters.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_04.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Captain Left Notes”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_05.co: Right-click a Frozen Chest with a Frozen Key in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_05.pu: Try the native key interaction after acquiring a real key.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_05.ti: Find the chest and obtain its key through the frozen adventure. This checks the key-on-chest click, not looting the chest; its contents still follow native rules.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_05.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Cold Reception”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_07.co: Wear a Salvager Helmet and obtain a Ship Graveyard Echo.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_07.pu: Prepare for deep exploration and its equipment upkeep.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_07.ti: Acquire the helmet and echo through the local recipes and expedition loot. The task checks equipment and the echo, not a dive or a repair. Read the echo’s uses before spending it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_aquamirae_07.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Below the Ice”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj03.title: Long Before Yesterday
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj03.condition: Obtain an Eye of Methuselah and an Archstone Pillar.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj03.purpose: Prepare the real gateway into ancient epochs.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj03.tip: Use the Journey Guide to find the temple and follow its native challenge. Build the Forgotten Portal using the guide’s full arrangement; the eye is never a journal reward.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj03.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Long Before Yesterday”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj04.title: Yesterday’s Jungle
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj04.purpose: Start the first ancient field expedition.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj04.tip: Choose the matching portal route in the Journey Guide. Mark the return portal before exploring; a safe return mark is advice, not a hidden objective. The native guide also covers Leptictidium with a Pouch of Seeds and Gnatusuchus with Raw Fillet as small excavation-helper pathways. No animal click is treated as proof of a completed excavation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj04.reward: 1 × Pouch Of Grass; 8 × Grilled Salmon Sandwich; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj04.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Yesterday’s Jungle”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj10.title: Another Yesterday
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj10.purpose: Compare an ancient landscape with the first epoch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj10.tip: Follow the Journey Guide’s portal route. Keep a return path and inspect the different land and sea life rather than collecting every creature.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj10.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Another Yesterday”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj12.title: Yesterday Was Colder
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj12.purpose: Reach the third ancient expedition environment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj12.tip: Prepare a return route and appropriate supplies before using its portal. Look for manganese as a practical next project; mining it is not part of this visit task. Cold fauna have separate equipment and riding rules: Froststalker Helmet and Tusklin should be studied as distinct options, not universal taming equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj12.reward: 1 × Hide Satchel; 10 × Grilled Bacon Sandwich; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj12.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Yesterday Was Colder”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj13.title: Steel From Another Age
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj13.condition: Take one Manganese Steel Ingot from a furnace output.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj13.purpose: Turn expedition resources into a useful technology.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj13.tip: Make the blend from manganese, raw iron and silicate using its recipe, smelt it and take the output manually. Owning a gifted ingot does not complete this smelting task.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_uj13.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Steel From Another Age”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac10.title: Under Stone, Over Trees
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac10.condition: Mount both a Subterranodon and a Tremorsaurus, and place an Amber Monolith.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac10.purpose: Try two different prehistoric mounts and a wildlife landmark.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac10.tip: Follow each creature’s own taming instructions in the cave guide. They are separate animals, not upgrades of each other. The monolith is placed, not checked for spawning output. Optional care discoveries nearby: Relicheirus responds to Primordial Soup for its native tree-felling mechanic. Vallumraptor first steals Dinosaur Nuggets from a chest; its native relaxing/taming sequence uses Serene Salad. These are guide leads, not extra mount requirements.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac11.title: A Very Tall View
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac11.purpose: Discover a late expedition mount without claiming permanent taming.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac11.tip: Atlatitan access follows the cave’s native Luxtructosaurus progression. Serene Salad allows temporary riding; this is not permanent taming, and the journal awards no boss trophy.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac16.title: Take a Deep Breath
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac16.purpose: Prepare for the abyss before entering it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac16.tip: Craft the Deep Sea Diving Helmet from its recipe and read how its air system works. Wearing it is the objective; the journal does not measure your dive.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_ac16.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Take a Deep Breath”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn03.title: Something in the Glass
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn03.condition: Obtain an Ectoplasm Bucket and Soul Glass.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn03.purpose: Discover unusual Nether materials and their interactions.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn03.tip: Collect ectoplasm with a bucket and follow the Soul Glass recipe. Read the native passage/ghost interactions before testing them; possession, not passing through glass, is checked. Lightspores and Nightspores interact with their matching wart growth; fossil fuel is a useful local fuel. Treat these as separate native uses, not a requirement to carry every Nether material.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.title: A Flame With Demands
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.condition: Right-click a Treacherous Candle with flint and steel, and obtain a Treacherous Flame.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.purpose: Follow a native Nether progression without receiving its key reward for free.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.tip: Find the relevant sanctum using the native locator, prepare the candle and follow its actual rules. The click and owned flame are checked; the journal neither creates the flame nor proves a ritual by a click alone.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.reward: 8 × Ancient Lantern; 8 × Nether Pizza Slice; 150 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Flame With Demands”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn13.title: Ferry Hot
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn13.tip: Read the creature’s equipment and control requirements in the animal guide, prepare the necessary gear and board it. Merely seeing one does not complete the mount task.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn13.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ferry Hot”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn14.title: Walls Have Options
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn14.condition: Drink one Lava Vision potion and one Clinging potion.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn14.tip: Brew both using their actual potion recipes. Drink safely before testing lava visibility or ceiling movement; the task checks consumption, not a dangerous route.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_wn14.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Walls Have Options”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_nether_extra_03: Eat one serving of Soul Return Rice.
Discover an unusual expedition food through actual consumption.
Follow the dish recipe and read its effect before eating away from home. Consumption is checked; teleport success, death or recovery are not required.
4 × Soul Return Rice; 6 × Soul Soup; 100 XP.
Mount a Glider from the Nether.
Find another native route across hostile terrain.
Follow this creature’s native access and control instructions. This is the rideable creature, not the handheld paraglider; boarding is the checked action.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Wings Over Fire”.
Place a Ritual Table and obtain Ghostly Essence.
Prepare for the native ghost ritual system.

Use the table recipe and obtain the essence through native content. Consult the Ritual Tome for valid offerings. This checks preparation, not a completed ritual. Pottergeist interaction, ectoplasm items and the cultist flag are other local guide topics. Read each native requirement before spending essence; they are not completed by this preparation task.
Right-click a Carrion Maw with an empty main hand.
Inspect a strange living block before using rare resources.
Find the living structure and read the Burial Knife’s recipe and uses nearby in the guide. This task checks the empty-hand interaction only; no conversion or sacrifice is inferred.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we01.title: The Long Way Around
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we01.purpose: Discover the End’s native creature transport.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we01.tip: Reach the End through the existing campaign and follow the creature guide’s riding requirements. The task records mounting, not visiting the End or taming permanently.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we06.title: A Cut Above Distance
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we06.condition: Right-click in the air with a Dimensional Carver.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we06.purpose: Try a late traversal tool after its intended acquisition.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we06.tip: Obtain the carver through the native End progression and read its travel limits. This task checks the click only, not a portal opening or a successful trip.
jem.atlas.card.v2_biomes_we06.reward: 24 × Ender Residue; 8 × Void Conch Noodle Soup; 200 XP.
Visit Paleogene, Neogene and Pleistocene, board a ship and a submarine, and obtain one actual photograph.
Bring time travel, sea travel and a recorded discovery into one expedition career.
Complete these in any order. A photograph must have a real image identifier; an empty photo item does not qualify. This is a representative expedition finale, not a demand to finish every branch.
1 × Extendo Grip; 12 × Color Film; 12 × Ender Mint Tea; 400 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “There, Then, and Back Again”.
Visit any one of the six special cave biomes.
Turn your decoded cave destination into an actual discovery.

A decoded Cave Codex and its matching map guide the search. Magnetic Caves, Primordial Caves, Toxic Caves, Abyssal Chasm, Forlorn Hollows or Candy Cavity each qualify; five further visits are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_stranger_nether.co: Visit Black Ice Glaciers, Exhaust Mire or Ash Forest; any one counts.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_stranger_nether.pu: Explore beyond the familiar red Nether wastes.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_stranger_nether.ti: Enter the Nether through the ordinary portal route and search within that dimension. Only one listed biome is required; this goal does not unlock the dimension or require its rare loot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bio_stranger_nether.re: 4 × Ancient Lantern; 6 × Nether Pizza Slice; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_research.title: Letters From Below
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_research.conditio: Decode a tablet and create a map for its cave.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_research.purpose: Decoding turns a random find into a route to a specific cave.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_research.tip: Find cabins underground or via cartographer/mineshaft maps. Put tablet and paper in a Spelunkery Table and solve its three stages; use the resulting codex for a cave map. A codex also reveals entries in the cave book.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_research.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Letters From Below”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_submarine_restore: Repair a damaged submarine with copper, scrape oxidation with an axe and board it.
A serviced submarine becomes useful for deep-sea expeditions again.

Find damaged submarines in Abyssal Ruins. The separate assembly route is a copper cube around an Enigmatic Engine with six Depth Glass blocks at the front. Both routes retain real engine acquisition, never a free reward.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Back to the Deep”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_traversal.c: Complete a Candy Cane Hook grapple and a Rainbounce Boots bounce.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_traversal.p: Grappling and bouncing help cross broken terrain.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_traversal.t: A sharpened-cane hook crosses gaps; dual hooks reduce delay. Sweetish Fish gelatin and Sundrops make boots that bounce on landing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_traversal.r: 6 × Caramel Apple; 8 × Purple Soda Bottle Rocket; 130 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_traversal.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Spring and Hook”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_finds.cond: Obtain one marine utility through its natural route: tooth shield, Grappling Squok or Flying Fish Boots. Then use the chosen utility; Blobfish oil and its floating effect is another alternative.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_finds.purp: Ocean finds provide new ways to travel and defend yourself.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_finds.tip: Frilled Sharks shed teeth attacking squid, a lost tentacle comes from whale hunts on giant squid, and Flying Fish can be bucketed. Craft the selected utility rather than owning a gifted finished item.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_finds.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Sea Leaves Clues”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_prospecting.cond: Direct an Underminer using a chosen ore and witness its vein discovery.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_prospecting.purp: A helper finds the chosen ore instead of random tunnelling.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_prospecting.tip: Drop the desired ore block nearby; ghost mining reveals ore positions. Its rare pickaxe buffers mined items when inventory is full and repairs with membranes; the pickaxe drop is not required here.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_prospecting.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ghost of a Vein”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_hidden_finders.c: Find one hidden resource with help: seagull-guided treasure or locator-guided pupfish.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_hidden_finders.p: Animals and instruments reveal otherwise hidden finds.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_hidden_finders.t: Hold a buried treasure map offhand and toss a Lobster Tail; the seagull perches above treasure. Strange Fish Finder leads to a rare aquifer chunk; bucket its fish and supply submerged moss for breeding.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_hidden_finders.r: 2 × Water Bucket; 6 × Black and White Film; 150 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_hidden_finders.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Clue Off the Map”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_serious_circle.c: Draw an actual protective circle on sand with a stick.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_serious_circle.p: The correctly drawn shape provides real protection from bears.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_serious_circle.t: The native interaction must actually produce a circle block, not merely a sand click. The Dictionary describes protection from Sea Bears; humorous provocations are not compulsory objectives. Drawing is available on April 1 or while the native April Fools mode superSecretSettings is enabled. On other dates without that mode, the interaction is unavailable.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_serious_circle.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Very Serious Circle”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_watch.cond: Observe a Great White Shark or Whale Shark in its ocean without attacking.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_watch.purp: Observation introduces ocean wildlife without pointless hunting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_watch.tip: Species have distinct ocean habitats. Whale Sharks are passive; predators are not pets. Working 1.0.7 feeding is explained in Lunch Without a Hand: drop one raw beef in water; hand right-click is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ocean_watch.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Seas of Different Temperatures”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.title: Just in Case
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.condit: Craft an Idol of Retrieval and learn its lost-item recovery conditions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.purpos: Cedar logs and cooked food prepare the next expedition without forcing an intentional death to test the idol.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.tip: Do not die for the quest. Crafting introduces the recovery tool beforehand; recovering real lost items remains an optional use after an ordinary mishap.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.reward: 16 × Cedar Log; 8 × Glazed Beast Chops; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_safekeeping.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Just in Case”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_fuel_for_time.cond: Dry a Peat Pie, smelt Bituminous Rock and plant a Platypodium seed pod.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_fuel_for_time.purp: Dried peat supplies another smelting run and archstone bricks help furnish an expedition base.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_fuel_for_time.tip: Find peat in Paleogene/Neogene, form a pie and collect it after native drying. Smelt Bituminous Rock for powder. Platypodium seed pods in Neogene grow small trees; native leaves may not decay.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_fuel_for_time.rewa: 8 × Dried Peat Pie; 24 × Archstone Bricks; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_fuel_for_time.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fuel for Yesterday”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_eye_of_the_blizzar: Perform the native Niveis Tear action in a Blizzard and actually reach Maelstrom.
A larger reserve of lighting and marine food helps establish a foothold after actually reaching the new region.

Installed text describes distilling the Tear and a Blizzard. Follow that procedure after acquiring the Tear, without a free tear reward. An intentionally disabled world route must be marked unavailable and never gate other paths.
More details: unified guide → Items → “In the Blizzard’s Eye”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_flesh.cond: Visit the Eroded Yard biome in the Nether.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_flesh.purp: Discover a distinct Nether region; fire charges and travel chocolate support the next expedition.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_flesh.tip: Find the separate flesh biome and its native materials. Study its local blocks and food; another Nether biome is not a substitute.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_flesh.rewa: 4 × Fire Charge; 6 × Bar of Chocolate; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_flesh.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Nether Within”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_treefall.title: Timber!
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_treefall.conditi: Fell one supported whole tree through repeated chops to its trunk.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_treefall.purpose: Beams support the first home, and the Iron Axe supports the next timber trip.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_treefall.tip: Chops accumulate on the tree; sneaking mines one log normally. Supported giant fungi use the same system. Find chopping toggles in Controls.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.title: Above the Smoke
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.conditio: Gain altitude in an updraft with an open paraglider.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.purpose: The orb advances a statue upgrade, while sandwiches supply the next outing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.tip: Open the glider from a safe height, then find rising air over fire. Watch stamina and choose a landing spot in advance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.reward: 1 × Spirit Orb; 6 × Grilled Bacon Sandwich; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_thermal.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Above the Smoke”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_statue_bargain.c: Trade Spirit Orbs at a Goddess Statue for a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_statue_bargain.p: Roadrunner Boots improve overland travel between glides.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_statue_bargain.t: Find orbs through exploration and treasure. Choose the upgrade that suits you; an Anti-Vessel can recover invested vessels. The statue shows current costs and limits.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_statue_bargain.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Heart or Wind”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_zip_transfer.con: Ride a suspended chain and transfer to an adjoining compatible cable without touching the ground.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_zip_transfer.pur: Extra chains and ropes let the player extend the cable route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_zip_transfer.tip: Connect supports with chains. Controls show the allowed attachment tool. Hold Use to attach and look toward travel; jump or release to detach. Shears change slack; punching a knot removes its attachment.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_zip_transfer.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Chain Reaction”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_wall_catch.title: By a Pick
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_wall_catch.condi: Catch a fall against a wall with a pickaxe and perform the native kick-release.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_wall_catch.purpo: The Anvil supports equipment maintenance after difficult descents.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_wall_catch.tip: Use a pickaxe against a nearby wall while falling. Hard walls hold; softer surfaces slow the slide. Double crouch releases. Pickaxe tier and Grip/Momentum change behavior.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_wall_catch.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “By a Pick”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_route.title: Air Mail
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_route.condit: Take off in a Biplane and land safely at least 64 blocks from takeoff.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_route.purpos: Hull parts and an engine provide components for another Biplane.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_route.tip: This pack retains the Biplane; other aircraft and upgrades are deliberately removed. Check the runway, native fuel slot and accepted Aircraft Fuel. Airborne dismount has accidental-use protection; inspect current controls.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_route.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Air Mail”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_service.cond: Successfully repair a damaged grounded Biplane.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_service.purp: A boiler and hull parts support a replacement aircraft without banned upgrades.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_service.tip: Repair the Biplane from outside through its native interaction; sneak if required by settings. Repair can cost exhaustion. Removed aircraft upgrades/weapons are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_air_service.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ready for Departure”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_sailing.con: Sail at least 64 blocks across water with raised sails.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_sailing.pur: A spare sail, leads and provisions support the next transport voyage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_sailing.tip: Launch into open water, take the controller seat and raise sails with the configured key. Cargo affects handling. Compatible creatures can board; sneak-use from outside opens storage. Dye changes sails and Name Tags change the name.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_sailing.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fair Winds”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_repair.cond: Restore positive health to a damaged ship through native repair.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_repair.purp: Cannonballs open a gunnery lesson after learning ship maintenance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_repair.tip: Repair uses Iron Nuggets with Wooden Planks available; interact from outside. You do not need to damage a ship deliberately for this quest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_repair.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Still Afloat”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_cannon.cond: Deal positive damage to a hostile creature with a ship cannonball.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_cannon.purp: Ammunition and defensive elixirs support the next dangerous landing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ship_cannon.tip: Install a cannon on a compatible ship and put cannonballs in its inventory. Use native broadside controls; dropping the item does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ruins.title: Someone Else's Walls
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ruins.condition: Explore one substantial overland ruin and open its natural loot chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ruins.purpose: The compass helps choose another biome and film records expedition discoveries.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ruins.tip: Look for temples, ruined castles and treehouses. A tiny decorative rock pile is not this expedition; different substantial structures are alternatives.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ruins.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Someone Else's Walls”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_mineshaft.title: The Previous Shift
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_mineshaft.condit: Enter a reimagined mineshaft and open its natural loot chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_mineshaft.purpos: Rails and Andesite Alloy connect expedition resources to workshop and transport uses.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_mineshaft.tip: Climate variants have different layouts. Light exits, mark junctions and do not assume rails imply safety.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_mineshaft.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Previous Shift”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ocean_ruins.cond: Explore an ocean ruin or sunken city and open its natural loot chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ocean_ruins.purp: Underwater lamps mark the return route and film records unusual discoveries.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ocean_ruins.tip: Surface wreckage and rare deep structures offer different routes. Prepare air and an ascent; the rare city is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_ocean_ruins.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Quiet Below”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_temple.co: Find a redesigned desert temple and open one natural loot chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_temple.pu: The Brush supports later archaeology and elixirs help with dangerous ruins.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_temple.ti: Explore traps, routes and puzzles while keeping an exit. Any native fatigue-clear guardian rule belongs to that temple; this goal does not invent a new pack boss.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_temple.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Not Just Sand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_monument.title: Beyond the Water Wall
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_monument.conditi: Explore a redesigned ocean monument and open its natural loot chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_monument.purpose: Defensive elixirs and seafood support further underwater trips.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_monument.tip: Rooms may differ from the usual monument. Prepare air and protection; tridents and Hearts of the Sea are possible native loot, not guaranteed drops.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_monument.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Beyond the Water Wall”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_fortress.title: Beyond the Heat
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_fortress.conditi: Explore a Nether fortress or substantial Nether structure and open natural loot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_fortress.purpose: Ancient Torches mark Nether routes and elixirs support the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_fortress.tip: Bridges, the keep and lower Lava Halls require different routes. Separate Nether ruins are alternatives; ordinary exploration does not bypass boss arenas.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_fortress.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Beyond the Heat”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_lotus_lift.title: Petal Lift
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_lotus_lift.condi: Ride a Lotus at least two blocks upward and descend using its native controls.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_lotus_lift.purpo: More Lotus Flowers and bone meal support another living lift.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_lotus_lift.tip: Bone meal raises the Lotus, crouching lowers it, and direct redstone power stops it. Begin over a safe landing area.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_lotus_lift.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Petal Lift”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_living_calcite.c: Harvest a Calcite Shard from mature calcite growth above a bubble column.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_living_calcite.p: Shards continue the building chain and lamps help establish the water farm.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_living_calcite.t: Place coral above an active bubble column and allow growth. Shards provide renewable calcite; carrying a finished block is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_living_calcite.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Growing Stone”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_stone_press.cond: Convert Stone into Deepslate with a falling Anvil above Magma.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_stone_press.purp: Columns and moulding turn the learned material into a useful home palette.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_stone_press.tip: Place Stone above Magma and drop an Anvil onto it. Clear the area and stand aside; the native conversion must actually succeed.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_stone_press.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Weighty Argument”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_root_and_crown.c: Follow Turnip Roots to a Turnip and knock down a Coconut with your projectile.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_root_and_crown.p: Foraged produce supplies additional kitchen uses.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_root_and_crown.t: Roots lead to an underground Turnip. Coconut harvesting needs a native valid projectile hit; purchases or prepared food do not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_root_and_crown.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Roots and Crowns”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_kaolin_knock.con: Finish a Zombie with a Kaolin block as required by the native challenge.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_kaolin_knock.pur: A ceramic building palette commemorates the odd challenge without replacing boss loot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_kaolin_knock.tip: This is an optional playful branch. Bring protection; the real final hit needs eligible Kaolin, not just hitting any creature.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_kaolin_knock.rew: 48 × White Kaolin Bricks; 2 × Oakskin Elixir; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_kaolin_knock.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ceramic Persuasion”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_wind.cond: Collect one genuine drop from a Tumbleweed.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_wind.purp: A Lotus invites exploration of water plants after the desert discovery.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_wind.tip: Look near desert dead bushes. Drops are random and pack-controlled; no particular rare item is required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_wind.rewa: 1 × Lotus Flower; 4 × Grilled Bacon Sandwich; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_desert_wind.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Gone with the Weed”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.title: An Open Table
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.conditi: Place and stock a Feeding Trough, then let it complete one successful animal feeding.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.purpose: Corral bars enclose the working trough and chicken feed points toward the poultry branch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.tip: Craft the Feeding Trough using its shown recipe. Stock food the chosen animal accepts and let one animal approach and eat. No mass breeding is needed.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.reward: 16 × Iron Coral Bars; 12 × Chicken Feed; 30 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_open_table.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Open Table”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.title: Supper, Anyone?
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.condition: Successfully feed your owned hamster, Manx Cat or Great Pyrenees appropriate food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.purpose: A bowl and brush turn the first accepted feeding into a usable care corner, with a small kibble reserve for later visits.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.tip: Hamsters take Sunflower Seeds; Manx Cats and Great Pyrenees accept Pet Kibble. Credit requires accepted feeding with real food consumption or healing, never a failed click.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.reward: 1 × Pet Bowl; 1 × Enrichment Brush; 8 × Pet Kibble; 20 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_supper.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Supper, Anyone?”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_soul_workshop.cond: Run real Soul Furnace processing and retrieve Crystallized Blood and a Soul Gem.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_soul_workshop.purp: A small reserve of both processed materials lets the player try first companions without repeating a long preparation step.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_soul_workshop.tip: Place a Great Chalice directly above the Soul Furnace and fill it with Essence: the full Chalice empties automatically and adds one furnace charge. Use a separate Chalice for filling Grails or the furnace takes the fill first. Follow actual recipe costs; configuration-enabled constant power does not require manual recharging.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_soul_workshop.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The First Soul Fire”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_field_notes.title: Who Lives Here?
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_field_notes.condit: Carry either an Animal Dictionary or a Field Guide.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_field_notes.purpos: Look up an unfamiliar creature before deciding how to approach it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_field_notes.tip: Search the recipe catalogue for Animal Dictionary or Field Guide. Their creature pages explain the matching species; neither book tames animals.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_field_notes.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Who Lives Here?”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h08_01.purp: Start travelling with an animal; mounting is the goal, not a measured journey.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h08_01.tip: Approach a horse empty-handed and mount it until it trusts you. A saddle is needed to steer; this quest does not require a saddle or travel distance.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h08_01.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Saddle Up”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h08_02.purp: Prepare useful mount equipment before trying the heavier transport branch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h08_02.tip: Look up leather horse armor in the recipe catalogue, then put it on a suitable tamed horse. Only carrying the armor is required here.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_10.purp: Give the poultry route a clear first project and matching feed.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_10.tip: Find Chicken Coop in the recipe catalogue, place it and bring compatible chickens nearby. The quest checks placement, not production speed or occupancy.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_10.rewa: 24 × Chicken Feed; 1 × Silkie Feather Cap; 45 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_11.purp: Turn an animal product into a useful furnishing palette.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_11.tip: Look for Jacob’s Sheep and its wool. The required item is Spotted Wool; you do not have to build or decorate a room for credit.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_h01_11.rewa: 12 × Spotted Quilt Carpet; 2 × Name Tag; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_ws22.title: Shake a Tail Feather
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_ws22.condit: Right-click in the air with a maraca in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_ws22.purpos: Discover a playful animal interaction without a rare-creature checklist.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_ws22.tip: Use the maraca described in the animal dictionary. The quest checks using the item in the air; nearby animals dancing is a bonus, not an invisible condition.
Carry wolf armor and right-click a wolf with it in your main hand.
Introduce pet protection without a deliberate injury requirement.
Brush armadillos for scutes, craft wolf armor and offer it to your tamed wolf. The quest checks armor ownership and the interaction, not damage absorbed.
1 × Brush; 16 × Pet Kibble; 2 × Name Tag; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_place.title: A Roof for Every Size
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_place.conditi: Place a small or large animal home.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_place.purpose: Give a companion a return point; the two sizes are appearance choices.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_place.tip: Small: slabs, planks and logs. Large: stairs, planks and logs. Use one matching vanilla wood family. Either home accepts a supported animal of any hitbox size.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_place.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Roof for Every Size”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.title: Home Is Where You Are
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.conditio: Bind one of your supported pets to an animal home.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.purpose: Complete the real home assignment rather than merely placing a decorative block.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.tip: Right-click the home, select your pet in its menu and choose Bind. One home holds one pet. Recovery needs the owner online, a loaded valid home and a safe space; you never need to kill a pet for a quest.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.reward: 4 × Name Tag; 32 × Pet Kibble; 2 × Pet Bowl; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_home_bind.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Home Is Where You Are”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.title: Trust Through the Ages
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.condit: Successfully tame a Vallumraptor, Raycat, Leptictidium or Gnatusuchus. One species is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.purpos: Learn a real exotic-animal bond instead of clicking every species in a catalogue.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.tip: Vallumraptor takes Serene Salad after stealing a Dinosaur Nugget and relaxing; Raycat takes Radgill, Leptictidium takes a Pouch of Seeds and Neogene Pebas Gnatusuchus takes Raw Fillet. Follow the chosen species’ native procedure. Credit requires the creature to actually become yours. Relicheirus soup logging is a separate service, not taming.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.reward: 4 × Name Tag; 16 × Pet Kibble; 8 × Serene Salad; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_exotic_bond.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Trust Through the Ages”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp03.title: Mind the Mandibles
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp03.condit: Right-click an Antlion with Crystallized Blood in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp03.purpos: Approach an unusual companion with its proper introductory material.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp03.tip: Approach from behind. Its growth follows native forms and timing; this introduction does not require waiting through every form or prove a successful bond.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.title: The Helping Spell
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.condit: Carry a mage coat, mage hat and mage staff.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.purpos: Prepare a magical companion with useful first spellbooks.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.tip: Golden Allays can be found in swamps. Their native progression uses this equipment and spellbooks. The quest checks the equipment, not a spell cast or completed transformation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.reward: 1 × Heal Ring Magic Book; 1 × Brace Magic Book; 4 × Soul Gem; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp06.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Helping Spell”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp08.title: Give Yourself a Hand
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp08.condit: Right-click a Magic Glove and carry an Empty Puppet.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp08.purpos: Start the puppet branch through its actual encounter and reward.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp08.tip: Look for the glove in a Witch House and follow its displayed item game. You need both the interaction and the puppet item; the quest does not award the first puppet.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp13.title: A Stitch in Time
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp13.condit: Right-click a Teddy with a Needle in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp13.purpos: Bring a suitable repair tool to a new companion.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp13.tip: The needle recipe uses Antlion Fur. Look for Teddy in a prison and follow its native interaction. This objective counts the needle interaction, not all later transformations.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp18.title: The Shape of a Journey
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp18.condit: Right-click an Imp empty-handed and carry Netherite Chains.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp18.purpos: Prepare a travelling companion whose native form depends on its surroundings.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp18.tip: Hire the creature using its own payment rules; chains retain a chosen form. Dimensions stay subject to the normal campaign gates, and visiting every dimension is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp18.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Shape of a Journey”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp20.title: A Second Chance
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp20.condit: Carry a Respawn Totem and an Hourglass.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp20.purpos: Prepare the native companion recovery tools without forcing a death.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp20.tip: Read their uses together. Totem charges and valid companion rules remain native. You are not asked to kill a companion; the objective checks the two items.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_cp20.reward: 32 × Crystallized Blood; 8 × Soul Gem; 4 × Name Tag; 150 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_04.c: Right-click in the air with a Coal Golem in your main hand and Flint and Steel in the other.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_04.p: Learn the carried helper’s actual activation gesture.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_04.t: Use the thrown golem’s recipe and keep the hands as stated. The task checks activation input; hitting or killing a mob is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_04.r: 4 × Coal Golem; 1 × Flint and Steel; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_08.p: Meet the advanced riding helper through its actual vehicle behavior.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_08.t: Obtain the golem through its native construction route. Gold and lava are separate native modifications with their own tradeoffs; neither is required for this goal.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_08.r: 48 × Polished Basalt Bricks; 8 × Gold Ingot; 2 × Name Tag; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_golems_08.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Heavy Company”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo01.title: A Net Gain
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo01.purpos: Prepare a creature-handling tool for a water expedition.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo01.tip: Find the Casting Net recipe, then read the supported creature entries. A network of safe pools is more useful than assuming every aquatic creature fits in a bucket.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo17.title: Fins for Feet
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo17.condit: Carry Rainbow Jelly and Flying Fish Boots.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo17.purpos: Turn marine discoveries into practical movement equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo17.tip: Use the animal dictionary and recipe catalogue to find the materials. The exact objective is both items in inventory; no ability activation or swim distance is assumed.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.title: A Whale of a Chore
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.condit: Right-click a Hullback with an iron axe and, separately, with shears.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.purpos: Discover that a giant animal has its own maintenance interactions.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.tip: Follow the Hullback’s native instructions for the tool interactions. The two clicks may occur independently; no specific collected barnacle quantity is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.reward: 12 × Barnacle Block; 12 × Rough Barnacle Block; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_companions_wo23.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Whale of a Chore”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_cloud_nursery.cond: Place a Dried Ghast and right-click a Ghastling with a snowball.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_cloud_nursery.purp: Begin the native sky companion route without a free creature reward.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_cloud_nursery.tip: Keep the Dried Ghast in water and let it become a Ghastling. Snowballs support growth. No fixed waiting timer or successful growth is checked by this introduction.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_cloud_nursery.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Cloud to Call Home”.
Finish a substantial living-transport project with an actual mounting action.
Grow the companion and craft its harness by the native recipe. A passenger and a construction project are optional. This quest checks mounting.
1 × Blue Footed Boots; 4 × Color Film; 140 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Head in the Clouds”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_pet_a_company_of_your_: Have three entries in your mount collection, earn the taming and breeding achievements, and bind a supported pet to a home.
Bring care, new life, transport and a safe home together as an optional chapter finale.

Tame three different eligible mount types, for example a horse, donkey and llama. Merely mounting does not add records; command/spawn-egg creatures and Creative taming are excluded. Bind one supported pet to its home; no pet death is required.
8 × Name Tag; 4 × Pet Bowl; 64 × Pet Kibble; 1 × Echolocator; 250 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Company of Your Own”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_amber_nursery.con: Place an Amber Monolith and witness an animal it repopulates.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_amber_nursery.pur: The monolith brings prehistoric wildlife into a prepared habitat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_amber_nursery.tip: Amber sometimes yields Amber Curiosity. A monolith gradually repopulates local fauna over several game days, considering local species and nearby animals; do not force-load chunks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_amber_nursery.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Life Comes Back”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_dinosaur_fieldwor: Perform one useful action: fly a Subterranodon, command a Tremorsaurus roar or use an Atlatitan stomp.
Prehistoric creatures have controllable powers for travel and work.

Tame Subterranodon with Trilocaris Tails and land often because a rider limits climbing. Stun Tremorsaurus with a club then immediately feed salad. Atlatitan follows volcano-boss access; salad grants temporary riding.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Ancient Skills”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_giant_nursery.con: Hatch Tremorzilla with a nuclear explosion, tame it with Waste Drums and hit a target with its controlled beam.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_giant_nursery.pur: A raised giant becomes a controllable ally with a powerful beam.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_giant_nursery.tip: The native shaped recipe uses five Tectonic Shards, an Immortal Embryo and a Tremorsaurus Egg. A nuclear explosion in a permitted place hatches it. Waste Drums tame; Nuclear Bombs are breeding food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_giant_nursery.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Very Big Beginning”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_marine_revival.co: Feed a Sea Pig and revive dead coral using its Marine Snow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_marine_revival.pu: Marine snow makes coral restoration possible.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_marine_revival.ti: Feed muck, clay or mud and collect its native digestion output. Marine Snow revives coral and supports sponge growth; a water bucket transports the pig.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_marine_revival.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Snow Underwater”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_deep_diplomacy.co: Complete an altar exchange and inspect Deep One reputation with a Gazing Pearl.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_deep_diplomacy.pu: Deep One relations provide an alternative to constant fighting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_deep_diplomacy.ti: Pearls can come from mussels grown on logs. Ordinary Deep Ones, knights and mages share reputation but different loot: knight Ortholance/Conch, mage Sea Staff. Do not attack trading partners.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_deep_diplomacy.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Offering First”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_worm_rider.title: Two Sweet Reins
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_worm_rider.condit: Attract a Gum Worm and ride using two embedded hooks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_worm_rider.purpos: Two correctly attached hooks turn the worm into transport.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_worm_rider.tip: Gobthumper made from Gumball Piles attracts the worm. Hold one hook in each hand, embed both and steer the ride; Sweet Tooth for the sack comes from its defeat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_worm_rider.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Two Sweet Reins”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_animal_work.cond: Complete one helper result: crow sorting, shrimp mining, platypus digging or gelada grass clearing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_animal_work.purp: Helpers can sort, gather and clear terrain for you.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_animal_work.tip: Toss pumpkin seeds to the crow, set a hay base, gathering and item frames on container sides. Tame shrimp with tropical fish and sneak-give a sample block; supply water on land. Feed platypus redstone near clay or gelada wheat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_animal_work.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Working Paws”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_pollinators.cond: Fill a feeder and witness hummingbird pollination; obtain a sapling planted by a toucan.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_pollinators.purp: Feeding birds connects gardening with pollination and new trees.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_pollinators.tip: Feeders take water bottles and sugar. Give toucans tree fruits: fruit chooses the tree and golden apples accelerate planting. These are two useful bird cooperation routes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_pollinators.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Sugar for Guests”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_renewable_harves: Obtain two distinct renewable gifts: bison fur, turtle scute, shed moose antler or anaconda skin.
Some useful materials can be collected while keeping the animal alive.
Shear bison; grass regrows fur. Shear snapping-turtle moss for scutes. Moose shed antlers naturally; fed anacondas shed skin. None of these material goals requires killing.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Without the Last Hit”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_creature_transpo: Transport a creature using one route: hostile-mob Vine Lasso, a catfish stomach or its suitable bucket.
The right transport method helps relocate unusual creatures.

Make the lasso from shed snake skin. A suitably sized catfish swallows items/small creatures; bucket transport followed by a sea pickle releases its contents. Use only supported buckets for ordinary aquatic passengers.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Unusual Passengers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_whale_rescue.con: Return a stranded Cachalot Whale to water without attacking it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_whale_rescue.pur: Rescue returns a sea creature to its proper habitat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_whale_rescue.tip: Storms can strand whales. Open a water route without attacking; an ambergris gift is possible but not required for rescue. Ambergris supports Echolocators and other uses.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_whale_rescue.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Back to Sea”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cargo_and_equipm: Use one special capability: elephant cargo, an equipped kangaroo or controlled Komodo riding.
An equipped animal helps with cargo, travel or protection.

Tame a calf/non-tusked elephant with Acacia Blossoms, add chest/carpet and sneak-open cargo. Kangaroos accept carrots, weapon/armor and stored plant food. Komodo needs rotten flesh and saddle; spit supports poison resistance/slime.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Gear for a Friend”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_companion_powers: Receive one companion capability: Flutter pollen, Mudskipper mud, a trained octopus form or a potion-coated rhino strike. Native radiation removal by a tamed Raycat also qualifies.
An unusual companion helps through its species-specific ability.

Flutter tames with different flowers and gains pot armor. Mudskipper takes lobster tails. Tame an uncamouflaged octopus with tails and train with Mimicream. Pacify rhino with wheat; potion coating supports a limited number of horn attacks. Tame Raycat with Radgill; it absorbs owner Irradiated and deters Nucleepers rather than acting as a combat defender.
8 × Cooked Lobster Tail; 2 × Flower Pot; 140 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Special Kind of Help”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_woodland_care.co: Complete one care result: gorilla trust, a raccoon’s washed egg or a hatched caiman’s protection. Another route is attracting an animal through Maned Wolf scent. Calming a Black Bear or earning cougar friendship also qualifies.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_woodland_care.pu: Care unlocks trust and interactions that a lead cannot provide.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_woodland_care.ti: Give gorillas bananas from jungle leaves. Toss a chicken egg near water for raccoon taming; carpet makes a bandana. Breed caimans with catfish and stay near hatching eggs for imprinting. Give a Maned Wolf an apple; scent attracts animals. It is not tameable, and its ant-farm bonus is unavailable because those ants are disabled. Offer Sweet Berries to Black Bear or venison to Cougar; a single feed does not guarantee friendship.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_woodland_care.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Trust Without a Lead”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_exotic_travel.co: Complete one route: controlled Tusklin riding, a Cosmaw rescue, Spectre transport or a peaceful orca encounter. Controlled Endergrade travel also qualifies. Warped Toad is not a riding route for this goal. Running on sand using Roadrunner Boots is also a separate alternative.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_exotic_travel.pu: Different creatures help cross different dangerous environments.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_exotic_travel.ti: Pacify Tusklin with brown mushrooms and equip Hogshoes; a saddle alone does not tame. Tame Cosmaw with Cosmic Cod and heal with chorus. Lure Spectre with Soul Heart and attach a lead. Peaceful orca swimming grants attack tempo; never hit the pod. Endergrade uses saddle and Chorus on a Stick; tame Warped Toad with mosquito larvae and heal it with maggots.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_exotic_travel.re: 12 × Enderiophage Rocket; 8 × Grilled Salmon Sandwich; 150 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_exotic_travel.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “By Stranger Trails”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_insect_nursery.c: Breed a Tarantula Hawk through its native lifecycle and upgrade Elytra with a obtained wing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_insect_nursery.p: The insect’s native lifecycle supplies an elytra-upgrade material.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_insect_nursery.t: Spider eyes tame and flowers heal. Fermented eyes breed tames around prey; offspring emerge through a buried parasitized spider. Wings upgrade Elytra armor/durability, never a substitute reward.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_insect_nursery.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Winged Generation”.
Receive a seal’s feeding gift or an actual Rain Frog musical response.
Food and sound reveal peaceful reactions in small animals.

Give a basking seal three fish and await its returned item. Carefully wake a Rain Frog with a shovel and expose it to a disc; no weather change is promised. Falconry Glove is disabled, so Potoo glove transport is not required.
1 × Jukebox; 4 × Black and White Film; 100 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “More Than a Pat”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.title: One of the Cold Pack
