jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.condit: Wear a Froststalker Helmet and successfully breed Froststalkers using porkchops.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.purpos: Suitable equipment helps you care for the icy pack more safely.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.tip: Obtain a dropped horn and make the disguise helmet. It permits approach until provoked; warmth weakens the creatures. This is camouflage, not universal taming.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.reward: 12 × Raw Porkchop; 6 × Mosquito Repellent Stew; 130 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cold_pack.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “One of the Cold Pack”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lava_nursery.con: Raise a Straddler from a Stradpole and ride a crafted Straddleboard.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lava_nursery.pur: Raising the young creature connects animal care with lava travel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lava_nursery.tip: Capture Stradpole with a lava bucket and feed Crimson Mosquito Larvae. The grown Straddler is hostile; its Straddlite makes the board. The board crosses lava quickly but sinks in water and destabilizes on collisions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lava_nursery.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Tadpole First”.
Transport a mouse in a pot and receive a Squonk gift after a cookie.
Small creatures offer their own transport and exchange interactions.
Forest/plains mice like Pumpkin Seeds; a pot preserves the passenger. Wet-biome Squonks can return a gift for a cookie, without becoming tamed.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Small Favor”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_ringtail_and_car: Receive Ringtail mining help or control a saddled Caribou.
Some companions help underground, others on snowy journeys.
Dry-biome Ringtails accept Glow Berries for mining friendship. Feed cold-biome Caribou red mushrooms then saddle. Food interaction without its resulting assistance/riding does not count.
More details: unified guide → Items → “To Mine and Snow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_barrel_bear.cond: Tame a bear and let it heal using food in its barrel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_barrel_bear.purp: The bear’s own food supply supports recovery after adventures.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_barrel_bear.tip: Approach slowly with honeycombs, then equip the tame with a food-filled barrel. It eats from the barrel at low health. Actual healing is checked, not a barrel click.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_barrel_bear.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Lunch on Your Back”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crocodile_retrie: Recover swallowed crocodile items with a feather and feed it a clock.
The native interaction lets you recover swallowed belongings.

A crocodile stores swallowed victim drops; feather interaction recovers them. Clock feeding is a separate native action. Guide wording suggests scaring pillagers, but no exact radius or guaranteed fear is asserted.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Please Return the Swallowed”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_nursery.co: Hatch an eagle from a found egg and tame the baby with raw chicken.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_nursery.pu: Raising a Primal eagle gives you a genuinely tamed helper.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_nursery.ti: Find an eagle nest; only the baby taming route qualifies, not an adult shortcut. Cassowary fathers defend nests; not all bird eggs are safe loot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_nursery.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “From Nest to Team”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_musical_snake.co: Tame a dancing snake with raw rabbit and collect its bitten-bottle output.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_musical_snake.pu: A tamed snake unlocks a musical interaction and useful output.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_musical_snake.ti: Play a note block or jukebox nearby, then offer rabbit during its dance state. The bottle needs an actual native bite result; effect contents are not promised without inspecting the output.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_musical_snake.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Music Charms”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_walrus_signal.co: Control a walrus ride and bind a Conch Shell to your pet. Have the walrus play its shell.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_walrus_signal.pu: The shell connects a signal to a particular pet.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_walrus_signal.ti: Tame walrus through riding; it has a land slam and underwater whirlwind. Use Conch on a pet to bind it; walrus shell-playing is a separate native interaction. A bound shell must contain a real target.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_walrus_signal.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Walrus Signal”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lion_trust.title: A Big Cat’s Trust
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lion_trust.condi: Tame a lion with meat and use its native rest interaction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lion_trust.purpo: A large predator’s trust enables peaceful interaction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lion_trust.tip: Approach a savanna lion slowly with a substantial meat supply. Taming enables the lap-nap interaction; the rare snowy form is a visual variant, not a required collection.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_lion_trust.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Big Cat’s Trust”.
Tame a Candicorn with Caramel Apples and perform a controlled charge.
A tamed Candicorn helps cover ground with controlled charges.
Saddle it, gain speed and release its charge. Candy Canes breed them and offspring inherit parental color; collecting every color is not required.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Caramel Momentum”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wet_work.title: Wet Work
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wet_work.condition: Collect mucus from a wet snail and change an ordinary or ghostly mucus block through humidity.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wet_work.purpose: The mucus supports another humidity experiment and the shell tiles furnish the snail habitat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wet_work.tip: Keep the snail in a safe wet habitat. Ordinary mucus slows contact; soft ghostly mucus permits passage. Humidity changes these states. Removing a snail shell is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wet_work.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Wet Work”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_solar_kitchen.cond: Help a juvenile iguana shed, then retrieve food it solar-cooks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_solar_kitchen.purp: Straw blocks and nests help build a dry sunny habitat beside the living kitchen.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_solar_kitchen.tip: Find an iguana on Tropical Islands. Its native shedding interaction establishes trust, then its sunlight cooking produces food. A real cooked output is required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_solar_kitchen.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Sun-Cooked Supper”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.title: A Reef with Character
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.conditi: Place an item on an underwater Sea Urchin’s head and use Clam plus Prismarine for a supported creature’s appearance change.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.purpose: Reefstone and sea pickles provide a sturdy lit platform for the living aquatic display.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.tip: Keep the urchin underwater; land is fatal. Its head carries an item and bundles follow native rules. Use the fieldguide/recipe view for the supported Clam-and-Prismarine cosmetic recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.reward: 24 × Algal Reefstone; 8 × Big Sea Pickle; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_reef_style.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Reef with Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.title: The Next Wave
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.conditio: Breed Tuna or Sunfish and raise one offspring.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.purpose: Coral blocks extend the young-fish nursery and sandwiches supply the next dive.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.tip: Tuna develops from an egg; buckets accept only eligible young stages. Adult Tuna and Sunfish do not fit a bucket. Dodos are not an alternative breeding target.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.reward: 16 × Wax Coral Block; 8 × Tuna Sandwich; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_next_wave.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Next Wave”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_mushroom_soup.cond: Obtain soup from a Flukeshroom using a bowl.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_mushroom_soup.purp: Forest planks furnish a mushroom camp and escargot introduces another unusual edible resource.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_mushroom_soup.tip: Find Flukeshrooms in Mushroom Fields. Use an empty bowl and receive soup. Lightning changes their form, but waiting for a storm is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_mushroom_soup.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Soup on Legs”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bubble_switch.cond: Wake a Stranded with Honeycomb, freeze it with an axe and release a living creature from a crab bubble
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bubble_switch.purp: Marine planks frame the controlled passage and a music disc brings the coast’s atmosphere to the home camp.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bubble_switch.tip: Honeycomb starts the Stranded native wake sequence. An axe returns an active Stranded to its frozen state. Complete both transitions and separately release a living creature from a real crab bubble
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bubble_switch.rewa: 24 × Cracked Rotten Planks; 1 × Music Disc; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bubble_switch.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Bubble Watch”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sea_sound.title: Music from the Deep
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sea_sound.conditio: Obtain Water Horse from a Seahorse rider or Barbaric after a Barbed kills a Creeper.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sea_sound.purpose: A second themed disc and moonstone furnish a display for rare marine finds.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sea_sound.tip: A baby Drowned riding a Seahorse is the Water Horse route; a Barbed killing a Creeper is the Barbaric route. Choose either. Command-given discs do not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sea_sound.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Music from the Deep”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_forest_friends.con: Successfully feed a Burrel a Pinecone and a Glaceros the Larkspur matching its antler variant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_forest_friends.pur: Pinecones support further Burrel visits and displays give found antlers a place at home.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_forest_friends.tip: Find them in Frostbite Forest. Burrel likes Pinecones and sap. Glaceros antler variants prefer corresponding Larkspur flowers; one color is not universal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_forest_friends.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Guests from the Cold”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_winter_companion.c: Tame a baby Frostomper or a Speartooth through its native procedure.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_winter_companion.p: Hearty chops supply another cold journey and shaggy blocks help furnish winter housing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_winter_companion.t: Use the baby Frostomper’s native taming route and avoid provoking adult herds. Speartooth takes Beast Chops; a single feeding is not guaranteed success.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_winter_companion.r: 8 × Glazed Beast Chops; 16 × Shaggy Block; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_winter_companion.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “At Home in the Snow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.title: Cool It, Bear
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.conditi: Pacify a Psycho Bear using Psycho Berry Ice Cream.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.purpose: Psycho Berry sprouts support growing future treats at home and the painting commemorates the peaceful encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.tip: The bear likes Psycho Berries, but this interaction specifically uses the ice cream. Keep a safe retreat and observe native pacification; killing it is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.reward: 4 × Psycho Berry Sprout; 1 × Permafrost Burrel Painting; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_cool_heads.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Cool It, Bear”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.title: A Soft Landing
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.condi: Shear a living Snowdo for its native feathers and use its held-creature slow-fall ability
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.purpo: Feathers support the journey, while the rewarded Shaggy Pelt continues the textile route
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.tip: Shearing a living Snowdo produces feathers, which regrow through its native mechanic. Holding the bird slows a real fall. A short descent is enough to try it
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.rewar: 8 × Shaggy Pelt; 6 × Melon Ice Cream; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_soft_landing.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Soft Landing”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_little_excavator.c: Collect an actual item unearthed by your owned Leptictidium or Gnatusuchus.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_little_excavator.p: Hide supports ancient travel equipment and rope ladders help leave excavation sites.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_little_excavator.t: Find Leptictidium in Paleogene Messel Pit, tame with a Seed Pouch and sneak-use it; digging has a native two-minute cooldown. Neogene Pebas Gnatusuchus takes Raw Fillet, not Clam.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_little_excavator.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Digging for Two”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_turtle_cargo.title: Cargo on a Shell
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_turtle_cargo.condi: Tame Carbonemys, equip its satchel and retrieve one item from its storage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_turtle_cargo.purpo: Hide supports further carrying equipment and cooked fillets provision the owner on a longer journey.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_turtle_cargo.tip: Find Carbonemys in Cerrejon and use clams for taming. Fit its satchel and sneak-use to open storage. The native satchel also supports long expeditions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_turtle_cargo.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Cargo on a Shell”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.title: Clay Needs Care
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.conditio: Transform a Clay Golem Statue into Terracotta Golem and apply a cactus or dead-bush upgrade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.purpose: Two statues supply further transformations and a Candle Golem opens the neighboring construct variant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.tip: The statue transforms through native heat behavior. Cactus and Dead Bush offer different attack roles. Candle Golem uses a separate item transformation; any statue is not automatically a fighter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.reward: 2 × Clay Golem Statue; 1 × Candle Golem Block; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_warm_clay.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Clay Needs Care”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_trailcraft.title: A Mounted Stop
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_trailcraft.conditi: While mounted, hitch a horse to a fence using its special lead slot; remove a pack animal’s chest with shears.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_trailcraft.purpose: Horseshoes and blankets support caring for and dressing transport animals after learning stops and unloading.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_trailcraft.tip: Put the lead in the horse’s special slot and interact with a fence while riding. Empty a pack chest safely before shearing; its contents drop. The native inventory-switch button moves between rider and horse views.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_trailcraft.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Mounted Stop”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.title: Fresh Wheels
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.condi: Repair a damaged wagon with iron according to the current repair rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.purpo: Wheels and two wool colors support maintaining and decorating the wagon already in use.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.tip: Iron repairs the wagon under the current repair rules. Wool recoloring consumes no material and does not count for this goal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.rewar: 4 × Wheel; 8 × Blue Wool; 8 × Red Wool; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_fresh_wheels.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fresh Wheels”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_widgets.cond: Find a Widget in shipwreck supply loot, install it on Hullback and operate its cannon or anchor.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_widgets.purp: A sail extends the living ship’s fittings and gunpowder supplies further permitted cannon use.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_widgets.tip: Widgets such as sails and cannons come from native exploration loot. Cannons use gunpowder; Helm jump controls activate the supported widget, including an anchor. One working widget is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_widgets.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Whale Fittings”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.title: A Croaking Bargain
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.condi: Complete a real trade with a merchant or fisherman Ribbit.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.purpo: Mossy planks and swamp lanterns furnish a small camp along the newly discovered trading route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.tip: Look for Ribbit villages in swamps; maracas occur in their trade. Do not expect plants removed from current offers; use the actual trade screen.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.rewar: 24 × Mossy Oak Planks; 8 × Swamp Lantern; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_market.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Croaking Bargain”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_neighbors.co: Set a Ribbit’s new home using amethyst and observe a native gardener watering a nearby crop.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_neighbors.pu: Lilypads and umbrella leaves furnish the water and banks around the neighbor’s actual new home.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_neighbors.ti: Bring a Ribbit to a prepared site and use amethyst. Put crops beside a gardener; sorcerers can offer buffs. Neither a blessing nor waiting all night is an additional hidden requirement.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_neighbors.re: 8 × Lush Lily Pad; 8 × Umbrella Leaf; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_neighbors.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Neighbors by the Water”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.title: Join the Band
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.conditi: Play a maraca with an active Ribbit music circle.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.purpose: Two toadstool colors decorate a home music corner after a real performance with the band.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.tip: Buy a maraca and find a group already sitting down to play. Use the instrument beside an active native music gathering; an isolated air click is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.reward: 16 × Red Toadstool Block; 16 × Brown Toadstool Block; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_swamp_band.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Join the Band”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_phases_and_faces.c: Change your owned Antlion’s phase with a fully durable Hourglass and lock an eligible minion’s chosen phase with chains.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_phases_and_faces.p: Antlion Fur and Crystallized Blood supply further work with companion forms.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_phases_and_faces.t: The Hourglass needs full durability for its native action. Chains lock the minion’s phase; they do not grant dimension access or alter campaign rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_phases_and_faces.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Time Changes Friends”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_porcelain_trip.con: Successfully contain an eligible creature in Holy Porcelain Pottery and release it again.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_porcelain_trip.pur: Ordinary pottery supports further crafting and name tags distinguish safely relocated creatures.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_porcelain_trip.tip: Native size and blacklist rules apply. Do not use bosses or another player’s pets; select an eligible creature and a safe release site.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_porcelain_trip.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Handle with Care”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_totem_shapes.title: Memory Takes Shape
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_totem_shapes.condi: Apply Old Cloth or Relic Gold to a Respawn Totem and obtain its corresponding native summon.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_totem_shapes.purpo: Blood and Soul Gems supply later summon work while rare source materials remain tied to their real encounters.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_totem_shapes.tip: Old Cloth gives Cloak and Relic Gold gives Mankh. Obtain materials through their real paths and encounters; the quest never grants them or requires a player/pet death.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_totem_shapes.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Memory Takes Shape”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shelled_friend.con: Raise a Scuttler into a tamed Shellback and mount it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shelled_friend.pur: Jelly supplies continued Scuttler care and lamps furnish a lit marine stop for the mount.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shelled_friend.tip: Scuttler likes Jellyfish Jelly. Use native maturation/taming without guessed ages or feeding counts. The resulting owned mount must actually accept its rider.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shelled_friend.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Friend in a Shell”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_quilted_ride.title: A Quilted Ride
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_quilted_ride.condi: Tame a Clydesdale, equip a supported quilted blanket and gallop on it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_quilted_ride.purpo: Horseshoes and fodder support continued use of the heavy horse already tamed and equipped.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_quilted_ride.tip: A compatible spotted or quilted rug doubles as a heavy horse blanket. Home textiles and mount equipment share a material route; use the native blanket slot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_quilted_ride.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Quilted Ride”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_farm_signatures.co: Shear Spotted Wool from Jacob’s Sheep, collect a Cochin Bantam Egg and wear a Silkie Feather Cap.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_farm_signatures.pu: Quilt rugs demonstrate a home use for Spotted Wool and feed supports the next poultry task.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_farm_signatures.ti: These breeds provide distinct useful results: textile wool, a breed-specific egg and a wearable cap. No complete collection of every breed is required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_farm_signatures.re: 8 × Spotted Quilt Carpet; 24 × Chicken Feed; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_farm_signatures.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Harvest of Their Own”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.title: Moving without Loss
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.conditi: Unbind your pet from its home and successfully bind it to another free home.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.purpose: Bowls, kibble and name tags furnish the new address while preserving the same pet and owner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.tip: Right-click a home and choose Bind or Unbind after selecting your pet. Each home holds one pet. Both sizes accept any supported animal; large creatures use a nearby safe position around the home’s level.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.reward: 24 × Pet Kibble; 2 × Pet Bowl; 4 × Name Tag; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_moving_day.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Moving without Loss”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_small_titans.co: Successfully tame a Modern Remnant or Netherite Ministrosity through its native method.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_small_titans.pu: Choose one little titan and finish its own taming route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_small_titans.ti: Remnant Skull creates Modern Remnant, tamed with a Sniffer Egg. Netherite Effigy creates Ministrosity, tamed with a Lava Power Cell. Obtain both summon paths normally; this quest does not award them.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_small_titans.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Very Small Titan”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_nether_housegue: Tame a Pottergeist and successfully attach its storage vase.
Connect an ash companion’s taming with its real storage function.
Find Pottergeist in the Ash Forest. Native right-click tames it under eligible conditions; then configure following and attach a vase. A click without actual ownership/storage is insufficient.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Guest from the Ash”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_guzzle_ectoplas: Feed a Guzzleghast and obtain its ectoplasm, then use its native throw.
Connect feeding a creature with a new way to alter block gravity.
Follow its native food tooltip first. The ectoplasm affects block gravity; arbitrary food and targets are not guaranteed to work.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Feed the Weightless”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_spider_pollen.c: Successfully grow Giant Bamboo using actual spider pollen.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_spider_pollen.p: Unlock an unusual building plant through a successful pollen interaction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_spider_pollen.t: Use Bottle of Spider Pollen on eligible bamboo. Not every creative spider/spawn egg is survival-enabled; use current native recipes and spawning.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_spider_pollen.r: 6 × Bamboo Shelf; 2 × Bamboo Wind Chime; 60 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_spider_pollen.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Bamboo with Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.title: The Clucking Store
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.conditi: Collect a genuinely stored egg from an occupied Chicken Coop.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.purpose: Collect farm produce from a working Coop.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.tip: Lead compatible chickens into the Coop and let them lay an egg. A Pitchfork releases the birds; placing an empty block does not prove production.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.reward: 16 × Chicken Feed; 12 × Iron Coral Bars; 56 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_coop_eggs.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Clucking Store”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_mob_capture.cond: Capture an eligible passive animal with Mob Catcher and release it safely.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_mob_capture.purp: Move an eligible pet while preserving its data; leads and upgrade bases support the next safe relocation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_mob_capture.tip: Sneak-use the native catcher on a permitted animal. Basic handles passive mobs; advanced may handle hostile mobs within server restrictions. Preserve native ownership and entity data.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_mob_capture.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Moving Day”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_cheek_delivery.con: Open your tamed hamster’s cheek inventory and retrieve one item.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_cheek_delivery.pur: A wheel immediately improves the hamster’s home and seeds supply care after the first real unloading.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_cheek_delivery.tip: Harvest Sunflower Seeds; they regrow after morning. Let the tame collect a harmless item, open its owner inventory and retrieve it. Avoid extreme heat or cold.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_cheek_delivery.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Safe in Your Cheeks”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_colony.title: A Tiny Colony
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_colony.condition: Hatch an owned ant from a pupa and complete one native ant-farm recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_colony.purpose: Planks and another farm help separate growing colonies after the first actual production cycle.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_colony.tip: Look for pupae around ant colonies. Hatch one that records you as owner, then use a recipe shown for the ant farm. Keep colonies with different abdomen colors apart.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_colony.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Tiny Colony”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_living_aquarium.co: Successfully capture and safely release an eligible aquatic creature; house an octopus in a Nautilus Shell.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_living_aquarium.pu: Reefstone and two coral materials provide a fitting palette for the new safe pool.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_living_aquarium.ti: Small fish fit buckets and some creatures fit the Casting Net; check each native entry. Large adult fish reject buckets. Octopus housing uses the supported Nautilus Shell, not an empty-net click.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_living_aquarium.re: 24 × Reefstone; 8 × Heart Coral Block; 8 × Reed Coral Block; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_living_aquarium.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Aquatic Passengers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_seagrass_pasture.c: Successfully milk a Sea Cow and collect one item it forages after feeding by Tall Seagrass.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_seagrass_pasture.p: Sea pickles illuminate the underwater pasture and ready food provisions the next visit.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_seagrass_pasture.t: Offer its accepted food, preserve Tall Seagrass and use an empty bucket for milking. Both checks require a real native result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_seagrass_pasture.r: 8 × Big Sea Pickle; 8 × Plate of Crab Boil; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_seagrass_pasture.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Seagrass Pasture”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.title: A Job for Each
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.conditi: Complete a real Barrel Golem exchange or collect Honey Golem honey, and station a Hay Golem by crops.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.purpose: Statues open the next construct-helper route and honey remains useful after the first genuine result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.tip: Drop the allowed payment near a Barrel Golem; Honey Golems occur in birch forests. Hay Golems protect nearby crops from trampling. Server economy may change payments; planks are not a trade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.reward: 2 × Clay Golem Statue; 8 × Honey Blob; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_golem_jobs.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Job for Each”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wagon_service.cond: Hitch a horse to a wagon, transport one mob passenger and unload it safely.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wagon_service.purp: A whip, wheels and fodder supply more real transport without granting a finished second wagon.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wagon_service.tip: Leash the horse and sneak-interact with the wagon. Load an eligible mob at a stationary wagon, move it and unload. The whip adjusts speed; off-seat sneak interaction changes direction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wagon_service.rewa: 1 × Horse Whip; 4 × Wheel; 16 × Horse Fodder; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_wagon_service.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Wagon at Work”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sled_team.title: A Snow Team
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sled_team.conditio: Hitch a tamed wolf to a sled, install a chest and carry items over snow or ice.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sled_team.purpose: Lights decorate a winter stop and eggnog supplies the next outing after the wolf team’s first job.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sled_team.tip: Use a lead to hitch your wolf. A chest or supported storage container carries cargo. Slopes give momentum and the wolf helps uphill.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_sled_team.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Snow Team”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.title: Captain of a Living Deck
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.conditi: Saddle a cleaned Hullback, add plank armor and actually steer it with the Helm.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.purpose: Two barnacle variants provide marine decoration for the berth and sandwiches supply another controlled voyage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.tip: Find Hullbacks in deep oceans and clean their gunk with axe and shears. Then use the native saddle, plank-armor and Helm interactions. Mounting alone is not steering.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.reward: 16 × Barnacle Block; 16 × Rough Barnacle Block; 8 × Tuna Sandwich; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_whale_helm.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Captain of a Living Deck”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bread_hatch.title: Bread That Grew Up
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bread_hatch.condit: Hatch a Croissant Dragon, grow it with milk and fit one flavor of armor.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bread_hatch.purpos: Bread and blood support further care and crafting while the egg and armor remain products of the player’s own project.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bread_hatch.tip: Process Big Bread in the Soul Furnace, place the egg, use milk after hatching and choose vanilla, chocolate or strawberry armor. All three variants are unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_bread_hatch.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Bread That Grew Up”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_current_flows.cond: Restore a Broken Dinamo and power a real Plasma Lamp through its Tesla Network.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_current_flows.purp: Pillars and extra lamps expand the network already working instead of replacing it with a free generator.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_current_flows.tip: Dinamo requests planks, Homunculus, iron and Tesla Coil in stages confirmed with Wrench. Link native nodes, choose top pillars with equal heights and use relays to extend range.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_current_flows.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Current Flows”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_recall_trip.title: Recall Accepted
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_recall_trip.condit: Travel between two Recall Platforms on the same working network.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_recall_trip.purpos: Pillars and Soul Gems support network expansion after real travel between its two platforms.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_recall_trip.tip: Link both platforms to one Tesla Network and use native travel. The network rejects self-links and excessive distances. Placing two platforms does not prove transfer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_recall_trip.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Recall Accepted”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shade_call.title: Who Answers the Bell?
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shade_call.conditi: Fill one Shade altar with Crystallized Blood, link its bell and summon its creature.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shade_call.purpose: Blood supplies later native altar charges and ghost lamps improve the summoning corner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shade_call.tip: Choose Maw, Sword or Bat altar. The linked bell needs a nonempty charged altar and consumes charges. Full charge improves its initial summon; all three altars are optional.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_shade_call.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Who Answers the Bell?”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_a_hand_in_action.c: Install one Puppet arm and perform its real special action.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_a_hand_in_action.p: Blood and Soul Gems support further puppet modification without granting another finished combat arm.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_a_hand_in_action.t: Whip, Mutant, Blade and Cannon arms are interchangeable. The initial puppet comes from the glove’s native item game in Witch House, not an inventory checklist.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_a_hand_in_action.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Hand in Action”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_angler_light.title: Light as a Favor
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_angler_light.condi: Give an Angler Fish an accepted shiny item and receive actual Night Vision.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_angler_light.purpo: Permanent lamps and reef tiles furnish a dive base after the angler’s temporary assistance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_angler_light.tip: Bring a gold nugget and find an Angler Fish; eligible fish can be bucketed. The real effect must activate; an unsuccessful interaction does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_angler_light.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Light as a Favor”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_guardian_vest.cond: Equip your Great Pyrenees with its protective vest and successfully feed a pet appropriate food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_guardian_vest.purp: Kibble and two bowls maintain the protected yard companion without granting a free new dog.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_guardian_vest.tip: Sneak-use the vest on your owned dog. Pet Kibble heals Manx Cats or Great Pyrenees; species diets differ. Do not injure a pet deliberately; accepted ordinary feeding also qualifies.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_guardian_vest.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Dressed Defender”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_shark_supper.con: Let a Great White Shark eat a piece of raw beef you dropped.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_shark_supper.pur: Learn the actual marine-predator feeding route without inventing taming.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_shark_supper.tip: Drop one piece in the water near the shark and move away. Version 1.0.7 eats dropped food rather than hand right-click feeding. Meat food is accepted; the whole dropped item entity is discarded, so drop one at a time. This does not tame or promise healing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_shark_supper.rew: 8 × Cooked Mackerel fish; 1 × Water Bucket; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_essence_and_orders: Restore genuinely missing health with Essence to your owned companion while it is in Follow mode.
Three Great Essences and an Empty Grail let the player immediately try filling a Chalice after genuinely caring for a companion.

Use an empty main hand on your own companion until its message confirms Follow. Further interactions cycle its modes; Wander depends on configuration. After an ordinary fight use Small or Great Essence, without deliberately hurting the companion. Essences use their native hostile-loot/crafting route; four Small craft one Great.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Close and Cared For”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_grail_filling.cond: Use an Empty Grail on a full normal Great Chalice and obtain the Filled Grail.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_grail_filling.purp: Six Great Essences supply two complete refills for powering the Soul Furnace, while blood supports first companion experiments.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_grail_filling.tip: Great Chalice uses seven Copper Ingots and Empty Grail uses three. The Chalice holds 12 charges: three Great Essences fill it. Use the Empty Grail on a full normal Chalice. For this experiment keep it separate from a Soul Furnace: the furnace below automatically takes a full charge. Afterwards place it above the furnace and refill.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_grail_filling.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “To the Brim”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lava_nursery.cond: Grow a baby Strider into an adult using a Nether Caterpillar.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lava_nursery.purp: Prepare a new lava companion through real feeding rather than merely owning its food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lava_nursery.tip: Find a baby Strider or obtain one through ordinary breeding. Use a Nether Caterpillar on it: successful feeding consumes one caterpillar and immediately makes it an adult. An adult target does not qualify.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lava_nursery.rewa: 2 × Nether Caterpillar; 1 × Warped Fungus on a Stick; 64 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lava_nursery.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Growing Up in a Flash”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.title: Make Yourself at Home
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.conditi: Place a chair, a cupboard and a fancy bed in any supported wood.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.purpose: Give a room a seat, storage and a proper bed.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.tip: Choose any supported wood for each piece in the recipe view. One placement of each furniture type is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.reward: 1 × Hammer; 6 × Oak Shelf; 4 × Red Cushion; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_furniture.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Make Yourself at Home”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_start_02.title: A Light in the Window
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_start_02.conditio: Place any bed and a normal torch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_start_02.purpose: Give your first home a resting place and a light.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_start_02.tip: Make a bed from wool and planks, and a torch from coal and a stick. The goal records both placements; sleeping is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_start_02.reward: 1 × Oak Bench; 1 × Oak Cupboard; 4 × Red Cushion; 20 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.title: Think Outside the Cube
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.condition: Place four listed shaped building blocks: beams, supports, layers, lattice or another supported shape.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.purpose: Add a thin edge or a projecting detail to a plain wall.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.tip: Look up a shape for a material you already have. Any four placements from the supported building sets count; four different materials are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.reward: 48 × Stone Brick Layer; 12 × Stone Fence; 36 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Think Outside the Cube”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_04.title: Who Is at the Window?
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_04.purpose: Try an interactive detail for your windows.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_04.tip: Craft and place a shutter by a window. The goal records the click; watch how your chosen model responds.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_04.reward: 1 × Bamboo Wind Chime; 8 × Cypress Trapdoor; 28 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_04.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Who Is at the Window?”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_05.title: A Wall with a Secret
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_05.condition: Place a secret door or secret trapdoor.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_05.purpose: Hide a pantry entrance or a private room in plain sight.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_05.tip: Choose a hidden door matching your wall material. Place it and try opening it; this goal records placement.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_05.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Wall with a Secret”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_06.title: Press Here
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_06.condition: Place one button from the supported decorative button set.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_06.purpose: Choose a large or hidden control for your doorway.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_06.tip: The recipe list includes large and disguised variants. This objective checks the installed button; wire the build to suit your plan.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.title: Keep the Evening Going
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.condition: Obtain hanging lights and place a normal lantern.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.purpose: Pair practical lighting with a warmer decorative layer.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.tip: Look up Hanging Lights, then choose attachment points. The goal records owning the strand and placing a lantern, not the length of a finished string.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.reward: 8 × Candle Lantern; 8 × White Glow Lights; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep the Evening Going”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_09.title: Home Is Where the Smoke Is
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_09.purpose: Give the roof a small sign of life.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_09.tip: Choose a chimney material in the recipe view. Extend or join its sections; the objective records two placements.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_09.reward: 12 × Brick Chimney; 6 × Copper Chimney; 16 × Rope; 32 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.title: Time Did the Decorating
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.condition: Obtain one listed rusted, mossy or weathered material.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.purpose: Use age and wear as a deliberate building palette.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.tip: Find a weathered material or check its available recipe. No fixed waiting period or building age is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.reward: 48 × Mossy Stone Brick Layer; 24 × Weathered Cut Copper Layer; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_10.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Time Did the Decorating”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.title: The House Rings Out
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.condition: Right-click a placed chime or bell from the listed set.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.purpose: Try a small sound-making detail for your home.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.tip: Hang the chimes somewhere visible. The objective records the click; it does not require a separate sound event.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.reward: 2 × Blue Glazed Thick Pot; Choose one: 1 × Amethyst Wind Chime, 2 × Copper Wind Chime, 2 × Glass Wind Bell; 32 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_12.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The House Rings Out”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.title: Any Excuse Will Do
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.condition: Place three festive decorations from the listed set.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.purpose: Give an ordinary room a reason to celebrate.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.tip: Choose decorations with available recipes. Any three placements count; no calendar date or other player is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.reward: 1 × Snow Globe; 4 × Wreath; 8 × Prismatic Glow Lights; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h05_13.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Any Excuse Will Do”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_vanilla_01.title: Copper Gets to Work
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_vanilla_01.condit: Craft a copper pickaxe and place a copper bulb.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_vanilla_01.purpos: Try copper as a tool material and a working light.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_vanilla_01.tip: Look up the copper pickaxe and bulb recipes. You can also try an axe or honeycomb on suitable copper surfaces; that is a suggestion, not a hidden objective.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bag_01.title: A Bigger Pocket
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bag_01.purpose: Take your supplies along without filling every ordinary slot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bag_01.tip: Craft a basic backpack and inspect its upgrade slots. Install the rewarded pickup upgrade; merely carrying it will not complete its practical lesson.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bag_01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Bigger Pocket”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_pickup.title: Straight into the Bag
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_pickup.condition: Install a pickup upgrade and let it collect at least one dropped item into the backpack.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_pickup.purpose: Make automatic pickup serve your trips.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_pickup.tip: Install and enable the upgrade in the backpack. Drop an ordinary spare item nearby and check that it enters the backpack itself.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_pickup.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Straight into the Bag”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.title: Packed the Workbench
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.conditio: Install a crafting upgrade and take one crafted result from the backpack’s crafting grid.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.purpose: Use a real working tool while away from base.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.tip: Install the upgrade, open its crafting panel and make something simple such as sticks. Take the finished result.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.reward: 1 × Iron Backpack; 8 × Grilled Bacon Sandwich; 72 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_bagcraft.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Packed the Workbench”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_store_01.title: A Barrel with a Future
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_store_01.purpose: Start storage you can expand without rebuilding the room.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_store_01.tip: Craft the upgradeable storage barrel rather than a normal barrel. Inspect its upgrade slots and capacity tiers.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_store_01.reward: 1 × Basic to Iron Tier Upgrade; 32 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_controller.title: One Door to the Store
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_controller.condit: Place a storage controller and obtain a linking tool.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_controller.purpos: Prepare one access point for several containers.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_controller.tip: Look up the controller and linking tool. Use the tool’s own instructions to link compatible containers; this goal checks the placed controller and owned tool.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_hopper.title: The Store Starts Moving
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_hopper.condition: Install a hopper upgrade and, while keeping that container’s menu open, let it transfer at least one item.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_hopper.purpose: Try an actual transfer between upgraded storage and a neighboring inventory.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_hopper.tip: Set the transfer direction, supply an item and keep the upgraded container’s menu open until the transfer commits. Credit goes to the player observing through that exact menu.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_hopper.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Store Starts Moving”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.title: Everything in One Place
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.condition: Place a storage terminal and an inventory connector.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.purpose: Get to know a shared storage network.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.tip: Craft a Storage Terminal and Inventory Connector. Place the connector by compatible storage and connect the terminal following their item instructions. This goal records both placements; the practical crafting lesson follows.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.reward: 24 × Inventory Cable; 4 × Inventory Cable Connector; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Everything in One Place”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_networkcraft.cond: Take a crafted result from a connected crafting terminal using the network’s ingredients.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_networkcraft.purp: Let the store supply your workbench.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_networkcraft.tip: Install a Crafting Terminal on a working network, put ingredients in connected containers and craft a simple item through the terminal. Take the result; opening the screen alone is not enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_networkcraft.rewa: 2 × Inventory Cable Connector (Filtered); 2 × Item Filter; 72 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_networkcraft.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Bench Knows the Store”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_03.title: A Box for Everything
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_03.condition: Place a filtered inventory cable connector.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_03.purpose: Give one kind of supply a deliberate destination.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_03.tip: Open the connector’s settings and choose the items for its filter. Placement is the recorded condition; try the rule with a small stock before expanding.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_03.reward: 1 × Level Emitter; 2 × Tag Item Filter; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_04.title: Enough, Thank You
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_04.purpose: Introduce your storage to redstone stock signals.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h07_04.tip: Connect a Level Emitter to the network and choose a stock threshold in its settings. The goal records placement; inspect its output as the stored count changes.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.title: The Store in Your Hand
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.conditio: Successfully open a connected network using a wireless terminal.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.purpose: Reach your own supplies away from the wall-mounted terminal.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.tip: Craft a Wireless Terminal, bind it to your network using its item instructions and open storage within its allowed range. Native distance and access rules still apply.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.reward: 48 × Inventory Cable; 8 × Inventory Cable Connector; 2 × Inventory Proxy; 88 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_wireless.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Store in Your Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_01.title: Hold Still
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_01.condition: Right-click in the air with a camera in your main hand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_01.purpose: Get to know the camera controls.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_01.tip: Craft a Camera, inspect its controls and load film. Read the lens and flash tooltips. This first step records the click, not a finished exposure.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_01.reward: 2 × Black and White Film; 8 × Paper; 32 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_print.title: A Picture on Paper
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_print.condition: Obtain developed black-and-white film and a photograph containing a valid image.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_print.purpose: Follow the process from film to a displayable print.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_print.tip: Expose film, develop it using its available recipe and print a photograph using the photo equipment. A blank photograph item does not count; the goal checks the resulting items, not who took the picture.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_04.title: The World Is Not Grey
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_04.purpose: Extend the familiar process into color.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_04.tip: Load color film and check its developing recipe. Three-color experiments are separate; ordinary color film does not require three filters.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_04.reward: 2 × High-Sensitivity Color Film; 2 × Color Film; 64 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_05.title: Room for Me in the Frame
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_05.purpose: Prepare the camera for staged pictures and self-portraits.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_05.tip: Look up the Camera Stand recipe. Place it, mount the camera and inspect its stationary controls; this goal records obtaining the stand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_05.reward: 2 × Black and White Film; 4 × Glass Photograph Frame; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.title: Memories on the Shelf
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.condition: Obtain an album and a normal photograph frame.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.purpose: Choose which pictures to display and which to keep together.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.tip: Look up Album and Photograph Frame for two ways to keep prints. Try adding a finished photograph; this goal records obtaining both items.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.reward: 8 × Photograph Frame; 4 × Dark Oak Shelf; 44 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Memories on the Shelf”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_08.title: As If Years Had Passed
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_08.purpose: Try another finish for a remembered moment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_08.tip: Check the Aged Photograph acquisition or use view for an ordinary print. No real-time waiting period is part of this objective.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_08.reward: 4 × High-Sensitivity Color Film; 8 × Glass Photograph Frame; 72 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_09.title: That Sounds Familiar
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_09.condition: Right-click in the air with a flute or lute.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_09.purpose: Get to know an instrument’s controls.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_09.tip: Craft a flute or lute, inspect its controls and try the notes. This introduction records the click; an actual played note is required for the housewarming finale.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_09.reward: 4 × White Cushion; Choose one: 1 × Bagpipe, 1 × Vielle, 1 × Tiny Drum; 36 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_11.title: A Very Small Resident
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_11.purpose: Try a miniature scene among ordinary furniture.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_h06_11.tip: Look up Custom Doll. The rewarded tool configures it; read the tool’s tooltip, then place the doll on a clear shelf. The objective does not judge the scene’s pose or appearance.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_01.title: Here Is Our Address
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_01.condition: Create your own settlement through its normal interface.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_01.tip: Open the native settlement controls and choose creation. Confirm the displayed bounds and price. Use its normal map tools for expansion; the quest does not pay territorial costs for you.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_01.reward: 48 × Stone Brick Layer; 8 × Oak Lantern; 4 × Farmer Salad; 64 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_01.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Here Is Our Address”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_street.title: There Is Room for You
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_street.condition: Place a bed, a wooden door, a lantern, a chest and a bell.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_street.purpose: Prepare the basic pieces of a residential street and shared supplies.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_street.tip: Place one of each listed item. Then inspect resident and storage controls: the settlement’s own system determines housing, food and comfort; five placements do not automatically prove those states.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_street.reward: 2 × Oak Dining Bench; 2 × Oak Table; 8 × Red Cushion; 48 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.title: Someone Calls It Home
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.condition: Register five residents in one settlement you own.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.purpose: Grow a settlement beyond a solitary building.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.tip: Use the normal resident registration and inspect that settlement’s list. Residents from different settlements do not add together; a second settlement is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.reward: 48 × Spruce Wall; 24 × Spruce Lattice; 12 × Oak Lantern; 4 × Oak Bench; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_town_10.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Someone Calls It Home”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_02.title: The First Customer
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_02.conditio: Sell an eligible shipment through the shipping box.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_02.purpose: See a real sale and its quoted price.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_02.tip: Check eligibility and price in the normal economy interface, put the goods in the Shipping Box and complete the sale. Merely placing items in the box is not enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_02.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “The First Customer”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_03.title: A Coin in the Hand
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_03.conditio: Successfully withdraw one of your own coins from the wallet as a physical item.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_03.purpose: Learn how your balance becomes cash.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_03.tip: Open Wallet and choose an available withdrawal of your own funds. A committed withdrawal counts once; the quest does not create coins.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_03.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Coin in the Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.title: Shake on It
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.conditio: Complete a purchase from an ordinary villager using the current currency.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.purpose: Try trading through the familiar trade window.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.tip: Choose an affordable villager offer and receive the goods. A committed purchase is required; browsing offers or offering food does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.reward: 1 × Bread Knife; 8 × Chocolate Glazed Cookie; 48 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_04.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Shake on It”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.title: Home, Piece by Piece
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.conditio: Buy an eligible building item through the normal market.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.purpose: Turn your own trading income into an improvement to the base.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.tip: Choose an affordable eligible block in the market and complete the purchase. The normal economy owns its price and delivery.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.reward: Choose one: 64 × Brick Layer, 64 × Stone Brick Layer, 64 × White Chalk; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_trade_05.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Home, Piece by Piece”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_housewarming.cond: Obtain a valid photograph, place an oak table and oak chair, craft a cake and play a real note on an instrument.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_housewarming.purp: Bring furnishing, craft and a small personal story together.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_housewarming.tip: Complete the actions in any order, including before earlier recommendations. The photograph needs an image, the cake must be taken from the crafting grid and the instrument must play a note. No beauty score or other player is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_home_housewarming.rewa: 6 × High-Sensitivity Color Film; 12 × Glass Photograph Frame; 16 × Sakura Paper Lantern; Choose one: 1 × Piano, 1 × Handpan, 1 × Vielle; 180 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_painting.con: Create a cave painting using charcoal on smooth limestone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_painting.pur: Cave painting leaves your own marks in a shelter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_painting.tip: Smelt the ancient limestone and decorate its smooth surface with charcoal. This is a native surface transformation, not merely hanging a normal painting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_painting.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Charcoal Memory”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_personal_touch.co: Change a placed Counter top using supported wood or stone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_personal_touch.pu: Make furniture fit your home; shelves and cushions immediately offer two more furnishing options.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_personal_touch.ti: Furniture is configurable: a Hammer changes supported shapes, cushion/sheet changes a fancy bed, and a plate displays an inserted item. Start by committing a real countertop material change.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_personal_touch.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Make It Yours”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_joinery.title: Hammer It Home
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_joinery.condition: Change a Frame center support and a Pallet layer with the building Hammer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_joinery.purpose: Change construction details without replacing the palette; frames and beams continue that style.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_joinery.tip: Target the actual detail: frames, balustrades, columns, ladders, supports, mouldings and hooks expose variants; some use sneak-Hammer. Punching a frame removes its center.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_joinery.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Hammer It Home”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_planters.title: Room to Grow
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_planters.conditio: Dress a Lattice with supported foliage and fill an Urn with dirt.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_planters.purpose: Use reversible planted decorations; lattices and supports help furnish a courtyard or greenhouse.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_planters.tip: Shears clear the lattice; a shovel empties the urn. These reversible decorations do not pretend the urn is a crop farm.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_planters.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Room to Grow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_hanging_lights.co: Hang a light strand between two valid attachments and adjust its slack.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_hanging_lights.pu: Fit lighting to the room; nightstands and glowstone support your next cozy arrangement.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_hanging_lights.ti: Use the hanging-light item on first and second faces/fasteners. String increases slack, a stick reduces it; empty-hand interaction toggles lights. The recipe selects sequence, straightness and twinkling.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_hanging_lights.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Across the Room”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_secret_signal.con: Emit native redstone with a Secret Button and a chain-linked Lantern Button.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_secret_signal.pur: Integrate controls into architecture; two button pairs support a working concealed entrance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_secret_signal.tip: A Secret Button matches the wall; a Lantern Button outputs at the chain top. Other types: alarm sounds, falling-material single-use, arrow-hit activation and Sticky Copper toggle.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_secret_signal.rew: 2 × Bookshelf Secret Button; 2 × Lantern Button; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_secret_signal.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Press Where?”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_restore.title: Back to Its Old Self
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_restore.condition: Repair cracked brickwork with Mortar and restore matching bark to a stripped log.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_restore.purpose: Restore an aging home rather than replace every material; a cupboard and wax help preserve its next corner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_restore.tip: Keep bark from stripping. Mortar repairs cracks; wax preserves rustable iron and flint-and-steel removes moss. Learn material behavior instead of collecting every aged variant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_restore.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Back to Its Old Self”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_quirky_corner.con: Store an item in a Vintage Cash Register and toggle a Copper Light.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_quirky_corner.pur: Try functional curiosities in decor; sacks and a side table furnish your own small shop corner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_quirky_corner.tip: The register is decorative storage, not currency processing. A normal Copper Light is controllable; the shoddy one flickers. Sacks and pots can form decorative stacks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_quirky_corner.rew: 4 × Burlap Sack; 1 × Oak Side Table; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_quirky_corner.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Curious Corner”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.title: One More Swing
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.condition: Assemble a rideable swing and change its amplitude while riding.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.purpose: Build an interactive resting place; ropes and a bench support your next courtyard.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.tip: Double-rope anchors share a height and lower ends connect through seats. Forward adds amplitude, backward reduces it; timed dismount preserves momentum. A Moon Seat supports its separate single-rope design.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.reward: 8 × Fabric Swing Rope; 1 × Oak Bench; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_swing.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “One More Swing”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_toy_story.title: Toying Around
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_toy_story.conditi: Open a genuine lottery gift box for a doll and adjust a placed doll with the Tweaks Tool.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_toy_story.purpose: Learn toy acquisition and adjustment; cupboards and shelves display the dolls you actually obtained.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_toy_story.tip: Use a diamond token at the lottery machine; each gift box yields its pool doll. Computer+wool creates a player doll. The tool changes scale, position and rotation; Shift speeds it, Ctrl makes it finer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_toy_story.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Toying Around”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_play_music.title: Play It Your Way
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_play_music.condit: Play a bundled melody and a keyboard-mode note on an instrument.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_play_music.purpos: Move from opening an instrument to performing; a triangle expands the sound and chairs seat listeners.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_play_music.tip: The instrument screen provides search, favorites, pause and MIDI track choice. Custom .midi/.abc uses its native drop zone or melody directory+refresh; server upload permissions apply and importing is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_play_music.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Play It Your Way”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.title: Hold That Moment
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.condi: Load film into a Camera and expose a real frame.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.purpo: Start real photography; black-and-white film and paper carry the workflow toward your first prints.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.tip: Sneak-use for attachments, insert film and enter the viewfinder. Controls include shutter, guides, spyglass lens, flash and timer; film labeling keeps rolls organized.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.rewar: 2 × Black and White Film; 12 × Paper; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_first_frame.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Hold That Moment”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_real_print.title: Light on Paper
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_real_print.condit: Develop black-and-white film and print one real Photograph in a Lightroom.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_real_print.purpos: Turn a negative into physical memory; frames and paper support a small home exhibition.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_real_print.tip: Black-and-white developing uses a Water Bottle. Supply developed film, paper and required materials at the Lightroom, with sufficient overhead light. Native frame_printed proves printing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_real_print.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Light on Paper”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_color_print.title: Color That Lasts
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_color_print.condi: Expose, develop and print a real color frame.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_color_print.purpo: Learn the distinct color workflow; fresh film and an album preserve your next journey.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_color_print.tip: Color developing uses Awkward, Thick and Mundane potions. Printing uses cyan, magenta and yellow dyes. High-sensitivity film trades extra brightness for noise.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_color_print.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Color That Lasts”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.title: Three Colors, One World
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.conditi: Complete a Chromatic Photograph from red, green and blue channel exposures.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.purpose: Reconstruct an image by channels; glass frames display the result and color film enables more experiments.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.tip: Expose through the three matching glass filters. Put Tinted Glass above the Lightroom, choose Chromatic mode and reuse one Chromatic Sheet through all three prints.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.reward: 2 × Glass Photograph Frame; 2 × Color Film; 200 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chromatic.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Three Colors, One World”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_remote_frame.cond: Expose a real frame from a stand-mounted camera using timer or redstone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_remote_frame.purp: Photograph from a separate viewpoint and appear in the scene; film and frames support a group portrait.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_remote_frame.tip: Mount and position the camera. A nearby player must supply the rendered view; Auto flash uses the camera-position lighting threshold.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_remote_frame.rewa: 2 × Black and White Film; 2 × Photograph Frame; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_remote_frame.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Photographer Too”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_album.title: A Story Bound
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_album.condition: Add your own photograph and text to a Photo Album, then sign it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_album.purpose: Finish a photographed story; a spare album and shelves prepare the next volume.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_album.tip: Signing makes the album uneditable, so review pages first. Display it on a Lectern. Prints can also be stacked and opened in the detailed zoomable viewer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_album.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Story Bound”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.title: A Clean Chimney
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.condition: Clean a sooty Chimney with an axe and toggle its smoke.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.purpose: Maintain smoky architecture; extra chimneys and chimes furnish a lively roofline.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.tip: Scrape soot with an axe for a possible Black Dye drop. Empty hand toggles smoke; redstone suppresses it. Stacking another section creates signal-style smoke.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.reward: 4 × Brick Chimney; 1 × Bamboo Wind Chime; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chimney.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Clean Chimney”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.title: A Different Chime
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.condition: Carve Bamboo Wind Chimes with an axe and hang the carved result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.purpose: Change the sound of hanging decor; copper chimes and a nightstand add texture to a quiet corner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.tip: An axe creates the carved bamboo variant with a deeper sound. Hanging chimes add ambience; phantom deterrence depends on actual configuration and is not a requirement.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.reward: 1 × Copper Wind Chime; 1 × Oak Nightstand; 60 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_chime.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Different Chime”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_copper_sort.title: A Copper Caretaker
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_copper_sort.condi: Summon a Copper Golem and let it complete an item transport from a Copper Chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_copper_sort.purpo: Demonstrate genuine golem storage help; a barrel and honeycomb expand and preserve the storage area.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_copper_sort.tip: Use the native carved-pumpkin-on-copper assembly. Provide a Copper Chest and valid destination inventories; wax preserves chest oxidation. Random copper-button pressing is separate from sorting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_copper_sort.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Copper Caretaker”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_logistics.title: Take, Deposit, Restock
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_logistics.condit: Use Deposit to move an item into storage and Restock to replenish the backpack from storage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_logistics.purpos: Distinguish deposit from restock; upgrade bases and a barrel support your own transfer point.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_logistics.tip: Sneak-interact with the target inventory. Filters select transfer contents; Refill is a separate upgrade that maintains a selected player-inventory stack, with advanced slot targeting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_logistics.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Take, Deposit, Restock”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_refill.title: Never an Empty Hand
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_refill.condition: Refill a selected player-inventory stack from the backpack using Refill.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_refill.purpose: Maintain a working stack without manual shuffling; an upgrade base and alloy support the next build.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_refill.tip: Consume a selected item/block and let the upgrade transfer real stock from the backpack. Advanced Refill adds precise slot targeting and middle-click block picking; it creates no items.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_refill.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Never an Empty Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_filter_void.cond: Configure a transfer filter and void one deliberately selected disposable item.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_filter_void.purp: Separate useful stock from deliberately disposable junk; a filter and storage base expand safe sorting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_filter_void.tip: Use one cheap isolated exemplar. Allow/reject and advanced component checks differ; Void destroys permanently. Magnet attracts from range, whereas Pickup collects on contact.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_filter_void.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep the Good Stuff”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_processing.title: A Pocket Workshop
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_processing.condi: Finish one native smelting, blasting or smoking recipe in a backpack upgrade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_processing.purpo: Process materials while traveling; the Stonecutter tab opens precise building-part cutting and sheets support new equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_processing.tip: Choose the appropriate furnace tab and supply fuel. Auto versions pull/push according to settings. Stonecutter, anvil and smithing tabs keep their own recipes and costs rather than acting as universal processing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_processing.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Pocket Workshop”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.title: A Tighter Fit
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.conditio: Compact items with Compacting and increase real slot capacity with a normal Stack Upgrade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.purpose: Distinguish compacting from capacity; Advanced Filter refines content control and a storage base supports the home branch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.tip: Basic Compacting handles supported 2×2 recipes; advanced also handles 3×3. Stack changes capacity rather than creating material; conversion recipes upgrade an existing upgrade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.reward: 1 × Advanced Filter Upgrade; 1 × Upgrade Base; 140 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compact.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Tighter Fit”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_food_medicine.co: Let a backpack Feeding Upgrade actually restore hunger using eligible stored food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_food_medicine.pu: Let supplies care for the player; Advanced Feeding refines feeding timing and chocolate prepares the next outing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_food_medicine.ti: Filters and hunger thresholds control feeding. Alchemy separately uses potions, effect-food or milk; advanced filters effects. This does not imply villagers can eat from every backpack.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_food_medicine.re: 1 × Advanced Feeding upgrade; 6 × Bar of Chocolate; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_food_medicine.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Packed with Care”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.title: Liquid Reserves
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.condition: Move fluid between a backpack Tank and a real container using Pump.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.purpose: Prove real fluid transfer; Advanced Pump opens hand-container/world handling and precise filtering.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.tip: Tank replaces part of item storage with fluid capacity. Pump handles adjacent blocks; advanced also supports hand containers, world fluid and filtering. Check compatibility before mixing fluids.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.reward: 1 × Advanced Pump Upgrade; 8 × Fluid Pipe; 140 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fluids.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Liquid Reserves”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.title: Experience in Reserve
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.conditi: Transfer real experience between yourself and a supported tank using XP Pump.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.purpose: Store and recover your own experience; upgrade bases expand equipment and experience nuggets add a modest reserve.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.tip: XP Pump uses its supported tank and experience-target settings. Battery is separate: stores energy and supplies compatible items when a real consumer exists; no electrical mod is assumed.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.reward: 2 × Upgrade Base; 8 × Nugget of Experience; 150 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_xp_power.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Experience in Reserve”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.title: The Right Tool
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.condition: Let Tool Swapper select an effective tool from the backpack.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.purpose: Select tools for actual work; Advanced Tool Swapper adds filters and wrench selection, with a wrench providing an immediate example.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.tip: Store tools and begin a supported native target interaction. Advanced adds filters and a bound control for wrench-like tools; configure key conflicts rather than bypassing them.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.reward: 1 × Advanced Tool Swapper Upgrade; 1 × Wrench; 125 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_tools.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Right Tool”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_nested.title: A Pocket in a Pocket
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_nested.condition: Install Inception and place one permitted backpack inside another.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_nested.purpose: Use permitted nesting without cycles; bases and packing tape help organize a larger move.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_nested.tip: Inception permits nesting within native configured limits. Everlasting separately protects the backpack item from destruction/despawn; never sacrifice valuables into the void to test it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_nested.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Pocket in a Pocket”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_linked_wall.cond: Link two storages to a Controller and verify real shared item access.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_linked_wall.purp: Verify shared access to real containers; barrels and connectors expand the working storage wall.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_linked_wall.tip: Storage Tool links/unlinks blocks; connectors extend supported geometry. Locks, slot memory, sorting and count/tier/upgrade overlays are distinct settings. Verify actual item access, not only a link line.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_linked_wall.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “One Wall of Storage”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fixed_upgrades.c: Tier-up a real storage Barrel or Chest while preserving its contents.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fixed_upgrades.p: Expand storage while preserving contents; a normal Stack Upgrade adds capacity and tape supports later filled-container relocation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fixed_upgrades.t: Basic Tier upgrades supported vanilla storage; copper/iron/gold/diamond/netherite conversions expand slots according to installed recipes. Packing Tape relocates filled storage under native rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fixed_upgrades.r: 1 × Stack Upgrade Tier 1; 2 × Packing Tape; 140 XP.
