jem.atlas.card.v3_store_fixed_upgrades.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Storage Grows Up”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compression.cond: Use Compression in a supported Limited Barrel with a valid material chain.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compression.purp: Learn dense material storage; Advanced Hopper connects it to selected sides of neighboring machinery.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compression.tip: Compression connects compatible material forms across Limited Barrel slots; Compacting crafts a compressed item and Stack increases capacity. These are distinct functions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compression.rewa: 1 × Advanced Hopper Upgrade; 8 × Iron Sheet; 170 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_compression.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Storage Density”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_portable_music.c: Play a real Music Disc through a backpack or storage Jukebox Upgrade.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_portable_music.p: Let storage or a backpack genuinely play a disc; shelves and a base furnish the listening area.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_portable_music.t: Insert a disc into the native tab. Advanced supports more discs and playback modes; instrument melodies are a separate system.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_portable_music.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Sound Investment”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_cables.title: Storage Around the Corner
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_cables.condition: Connect a distant inventory by cable and retrieve its item through the network terminal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_cables.purpose: Reach storage beyond one wall; cables and trims extend the network you demonstrated.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_cables.tip: Cables join Cable Connectors; the network needs an Inventory Connector. Trims bridge nearby sections and a Proxy exposes its pointed inventory face.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_cables.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Storage Around the Corner”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_network_filter.c: Configure a network input filter and demonstrate accepted and rejected item types.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_network_filter.p: Verify the rule through real transfers; a spare filter and connectors support a separate network branch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_network_filter.t: Multi-item filters compare type/damage/data, tag filters match groups, polymorphic accepts existing types. Priority chooses storage and keep-last retains an exemplar; Inventory Hopper imports/exports.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_network_filter.r: 1 × Item Filter; 4 × Inventory Cable Connector; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_network_filter.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Store by the Rules”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_level_signal.con: Make a Level Emitter change redstone output when stored count crosses its configured threshold.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_level_signal.pur: Turn stored count into a control signal; hoppers and electron tubes help attach the next supply line.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_level_signal.tip: Select item, threshold and above/below mode; insert or remove actual stock. This reports network contents rather than generating items.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_level_signal.rew: 2 × Basic Inventory Hopper; 4 × Electron Tube; 125 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_store_level_signal.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Enough Is Enough”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_map_gallery.title: A World on the Wall
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_map_gallery.condit: Put a filled terrain map into an Item Frame.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_map_gallery.purpos: Extra frames and shelves support a home gallery of traveled routes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_map_gallery.tip: Explore with the map first. A framed map can show terrain in 3D; sneak-use opens its slice, height and mode options. Display quality is a separate client setting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_map_gallery.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A World on the Wall”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_snow_garden.cond: Snow-cover a compatible fence or wall without replacing it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_snow_garden.purp: Lights and wreaths complete a winter corner around the snow-covered shapes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_snow_garden.tip: Cold forests may accumulate snow beneath canopies. Supported shapes coexist with snow; use native shovel scraping. Depth and melting depend on server settings.
jem.atlas.card.v3_world_snow_garden.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A White Blanket”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supply.title: The Common Table
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supply.condition: Link physical storage to your town and enable it as a resident food source.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supply.purpose: Salads immediately stock the authorized food supply for the resident-feeding lesson.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supply.tip: In your town screen, link an accessible chest or supported physical storage and enable feeding. Foreign storage cannot be claimed; a virtual terminal alone does not prove physical access.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supply.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Common Table”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supper.title: Fed and Content
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supper.condition: Have a registered resident actually eat a safe meal from authorized food storage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supper.purpose: Different safe meals support continued resident diet care.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supper.tip: Stock suitable food and leave a real access route. Variety and desired dishes affect quality; harmful meals worsen state. Food sitting in a chest is not proof the resident ate.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_supper.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fed and Content”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_roof_and_work.con: Give one registered working-age resident an accessible roofed bed and valid workplace.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_roof_and_work.pur: Lanterns, a table and chairs support the occupied street around actual housing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_roof_and_work.tip: A bed belongs to a specific resident; leaves are not a roof. Profession, job site and actual route must agree. One workplace does not serve every resident.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_roof_and_work.rew: 8 × Oak Lantern; 2 × Oak Table; 4 × Oak Chair; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_roof_and_work.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Address and a Calling”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.title: A Street with Character
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.condition: Reach at least 50 confirmed comfort in your occupied town.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.purpose: Lighting and greenery supplies help improve the street's remaining weak spots.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.tip: Connect actual homes with paths, light used streets and add greenery and peaceful animals. Empty purchased land is not comfort; sunlight is not street lighting. The interface identifies missing factors.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.reward: 16 × Oak Lantern; 6 × Terracotta Medium Pot; 2 × Lotus Flower; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_comfort.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Street with Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_kind_gesture.cond: Successfully pat a registered resident and have the native activity bonus accepted.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_kind_gesture.purp: Meals support ongoing care and cushions add home decoration options.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_kind_gesture.tip: Use the configured pat action near a visible resident. A permitted pat gives a personal temporary town activity bonus; repeating it while active neither stacks nor extends it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_kind_gesture.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Kindness without Words”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.title: Beyond the Fence
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.condition: Pay for one actual expansion of your town.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.purpose: Fences, paving and lights help develop the purchased extension.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.tip: Use native map/town expansion mode, review the boundary and price, then confirm. Server validates overlap, ownership, minimum quote and funds. Personal waypoints stay private.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.reward: 24 × Stone Fence; 64 × Stone Brick Layer; 8 × Oak Lantern; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_expand.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Beyond the Fence”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_first_income.cond: Receive your town's first positive happiness-income payment into its treasury.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_first_income.purp: Shelves and provisions support the functioning town without extra currency issuance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_first_income.tip: Income follows actual happiness of living registered residents over time. Funds enter the town treasury, not your pocket; inspect treasury and native withdrawal. Empty land and replayed requests create no income.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_first_income.rewa: 8 × Dark Oak Shelf; 12 × Roasted Chicken; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_first_income.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Town Gives Back”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_seasonal_gift.cond: Accept one genuine seasonal gift through the recipient confirmation flow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_seasonal_gift.purp: Seasonal decorations commemorate a consensual exchange without recreating anyone's gift.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_seasonal_gift.tip: During New Year, the sender uses /jem holiday gift <player> for a whole held stack; recipient accepts the shown UUID. Unaccepted gifts can be canceled. Escrow survives the holiday window. Do not share passwords or gift yourself.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_seasonal_gift.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “From Hand to Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_coin_deposit.cond: Deposit a real physical coin into your money account through the native exchange.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_coin_deposit.purp: Counters and a breadbox support a trading corner after learning physical coin circulation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_coin_deposit.tip: Review denomination and amount in the money interface. A successful deposit removes physical coins and credits the account; exchange preserves value while changing denominations. Replayed requests do not mint more money.
jem.atlas.card.v3_town_coin_deposit.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Weight of a Coin”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_decorative_tag.con: Craft a Decorative Tag using its effective recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_decorative_tag.pur: Tags and lamps demonstrate the value of the shared decorative component.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_decorative_tag.tip: The tag is a shared component for eligible decorative recipes. Open its uses in the recipe viewer; it is neither a summon item nor currency.
jem.atlas.card.v3_qol_decorative_tag.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Tag for Beauty”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_horned_helmet.co: Attach a Goat Horn to a helmet in an anvil and take the decorated result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_horned_helmet.pu: Personalize equipment through the working native route while preserving current deer curation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_horned_helmet.ti: An ordinary Goat Horn works; disabled deer are unnecessary. Combine helmet and horn in an anvil; slot order chooses the decoration side. The other side can be decorated later. This is cosmetic, not extra armor.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_horned_helmet.re: 1 × Banner Pattern; 6 × Thrown Bottle o' Enchanting; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_seedtime.title: Buried Lunch
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_seedtime.conditio: Plant barley, oats, a tomato or lettuce crop.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_seedtime.purpose: One planting starts a useful little garden.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_seedtime.tip: Hoe soil near water, then plant seeds. The reward adds new crops to your patch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_seedtime.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Buried Lunch”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_ripe_pickings.con: Break one fully grown tomato or lettuce crop.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_ripe_pickings.pur: Harvest a mature plant instead of buying its produce.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_ripe_pickings.tip: Wait until the crop is mature. Replant afterwards; right-click harvesting is convenient for later crops.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_ripe_pickings.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ripe for Picking”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_05.title: The Garden Forecast
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_05.purpose: Plan your planting before the weather changes.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_05.tip: Find the Calendar recipe in JEI. Read crop tooltips for their seasons; no season change is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_05.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Garden Forecast”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_under_glass.title: Summer Under Glass
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_under_glass.condi: Harvest one mature crop protected by a working greenhouse roof.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_under_glass.purpo: Use greenhouse protection rather than merely carrying glass.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_under_glass.tip: Build an allowed glass roof above the crop within the season system’s configured greenhouse range. Winter is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_under_glass.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Summer Under Glass”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_07.title: A Season on a Wire
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_07.purpose: Seasonal information can become part of home automation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_07.tip: Use JEI for the sensor recipe. Wire a lamp to it and inspect its modes; the objective counts placement.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h01_07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Season on a Wire”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_new_furrow.title: Making Furrows
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_new_furrow.condit: Turn at least one soil block into farmland with a working Plow.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_new_furrow.purpos: Mechanization changes how the work is done.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_new_furrow.tip: Craft the Plow using JEI, then attach and lower it using its native controls. Actual tilling earns completion.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_new_furrow.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Making Furrows”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_dry_store.title: A Dry Store
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_dry_store.conditi: Collect completed Dried Wheat from a Silo.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_dry_store.purpose: Drying connects the garden to brewing.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_dry_store.tip: A Silo dries grain; JEI shows the Dried Wheat recipe. Collect the completed output, rather than placing an empty silo.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_dry_store.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Dry Store”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_01.title: Chop, Grind, Mix
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_01.condition: Place a Mincer and a Crafting Bowl.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_01.tip: JEI lists both stations and their products. The Mincer prepares ingredients; the bowl combines them.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_soup_on.title: Soup’s On!
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_soup_on.condition: Collect completed Potato Soup from a Cooking Pot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_soup_on.tip: Heat the pot, add the Potato Soup ingredients and prepare its serving container. JEI shows the pot-cooking recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_soup_on.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Soup’s On!”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_wok_first.title: That’s the Sizzle
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_wok_first.conditi: Cook and collect a Fried Egg from a Wok.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_wok_first.purpose: Learn frying through a finished dish.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_wok_first.tip: Heat the Wok, use oil and a Spatula, then collect the finished food. The wok recipe view shows Fried Eggs.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_wok_first.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “That’s the Sizzle”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_lid_on.title: Keep a Lid on It
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_lid_on.condition: Cook and collect Beef Noodles from a Stockpot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_lid_on.purpose: Move from frying to soups and simmering.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_lid_on.tip: Make a Stockpot and its lid. Follow the Beef Noodle recipe for its base, heat and ingredients.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_lid_on.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep a Lid on It”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_recipe_memory.con: Record a nonempty Wok or Stockpot recipe in a Recipe Book.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_recipe_memory.pur: A recorded recipe makes a favorite dish easier to repeat.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_recipe_memory.tip: Use a Recipe Book on a suitable station. A real saved recipe is required; clicking an empty pot is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_recipe_memory.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Written on a Napkin”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_steam_rises.title: Full Steam Ahead
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_steam_rises.condi: Cook and collect Mantou from a Steamer.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_steam_rises.tip: Set the Steamer over suitable heat and close its top. Find Mantou in JEI’s steaming category.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_steam_rises.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Full Steam Ahead”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_turning_roast.con: Collect a completed edible portion from a Shawarma Spit.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_turning_roast.pur: Learn controlled roasting as a separate technique.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_turning_roast.tip: Use the Spit’s native redstone controls; stop it before collecting a finished portion. Raw input does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_turning_roast.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Spit Turns”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_bread_rises.title: Rise and Dine
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_bread_rises.condi: Bake and collect Bread from a Stove.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_bread_rises.purpo: Turn grain into finished baked food.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_bread_rises.tip: Use JEI to prepare flour and dough, then follow the Stove bread recipe. Bought bread does not replace baking.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_bread_rises.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Rise and Dine”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_04.title: A Slice for Everyone
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_04.condition: Place one of the listed cakes or pies.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_04.tip: Follow the chosen cake’s recipe, then place it on a table. Placement earns completion; table decoration is your choice.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_04.reward: 1 × Cake Display; 2 × Tray; 4 × Strawberry Cupcake; 48 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_04.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Slice for Everyone”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_14.title: A Cultured Hobby
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_14.purpose: Fermentation belongs in the kitchen too.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_14.tip: Put milk in a cauldron, add a brown mushroom, let it mature and collect the cheese with a bucket. The objective checks the finished bucket.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_14.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Cultured Hobby”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_15.title: Dinner Comes Round
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_15.purpose: Combine familiar ingredients into food for the table.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h02_15.tip: Cheese and dough lead to Pizza; JEI shows the recipe. After placing it, try its allowed toppings and portions.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_01.title: A Bunch of Promise
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_01.purpose: Start a vineyard with a small bunch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_01.tip: Vines need suitable supports. Look for ordinary vines in the world; regional varieties also come from a winemaker or their native regions.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_01.reward: 4 × Red Grape Seeds; 4 × White Grape Seeds; 8 × Wine Bottle; 24 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Bunch of Promise”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_grape_stomp.title: Better by Foot
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_grape_stomp.condi: Bottle grape juice you have finished stomping.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_grape_stomp.tip: Put one grape variety in a Grapevine Pot, stomp it into juice and bottle it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_grape_stomp.rewar: 16 × Wine Bottle; 2 × Big Oak Wine Bottle Storage; 48 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_grape_stomp.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Better by Foot”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_vintage.con: Collect completed Red Wine from a Fermentation Barrel.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_vintage.pur: Turn juice into a finished drink.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_vintage.tip: Place a Fermentation Barrel and load Red Wine’s juice, ingredients and bottles. No years-long bottle aging is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_vintage.rew: 2 × Big Dark Cherry Wine Rack; 16 × Wine Bottle; 64 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_vintage.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fit for the Table”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_apple_press.title: Under Apple Pressure
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_apple_press.condi: Collect completed Apple Juice from an Apple Press.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_apple_press.tip: The Press uses apples and a container; consult its native help and recipe. A completed pressing earns the objective.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_apple_press.rewar: 2 × Apple Tree Sapling; 8 × Wine Bottle; 48 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_apple_press.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Under Apple Pressure”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.title: Here’s to Variety
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.condition: Drink Red Wine and Jellie Wine.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.purpose: Choose a drink for its purpose.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.tip: JEI lists the wine recipes. Compare their listed effects; one bottle of each is enough, without aging.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.reward: 2 × Big Dark Cherry Wine Rack; Choose one: 2 × Aegis Wine, 2 × A Bottle of 'Creepers Crush', 2 × Eiswein; 64 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_05.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Here’s to Variety”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_07.title: Three Shades of Tea
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_07.condition: Obtain dried Green, Oolong and Black Tea leaves.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_07.purpose: One crop offers several processing stages.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_07.tip: Find a tea plant and dry its leaves to the desired stages. JEI shows the transitions; one of each is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Three Shades of Tea”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_kettle_sings.cond: Brew and collect Green Tea from a Tea Kettle.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_kettle_sings.purp: Turn processed leaves into a drink.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_kettle_sings.tip: You need water, heat, dried leaves and a serving container. JEI shows the Green Tea brewing recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_kettle_sings.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Kettle Sings”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_09.title: A Pocketful of Potions
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_09.condition: Drink a filled Flask containing real potion effects.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_09.purpose: Take a prepared effect with you.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_09.tip: Explore Herbal Infusion and the Brewing Cauldron: compatible potions can be combined in a Flask. An empty Flask does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_09.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Pocketful of Potions”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.title: A Frothy Tale
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.condit: Brew and collect Wheat Beer from a Wooden Brewingstation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.purpos: Connect farming and drying to a real brew.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.tip: Prepare hops, dried grain, water and heat according to the recipe; follow the brewing prompts and collect the drink with a Mug.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.reward: 4 × Bar Counter; 6 × Pretzel; 8 × Dried Barley; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_first_brew.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Frothy Tale”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_copper_spirit.con: Collect completed Highland Hearth whiskey from a Copper Brewingstation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_copper_spirit.pur: The next station opens more advanced production.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_copper_spirit.tip: Upgrade the station and follow this whiskey’s JEI recipe. A purchased bottle does not replace brewing it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_copper_spirit.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Copper Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.title: One Last Toast
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.condit: Finish a brew in a Netherite Brewingstation and collect the completed drink.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.purpos: Demonstrate the advanced station in use.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.tip: Obtain the Netherite station yourself. Complete one recipe it supports; no specific quality roll or creature encounter is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.reward: 12 × Bar Counter; 12 × Pretzel; Choose one: 1 × Brewfest Regalia, 1 × Brewfest Dress; 200 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_brewmaster.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “One Last Toast”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_17.title: A Coconut Break
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_17.condition: Obtain a Coconut and drink one of the listed beach cocktails.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_17.purpose: Relax with another way to prepare drinks.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h03_17.tip: Coconuts come from palms; cocktails are made at the Palm Bar. The recipes show the ingredients; a beach location is optional.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_02.title: Fishy Advice
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_02.condition: Right-click in the air with a Fishy Note.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_02.purpose: Read the conditions before a longer fishing trip.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_02.tip: JEI shows the Note’s recipe. Use it to look up the time, depth, temperature and weather for a catch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_02.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fishy Advice”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_01.title: Got a Bite!
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_01.condition: Catch a Cod, Salmon or Bluegill with a fishing rod.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_01.purpose: Start fishing with a real ordinary catch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_01.tip: Use an available fishing-system rod; the ordinary vanilla rod is disabled in this pack. Catch the fish yourself rather than buying it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Got a Bite!”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_03.title: Tackle to Taste
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_03.tip: The table changes a rod’s hook, line, bait and bobber. Find its recipe in JEI and assemble the tackle you want.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_03.reward: 1 × Copper Line; 1 × Golden Line; 16 × Bait; 40 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_04.title: The Fish Forecast
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_04.condition: Obtain a Pocket Watch, Climate Gauge, Depth Meter and Weather Radio.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_04.purpose: Prepare to seek special fishing conditions.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_04.tip: Each instrument explains a different condition. JEI lists their recipes; they need not be obtained at the same moment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_04.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Fish Forecast”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_05.title: It Was This Big
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_05.purpose: Keep a memory of a good fishing trip.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_05.tip: JEI shows the display recipe. Put your favorite catch on show; filling it is optional for completion.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_07.title: Live Delivery
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_07.condition: Obtain a Cod Bucket, Salmon Bucket or Bluegill Bucket.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_07.purpose: Move a living fish as an alternative to eating it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_07.tip: Bucket a supported live fish; only the pack’s configured conversions work. Release it into a pond after completion if you wish.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_07.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Live Delivery”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_09.title: A Hot Bite
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_09.purpose: Use a special hook in a new fishing environment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_09.tip: Fit a Lavaproof Hook at the Angling Table first. Check the Mackerel’s journal conditions and fish in lava from a safe bank.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_09.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Hot Bite”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_10.title: A Bite from Nowhere
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_10.purpose: Apply advanced tackle to an unusual catch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_10.tip: Fit a Hook of the Depths and follow the fish’s journal conditions. Dimension access follows the normal game progression.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_10.reward: 24 × Abyss Bait; 1 × Hook of the Depths; 160 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_10.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Bite from Nowhere”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_11.title: Scales of Gold
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_11.purpose: Overcome the native rarity of a legendary catch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_11.tip: The current fishing journal lists its exact conditions. Only a real catch counts; an acquired fish item does not.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_11.reward: 1 × Netherite Fishing Rod; 32 × Lucky Bait; 240 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_12.title: A Rod from a Tale
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_12.purpose: Complete your own legendary fishing progression.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_12.tip: Its late recipe is tied to the corresponding catch; inspect it in JEI. The questbook awards neither a Midas Fish nor this rod.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_h04_12.reward: 1 × Enchanted Pocket Watch; 2 × Diamond Line; 32 × Magnetic Bait; Choose one: 1 × Enchanted Golden Apple Bobber, 1 × Netherite Bobber, 1 × Pearl Bobber; 320 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_nether_taste.cond: Eat Blaze Soup or a Nether Fries Platter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_nether_taste.purp: Discover the prepared cuisine of another dimension.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_nether_taste.tip: These are prepared foods from the Nether cooking branch; JEI shows their actual recipes. Raw ingredients and inedible items do not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_nether_taste.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Taste of Fire”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_end_taste.title: The End Aftertaste
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_end_taste.conditi: Eat Chorus Flower Cake or drink Ender Mint Tea.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_end_taste.tip: Both use End resources; JEI shows their recipes. Reaching the End keeps the campaign’s normal access requirements.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_end_taste.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “The End Aftertaste”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_good_meal.title: Well Fed, Well Prepared
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_good_meal.conditi: Eat a prepared dish that actually activates a food blessing.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_good_meal.purpose: Use food quality as preparation for an activity.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_good_meal.tip: Read the dish-quality tooltip. Choose food that grants a blessing; eating the same dish again too soon may not refresh it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_good_meal.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Well Fed, Well Prepared”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_variety.title: More Than Bread
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_variety.condition: Activate the variety bonus by eating five different eligible foods within one hour of playtime.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_variety.purpose: A varied menu has its own practical benefit.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_variety.tip: The food-variety system determines eligible foods. Repeats do not fill different slots; this grants a small movement bonus and is not a mandatory diet.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_variety.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “More Than Bread”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_feast.title: Dinner Is Served!
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_feast.condition: Complete pot soup, wok frying, stockpot cooking, steaming and bread baking, and activate a prepared-food blessing.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_feast.purpose: Five different techniques turn a garden into a complete kitchen.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_feast.tip: This kitchen finale uses the neighboring technique milestones, in any order. It does not require every wine, a legendary fish or End cuisine.
jem.atlas.card.v2_food_feast.reward: 4 × Chocolate Box; 4 × Tray; 4 × Toolrack; Choose one: 1 × Caking Station, 1 × Stockpot, 1 × Copper Tea Kettle; 240 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_gummy_alchemy.con: Collect Jelly Beans matching a potion fed to a Gummy Bear.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_gummy_alchemy.pur: A Gummy Bear turns potion effects into another portable form.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_gummy_alchemy.tip: Feed the bear a potion, let it hibernate and provide Licoroot after waking. Matching-color Sweetish Fish breed bears; feeding without resulting beans does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_gummy_alchemy.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Dream Filling”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_venison_table.co: Prepare and eat one dish from local game.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_venison_table.pu: Local game expands a varied expedition diet.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_venison_table.ti: Elk retaliate rather than acting as harmless targets; turkey and deer provide other meat routes. Use an available stew or pemmican recipe; antlers and buckskin have separate furnishing/equipment uses.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_venison_table.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “After the Woodland Trail”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_cassowary_orchar: Obtain pecked petrified-fruit seeds and grow one exotic fruit.
A pecked fruit can start your own exotic orchard.
Retrieve petrified fruit from cassowary nests and offer it to the bird. Kiwano grows at ground level; litchi and starfruit form small trees, each with growth stages. One chosen fruit is enough.
24 × Bone Meal; 3 × Thorny Acacia Sapling; 130 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Fruit From Stone”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_fritter_and_thor: Prepare and eat an Apple Fritter; grow Thorny Acacia from a sapling.
A new recipe and tree connect cooking with landscaping.
Follow the fritter recipe. Thorny Acacia grows on Savanna Plateaus with orange leaves and trunk thorns; grow your own in a safe place.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Sweet and Thorny”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_garden.title: A Garden Below
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_garden.condi: Collect Fiddlehead after Grottoceratops feeding and grow Thornwood with Fertilizer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_garden.purpo: Caring for cave plants creates a renewable material source.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_garden.tip: Grottoceratops eats Curly Fern and yields Fiddlehead; Tree Stars breed it. Process Guano into Fertilizer for plants including Thornwood. Charcoal can decorate smooth limestone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_cave_garden.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Garden Below”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_wild_kitchen.cond: Prepare and eat one specialty: Deep Sea Sushi, Vesper Stew or Mosquito Repellent Stew.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_wild_kitchen.purp: Special meals provide useful preparation for dangerous outings.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_wild_kitchen.tip: Combine deep fish into sushi, cook Vesper Wings into stew or use Triops eggs for mosquito-repellent stew. Toss carrots to both Triops parents; eggs can also hatch. One chosen dish is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_wild_kitchen.rewa: 6 × Deep Sea Sushi Roll; 2 × Straw Basket; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_wild_kitchen.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Unexpected Meal”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.title: Lunch in Reserve
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.conditi: Fill a Sack of Sating and let it feed you automatically.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.purpose: A filled sack supports eating without constant item switching.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.tip: Obtain Sweet Tooth from Gum Worm for the sack. Drag food onto it; it stores hunger value and spends its reserve when the carrier is hungry. An empty finished sack alone does not complete this.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.reward: 8 × Cooked Dinosaur Chop; 6 × Deep Sea Sushi Roll; 140 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_sack_food.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Lunch in Reserve”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_hunger_guard.title: Protection Wants Seconds
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_hunger_guard.condi: Eat Void Squid and trigger its native protection when your food reserve reaches zero
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_hunger_guard.purpo: Marine meals replenish the very food reserve on which the learned protective effect depends.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_hunger_guard.tip: Keep the acquired protective effect until it genuinely triggers with an empty hunger bar. A separate native protection handler spends food while reserves remain, while the zero-food branch supplies native invulnerability
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_hunger_guard.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Protection Wants Seconds”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.title: Ginger for Walls
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.condi: Turn cultivated Ginger into a real gingerbread building part.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.purpo: Frosted gingerbread and white lights turn the first crop into a distinctive festive building.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.tip: Find Wild Ginger in Sparse Jungle, cultivate it and use gingerbread blocks, doors or stairs as building materials, not just food.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.rewar: 24 × Frosted Gingerbread; 12 × White Glow Lights; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_ginger_house.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ginger for Walls”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knead_and_grind.c: Grind grain in a Mincer and make Dough in a Crafting Bowl.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knead_and_grind.p: Connect the harvest to dough and ingredient preparation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knead_and_grind.t: Put suitable grain in the Mincer and hold right-click. Add the dough recipe ingredients to the bowl and stir with an empty hand.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knead_and_grind.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “From Grain to Dough”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_soil.title: Working Soil
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_soil.condi: Hydrate farmland with a Sprinkler and successfully use Compost or Pitchfork-worked Fertilized Soil on a growing crop.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_soil.purpo: Support crop growth with working soil and irrigation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_soil.tip: A Sprinkler waters neighboring farmland. Compost and fertilized soil have native usage rules; a large onion or lettuce is a possible continuation, not a required random outcome.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_soil.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Working Soil”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_roaster.title: Nicely Browned
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_roaster.condition: Cook and collect Roasted Chicken from a Stove.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_roaster.tip: Put the ingredients and fuel in the Stove. Wait for the recipe to finish and take the cooked chicken from the output slot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_roaster.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Nicely Browned”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cake_workshop.con: Make a decorated cake, a cupcake and a cookie on a Caking Station.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cake_workshop.pur: Control manual baking and different serving forms.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cake_workshop.tip: Put Cake Dough on the station and add its topping. A knife cuts cupcake portions; a rolling pin opens the cookie branch. One completed product of each is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cake_workshop.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Rolling Success”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_small_kitchen.con: Draw water from a Kitchen Sink and cook one meal in a Small Cooking Pot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_small_kitchen.pur: Build a compact workspace with water and heat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_small_kitchen.tip: Interact with the sink’s lower half; containers fill according to its native rules. The Small Cooking Pot needs heat and the recipe’s serving container.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_small_kitchen.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Small Kitchen”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_brew_tasting.cond: Drink one brew you completed and successfully use a Breathalyzer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_brew_tasting.purp: Choose a brew by quality and effect while understanding intoxication.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_brew_tasting.tip: Choose a drink by its effect and quality. The Breathalyzer reports intoxication; blacking out and deliberately failing a brew are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_brew_tasting.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Know Your Measure”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_tea_jug.title: Three in a Jug
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_tea_jug.condition: Fill a Jug with at least two different supported teas and drink from it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_tea_jug.purpose: Combine tea effects in one portable serving.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_tea_jug.tip: A Jug accepts up to three different teas. It combines their native effects; a Flask follows a separate potion recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_tea_jug.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Three in a Jug”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.title: The Cellar Can Wait
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.condition: Store a finished wine bottle in a compatible rack and retrieve it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.purpose: Understand bottle storage and wine age without a long wait.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.tip: Check the rack’s accepted bottle size. Wine age affects some effects, while instant effects may not scale; no year-long wait is required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.reward: 3 × Big Dark Cherry Wine Rack; 8 × Wine Bottle; 56 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cellar.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Cellar Can Wait”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.title: An Orchard, Not a Log Pile
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.condition: Pick ripe fruit from apple or cherry leaves with an empty hand.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.purpose: Harvest repeatedly from a living tree.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.tip: Bone Meal speeds fruit growth. A full Winemaker outfit can save it at a durability cost; grape variety and vine state matter when choosing supports.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.reward: 2 × Apple Tree Sapling; 1 × Dark Cherry Sapling; 56 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_orchard.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Orchard, Not a Log Pile”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knife_board.title: A Fine Cut
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knife_board.condi: Collect the result of a real Chopping Board cutting recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knife_board.tip: Place food on the board and use a Kitchen Knife. Fat from suitable knife-killed animals opens an oil route, but killing a pet is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_knife_board.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Fine Cut”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_mill_noodles.cond: Mill grain with an animal-powered Millstone and make Raw Noodles from dough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_mill_noodles.purp: Take animal-powered milling through to a kitchen ingredient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_mill_noodles.tip: A supported animal drives the mill; load grindable grain and collect flour. Native dough stretching or cutting produces noodles.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_mill_noodles.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Long Story”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_little_teapot.con: Prepare and serve a drink from a Teapot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_little_teapot.pur: Learn a teapot with its own fluid-and-ingredient sequence.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_little_teapot.tip: First add the supported full fluid portion, then the recipe ingredient. The processing pot cannot be picked up; extra fluid and the wrong order are rejected.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_little_teapot.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Particular Teapot”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lunch_bag.title: Lunch, with Extras
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lunch_bag.conditi: Eat from a loaded Transmutation Lunch Bag and receive at least one additional stored effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lunch_bag.purpose: Apply extra effects from a portable food supply.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lunch_bag.tip: This version has 16 slots. It consumes the first food or potion and can add effects sampled from up to three others; an extra effect can consume one additional item.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_lunch_bag.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Lunch, with Extras”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_nether_provisions: Eat an Everlasting Flame Steak and retain it after consumption.
Distinguish special foods' native utility from ordinary hunger restoration.
This food has its own consumption rule. Soul Return Rice relates to a death location, while star and fiery meals have other effects; choose using their native tooltips.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Food with a Twist”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_ghast_friend.cond: Equip a Ghast Pendant in a supported slot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_ghast_friend.purp: Use equipment that changes a particular encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_ghast_friend.tip: The Pendant changes Ghast hostility according to its native description. Use its supported chest or accessory slot; merely carrying it is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_ghast_friend.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Off the Ghast Menu”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_end_brushing.cond: Obtain a Void Conch or Dragon Dust by genuinely brushing a suspicious block.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_end_brushing.purp: Open End archaeology as a route to useful materials.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_end_brushing.tip: The Conch comes from suspicious End Stone and substitutes for Lapis Lazuli when enchanting. Dust comes from a suspicious Dragon Egg and serves as reusable Bone Meal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_end_brushing.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Excavation at the Edge”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cold_supplies.con: Mix a cocktail in a Palm Bar and collect a cooling result from a Mini Fridge.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cold_supplies.pur: Connect drink mixing with a separate cooling workstation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cold_supplies.tip: The Palm Bar mixes recipe ingredients. The Mini Fridge processes water and ice through its own recipes; it is a separate workstation, not merely a chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_cold_supplies.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Cool Planning”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_goal.title: A Goal in the Sand
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_goal.condit: Score a Beach Ball in a Beach Goal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_goal.purpos: Discover a working beach game rather than decoration alone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_goal.tip: Place the ball and push it by walking into it or right-clicking. A real goal triggers a firework; sneak-right-click collects the ball.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_goal.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Goal in the Sand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_treasure.co: Open a found Seashell and receive its contents.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_treasure.pu: Distinguish openable finds from ordinary beach decoration.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_treasure.ti: Collect shells from naturally generated beach blocks. A Message in a Bottle is a separate message/map find whose spawning depends on configuration.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_treasure.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Mail from the Sea”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.title: Keep Your Crocs Dry
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.condit: Sprint across the water surface while wearing Crocs.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.purpos: Try practical movement from beach equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.tip: Crocs have their own water-running condition. A Rubber Ring helps swimming but prevents diving; Swim Wings reduce fall damage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.reward: 1 × Swim Wings; 1 × Blue Rubber Ring; 56 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_beach_gear.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep Your Crocs Dry”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_thatch.title: A Roof in the Sun
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_thatch.condition: Dry a Wet Hay Bale into Thatch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_thatch.purpose: Use climate to make a building material.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_thatch.tip: Leave Wet Hay under open sky in a hot biome. An unsuitable climate returns ordinary hay; no full season needs to pass.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_thatch.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Roof in the Sun”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_context_tackle.co: Catch a fish with a Fiery, Permafrost or Twilight Hook fitted.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_context_tackle.pu: Change fishing conditions through actual tackle.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_context_tackle.ti: These hooks change water temperature or fish time preferences; lines help with fish movement and catch difficulty. Native fishing decides eligibility.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_context_tackle.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Hook Changes the Forecast”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fishing_crate.con: Fish up a native fishing crate and open it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fishing_crate.pur: Open contextual loot through real fishing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fishing_crate.tip: The catch context selects the available crate and its loot. One kind is enough; a crafted or gifted crate does not prove fishing it up.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fishing_crate.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Caught Some Timber”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fish_home.title: Swimming Home
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fish_home.conditi: Eat a Voidseeker and successfully return to your respawn point through its native effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fish_home.purpose: Use a special catch as a way to return home.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fish_home.tip: A native return must succeed; an unrelated teleport does not count. Another special catch, the Chasm Eel, interacts with bedrock only when the server explicitly allows it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_fish_home.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Swimming Home”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_catch_toolkit.con: Successfully freeze an eligible creature with an Enchanted Pocket Watch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_catch_toolkit.pur: Turn fishing-derived equipment into useful movement or control.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_catch_toolkit.tip: The watch respects forbidden targets. The Dragonfin Boots extra jump does not count for this goal. A Jelly Torch can be placed underwater for light.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_catch_toolkit.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Catch Can Do More”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_meal_choice.title: New Dish, New Plan
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_meal_choice.condi: While one food blessing is active, eat a different dish that replaces it with a new blessing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_meal_choice.purpo: Choose the active food traits for your next task.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_meal_choice.tip: Only one dish bundle is active. Quality I/II/III grants 1/2/3 traits for 2/3/4 minutes; read the current tooltip for exact traits rather than guessing from the food name.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_meal_choice.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “New Dish, New Plan”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.title: One Step Beyond
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.condit: Successfully use Void Walker on supported enchanted equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.purpos: Apply a late enchantment through its real function.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.tip: This is the End-cooking expansion’s enchantment, not a similarly named armor-set effect. Check its supported item and native rules; Void Assault and Void Echo are separate combat effects.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.reward: 1 × Hook of the Depths; 16 × Abyss Bait; 160 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_void_steps.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “One Step Beyond”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_catch.cond: Land a real catch that becomes a living entity through an enabled conversion.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_catch.purp: Distinguish a real living catch from a bucket-spawned creature.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_catch.tip: Only active fish-item/entity mappings qualify. Not every fish is supported; moving a supported catch in a bucket is a separate option.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_living_catch.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Alive at the Other End”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_harvest_again.con: Right-click harvest a supported mature crop and let it replant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_harvest_again.pur: Harvest supported crops without manually replanting them.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_harvest_again.tip: Use the hoe required by server settings, if any. Radius, hunger, experience and Fortune behavior depend on this server; no fixed area size is promised.
jem.atlas.card.v3_food_harvest_again.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Picked and Growing Again”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_taste.cond: Finish eating native Intestine from the flesh biome.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_taste.purp: Try one specific unusual food mechanic without a dish catalogue; bottles and chocolate support later preparation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_taste.tip: Obtain the actual Nether item and read its effect before eating. One serving is enough; no catalogue of strange foods is required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_taste.rewa: 4 × Glass Bottle; 4 × Bar of Chocolate; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_nether_taste.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Unusual Supper”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_01.con: Place a Water Wheel and a Shaft.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_01.pur: Bring motion into your first workshop; the wrench reward helps you rearrange it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_01.tip: Use the wheel’s Ponder scene to see the water arrangement. This first task checks placement; the next tasks ask for actual work.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_02.con: Carry a Cogwheel, a Large Cogwheel and Engineer’s Goggles.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_02.pur: Learn speed ratios and stress; a toolbox keeps the growing workshop portable.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_02.tip: A large/small gear pair changes speed. Wear the goggles to read the working components; possessing the three items completes this preparation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h11_02.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Gears in Your Head”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_press.title: Hot off the Press
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_press.condition: Produce an Iron Sheet with a powered Mechanical Press.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_press.purpose: Turn workshop motion into a useful building component; spare sheets support the next machines.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_press.tip: Feed an iron ingot to the press’s native work surface and power the press. Taking a found or gifted sheet does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_press.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Hot off the Press”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.title: The Daily Grind
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.condition: Produce Wheat Flour in a powered Millstone.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.purpose: Connect the workshop to the kitchen; chocolate is a useful workday snack.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.tip: Feed wheat into a powered Millstone. Collect the actual milled flour; no large harvest is required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.reward: 8 × Bar of Chocolate; 8 × Andesite Alloy; 65 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_mill.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Daily Grind”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_belt.title: Keep It Moving
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_belt.condition: Move an item on a powered Belt into an inventory through an Andesite Funnel.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_belt.purpose: Make materials travel without carrying every stack; the reward extends a proven line.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_belt.tip: Connect two compatible shafts with a Belt Connector. Put a funnel on the destination inventory and let a carried item enter it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_belt.reward: 8 × Mechanical Belt; 4 × Andesite Funnel; 4 × Chute; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fan.title: A Change of Air
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fan.condition: Finish one native washing recipe with an Encased Fan blowing through water.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fan.purpose: One air stream becomes a processing tool; extra shafts let you arrange separate workstations.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fan.tip: Use an installed washing recipe shown in JEI. The water belongs in the fan’s processing stream; a placed fan alone does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fan.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Change of Air”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_brass.title: A Touch of Brass
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_brass.condition: Make Brass Ingots in a heated Basin under a Mechanical Mixer.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_brass.purpose: Learn heat-dependent mixing; a modest brass reserve opens precision and filtering.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_brass.tip: Check the installed brass recipe: copper and zinc use a Basin, Mixer and fueled Blaze Burner. The quest checks a completed batch, not a loose ingot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_brass.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Touch of Brass”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_polish.title: A Little Elbow Grease
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_polish.condition: Finish polishing Rose Quartz with Sand Paper.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_polish.purpose: Make an electronic ingredient yourself; tubes reward the hand-finished step.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_polish.tip: Use the native sandpaper-polishing interaction with Rose Quartz. A found Polished Rose Quartz is useful, but does not prove polishing.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_filter.title: Only the Good Stuff
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_filter.condition: Let a configured Brass Funnel pass its selected item and reject a different item.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_filter.purpose: Filtering becomes a demonstrated rule rather than a component collection.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_filter.tip: Put a Filter on the funnel. Test a matching item and a nonmatching item; both observations belong to the same configured funnel.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_filter.reward: 4 × Brass Funnel; 2 × Brass Tunnel; 1 × Attribute Filter; 145 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_precision.title: Step by Step
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_precision.conditio: Complete the native Sequenced Assembly recipe for a Precision Mechanism.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_precision.purpose: Combine several operations into one product; the reward supports a second assembly station.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_precision.tip: Follow the installed sequence in JEI and return the intermediate item through every required step. Only the successful finished mechanism counts.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_precision.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Step by Step”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fluid.title: A Drop of Order
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fluid.condition: Move fluid through a Mechanical Pump and use a Spout to fill one compatible item.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fluid.purpose: Learn liquid handling through one small working line.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fluid.tip: Connect the pump to a real fluid source and a Spout. Choose a supported filling recipe in JEI; an empty tank or placed pipe does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_fluid.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Drop of Order”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_crafter.title: More Than Nine
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_crafter.condition: Complete one recipe using a connected Mechanical Crafter arrangement.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_crafter.purpose: Learn a larger recipe surface; extra brass supports your own pattern.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_crafter.tip: Arrange crafters to match a real recipe and point their arrows toward the output. Retrieve the completed result.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_crafter.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “More Than Nine”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_arm.title: An Extra Hand
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_arm.condition: Make a Mechanical Arm transfer an item between two configured endpoints.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_arm.purpose: Delegate a repeated transfer while retaining control of where things go.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_arm.tip: Select input and output before placing the arm, then supply rotation. A successful transfer between distinct endpoints completes the task.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_arm.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Extra Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_steam.title: Full Steam Ahead
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_steam.condition: Run a Steam Engine from a boiler with water supply and heat.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_steam.purpose: Learn the linked demands of heat, water and boiler size before scaling the factory.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_steam.tip: Follow the boiler Ponder scene. The native boiler must report active output and the attached engine must transmit nonzero rotation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_steam.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Full Steam Ahead”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.title: The Workshop Works
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.condition: Complete pressing, milling, washing and heated brass mixing yourself.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.purpose: Bring the first workshop techniques together; a symmetry tool rewards a proven production base.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.tip: The four named production milestones count in any order. This does not require every machine to share one network.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.reward: 1 × Wand Of Symmetry; 32 × Andesite Alloy; 260 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_workshop.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Workshop Works”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.title: Built to Move
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.condit: Assemble and move a Mechanical Bearing, Mechanical Piston or Gantry contraption.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.purpos: Make a construction change position; chassis and glue support the next moving project.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.tip: Use the native assembly control. Any one listed movement system is enough; a collection of three unused machines is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.reward: 1 × Super Glue; 8 × Linear Chassis; 8 × Radial Chassis; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_contraption.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Built to Move”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_harvest.title: A Field That Runs Itself
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_harvest.condition: Harvest a mature crop with a moving Mechanical Harvester and collect its output.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_harvest.purpose: Connect mechanical movement with the farm while leaving native harvesting balance intact.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_harvest.tip: Mount the harvester on a working contraption facing a mature supported crop. Its native harvesting operation must succeed.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_harvest.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Field That Runs Itself”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_drill.title: Rough Around the Edges
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_drill.condition: Wear a Mechanical Drill through actual block drilling, then service it once.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_drill.purpose: Learn the pack’s maintenance cycle before expensive digging jobs.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_drill.tip: Read the wear shown by Jade. Stop the mechanism and perform the existing repair interaction with iron; attempting service on an unworn drill does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_drill.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Rough Around the Edges”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_elevator.title: Going Up
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_elevator.condition: Ride a working Elevator Pulley cabin between two Elevator Contact stops.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_elevator.purpose: Give a multi-storey base a useful transport link.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_elevator.tip: Follow the native elevator Ponder scene. Stay on the assembled cabin until it arrives at a different registered stop.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_elevator.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Going Up”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schematic.title: Built Once, Built Twice
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schematic.conditio: Complete a nonempty supplied schematic with a Schematicannon.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schematic.purpose: Turn a useful build into a repeatable construction method.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schematic.tip: Save your own small build with Schematic and Quill, prepare it at the table, then supply the cannon’s required materials and fuel. Completion is native, not judged by appearance.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schematic.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Built Once, Built Twice”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.title: Air on the Side
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.condition: Carry a Copper Backtank, Copper Diving Helmet and Copper Diving Boots.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.purpose: Prepare a workshop-supported diving outfit without a cannon-and-gadget shopping list.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.tip: Charge the backtank with rotation before diving and equip the three pieces. This preparation checks the three items; it does not pretend to prove an underwater expedition.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.reward: 4 × Sturdy Sheet; 8 × Bar of Chocolate; 110 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_toolkit.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Air on the Side”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_package.title: Handle with Care
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_package.condition: Create a filled Package with a Packager attached to a real inventory.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_package.purpose: Turn a stored stack into a transportable shipment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_package.tip: Supply the native packaging setup and request available contents. The finished package must contain an item; rare decorative package skins are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_package.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Handle with Care”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_chain.title: Special Delivery
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_chain.condition: Deliver a filled Package by Chain Conveyor to a receiving Frogport.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_chain.purpose: Give the shipment a real destination; spare packaging supports the next delivery.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_chain.tip: Connect compatible sending and receiving points using the native conveyor setup. Credit occurs when the receiving port accepts the carried package.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_chain.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Special Delivery”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_stock.title: Ask and Receive
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_stock.condition: Place a Stock Ticker order and receive its filled shipment from the linked stock network.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_stock.purpose: Learn the whole request loop instead of merely opening its menu.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_stock.tip: Link the native inventory stock nodes and ticker, choose something actually stored, and complete a request. The request and fulfilled package must share the same order identity.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_stock.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Ask and Receive”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_requester.title: A Signal Gets Things Done
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_requester.conditio: Fulfil one configured Redstone Requester order after a real redstone activation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_requester.purpose: Automate a useful request while retaining the native stock rules.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_requester.tip: Set a small available request, then pulse the requester. The task waits for its actual shipment, not just a lever placement.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_gauge.title: Never Run Dry
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_gauge.condition: Use a Factory Gauge target to request and restore a consumed stock item.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_gauge.purpose: Make the factory respond to actual demand.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_gauge.tip: Choose a modest target for an available product, remove some stock, and let the configured native request restore it. The gauge must cause the replenishment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_gauge.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Never Run Dry”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.title: All in One Box
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.condition: Complete a split native order through a Re-packager.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.purpose: Bring separate supply branches back together; this is the logistics finale.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.tip: Order contents supplied from more than one package, route the matching parts through the Re-packager, and let it emit the correctly combined shipment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.reward: 8 × Sturdy Sheet; 4 × Precision Mechanism; 64 × Cardboard; 280 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_repack.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “All in One Box”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_01.con: Place Train Track, a Train Station and Train Controls.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_01.pur: Lay out the first railway site; a modest track reward lets you extend it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_01.tip: Begin at a native station and use Ponder for bogeys, assembly and controls. This entry checks the three placements, not an already working train.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_01.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Next Stop”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_train.title: All Aboard!
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_train.condition: Assemble a nonempty train and drive it between two distinct stations.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_train.purpose: Turn railway parts into an actual journey.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_train.tip: Assemble the train at a station with valid bogeys and controls. Drive it to another native station and stop there. No minimum route distance is imposed.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_train.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “All Aboard!”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schedule.title: Runs Like Clockwork
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schedule.condition: Have a train complete an automatic journey using a Schedule.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schedule.purpose: Learn unattended routing without claiming that holding a blank schedule is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schedule.tip: Create a valid schedule with two distinct stops and hand it to the native train operator. Completion requires departure and scheduled arrival.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_schedule.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Runs Like Clockwork”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_signal.title: Wait Your Turn
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_signal.condition: Let a scheduled train stop for a blocking Train Signal and resume when it clears.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_signal.purpose: Show why a railway needs traffic control.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_signal.tip: Use a native block or chain signal on a valid shared route. A real native occupied/conflicting section must produce the stop and later release.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_signal.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Wait Your Turn”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_cargo.title: Freight Expectations
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_cargo.condition: Unload real train cargo through paired Portable Storage Interfaces at a destination.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_cargo.purpose: Join the workshop to a railway delivery route.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_cargo.tip: Load a train-mounted inventory, travel to a different station, align the interfaces and let a nonempty stack enter the stationary destination storage.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_cargo.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Freight Expectations”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_05.pur: Introduce the optional shunting tool; it is preparation, not proof of a coupled train.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_05.tip: Read its native Ponder/help before using it on a live route. The coupler complements the railway; other branches do not depend on it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_08.con: Right-click in the air while holding the Navigator.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_08.pur: Find the native route-planning interface; the task rewards trying the tool, not completing a trip.
jem.atlas.card.v2_engineering_h14_08.tip: Obtain the Navigator using its installed recipe, then try its native controls. Compare suggested departures with your actual stations.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_terminal.title: A Proper Station
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_terminal.condition: Place a Display Board and an Advanced Display at your station.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_terminal.purpose: Give passengers useful display surfaces; the quest checks installation, not text accuracy.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_terminal.tip: Use native display configuration to choose station information. A home-made timetable is welcome, but beauty and passengers are not scored.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_terminal.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Proper Station”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_network.title: The World Keeps Moving
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_network.condition: Complete a working workshop and a scheduled train cargo delivery.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_network.purpose: Finish with useful industry and transport; the reward supports the next expansion without gifting a new victory.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_network.tip: Earn The Workshop Works, Runs Like Clockwork and Freight Expectations yourself. They count in any order; optional shunting and decoration remain optional.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_network.reward: 256 × Train Track; 16 × Sturdy Sheet; 8 × Precision Mechanism; 400 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_windmill.title: Catch the Wind
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_windmill.condition: Assemble a Windmill Bearing contraption with sails and generate rotation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_windmill.purpose: Try an independent power source before choosing a larger boiler.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_windmill.tip: Use the native windmill Ponder scene. Attach valid sails, assemble the rotor, and let the bearing transmit nonzero kinetic power. A loose bearing does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_windmill.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Catch the Wind”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_control.title: Know When to Stop
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_control.condition: Use a Clutch to stop and restart a driven output, then reverse a driven output with a Gearshift.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_control.purpose: Learn control before letting a factory run unattended.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_control.tip: Use native powered components and a real redstone control. Both changes must occur on functioning kinetic outputs; placing a lever is not the objective.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_control.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Know When to Stop”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_saw.title: Timber on the Move
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_saw.condition: Harvest a log with a moving Mechanical Saw contraption.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_saw.purpose: Give the moving workshop a useful forestry job without counting hundreds of trees.
jem.atlas.card.v2_eng_saw.tip: Put the saw on a valid assembled contraption and let its native cutting operation harvest a supported log. A hand-broken log or a placed stationary saw does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_magnet_workshop.c: Move a magnetic assembly with both polarities and adjust a magnet’s range.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_magnet_workshop.p: Two polarities let you control magnetic movement direction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_magnet_workshop.t: Azure repels and Scarlet attracts. Matching ingots increase range; opposing ingots reduce it. Leave movement clearance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_magnet_workshop.r: 6 × Azure Neodymium Ingot; 6 × Scarlet Neodymium Ingot; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_magnet_workshop.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Both Ways”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_quarry_cycle.cond: Collect the first output of a working Magnetic Quarry.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_quarry_cycle.purp: A working quarry turns magnetic technology into production.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_quarry_cycle.tip: Place four Magnetic Lights in a rectangle behind the quarry, wait for connecting lightning and put Smasher inside. Drops emerge above the main block; an exhausted quarry becomes dormant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_quarry_cycle.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Stone on the Move”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_metal_slime.title: Iron With Character
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_metal_slime.condi: Smelt Metal Swarf into Scrap Metal and brew Magnetizing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_metal_slime.purpo: Processing connects metallic creatures with materials and potions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_metal_slime.tip: Smallest Ferrouslimes yield slime for swarf; larger ones merge and grow stronger. The potion makes targets magnetic without metal armor.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_metal_slime.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Iron With Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_living_forestry.c: Feed Primordial Soup to a Relicheirus and collect wood from its felling.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_living_forestry.p: Feeding Relicheirus earns forestry help without invented taming.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_living_forestry.t: Relicheirus temporarily fells trees after soup; this is a service, not taming. Tree Stars breed it. Drinking the soup yourself also provides Haste.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_living_forestry.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Lumberjack’s Lunch”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_hazmat_processing: Assemble Hazmat protection and obtain Rusty Scrap, Sulfur and bottled Radon through local processing.
Prepared protection makes toxic processing more manageable.
Polymer supplies acid/radiation protection, not guaranteed immunity. Flowing acid rusts scrap; Acidic Radrock above sulfur stacks supports growth, and a bottle captures vent gas.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Protected Chemistry”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_reactor_output.co: Collect a nuclear-smelted output and package waste in a drum.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_reactor_output.pu: A complete reactor cycle includes useful output and waste handling.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_reactor_output.ti: Assemble eight furnace components as a cube, supply Uranium Rods and insert Metal Barrels for unrefined waste. Buildup is dangerous; do not break completed waste drums.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_reactor_output.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Clean Shift”.
Hear an actual Nuclear Siren warning and remotely activate a permitted explosive.
Warnings and remote control help manage a dangerous process.

Bind the detonator to an eligible explosive. Craft the siren from Brainiac Charred Remnants; it warns of nearby nuclear explosions. Respect protection rules; ordinary permitted TNT is enough for the detonator.
10 × Polymer Plate; 4 × Green Radon Lamp; 140 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Warning First”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_tools.title: Up and Down
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_tools.condi: Transfer water with a redstone Drain and ascend with a Floater.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_tools.purpo: Flow and buoyancy help manage water and depth.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_tools.tip: The Drain needs liquid above and empty space below. Gossamer Worm Bioluminessence makes Floaters, underwater torches and Glowing potions. Light and glowing creatures attract Hullbreakers.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_tools.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Up and Down”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_gingerbread_dispa: Create a Gingerbread helper and receive an item it deposits into a Gingerbarrel.
A Gingerbread helper connects item transport to a chosen barrel.
Power the oven and set frosting with a Rock Candy block below it. Helpers fight different frosting, gather drops and deposit into barrels; collected candy also builds their armor.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Oven Dispatch”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crystal_water.co: Drain water with a slug slime block and harvest one crystal appropriately.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crystal_water.pu: Managing water gives access to useful crystals.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crystal_water.ti: Slugs drop slime; its block beside water crystallizes water. Silk Touch preserves mucus crystals; removing the source makes them decay. Brown mushrooms breed slugs.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crystal_water.re: 8 × Crystallized Banana Slug Mucus; 2 × Sponge; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_crystal_water.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Water in Crystals”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_redstone_creatur: Move items with a Gustmaker and trigger a controlled Sculk Boomer response.
Creature reactions can be used in controlled devices.
A desert Guster eye makes a redstone blower. Interrupt dangerous Skreecher calling to obtain its soul for the sculk-triggered boomer; redstone can disable it.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Wildness on Signal”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_compact.title: Under Pressure
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_compact.condition: Complete a native Basin compacting recipe under a Mechanical Press.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_compact.purpose: Learn compound press recipes; alloy and sheets help build neighboring workstations.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_compact.tip: Put a Basin below the press, supply a valid JEI recipe and rotation. This differs from pressing one ingot on a Depot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_compact.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Under Pressure”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_crush.title: Between the Wheels
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_crush.condition: Complete a native Crushing Wheels recipe.
