jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_crush.purpose: Add crushing to raw-material processing; alloy and brass support your next line.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_crush.tip: Drive the pair inward, feed supported input above and collect below. A completed recipe counts; wheel damage does not.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_crush.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Between the Wheels”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_saw_recipe.title: Cut to Pattern
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_saw_recipe.conditi: Complete a stationary Saw recipe with a selected output filter.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_saw_recipe.purpose: Choose a useful saw output; glue and chassis support a moving forestry machine.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_saw_recipe.tip: Face the Saw upward. Set its output filter when alternatives exist; moving-saw forestry is a different function.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_saw_recipe.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Cut to Pattern”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_deployer.title: A Helping Hand
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_deployer.condition: Make a Deployer successfully place a block or apply an item.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_deployer.purpose: Automate a repeated action; electron tubes and brass sheets support precision actuators.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_deployer.tip: Supply its held item and rotation; wrench it to switch use/attack modes. A committed supported action must change the world/target; an empty swing is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_deployer.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Helping Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_hose.title: Beyond Buckets
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_hose.condition: Transfer fluid to or from a world pool through a Hose Pulley.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_hose.purpose: Connect the workshop to a pool; pipes and tanks help build a real fluid reserve.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_hose.tip: Lower the hose into eligible fluid and connect a pump. Hose height controls the working level; server-defined infinite-source rules are not a quest requirement.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_hose.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Beyond Buckets”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_cart.title: A Build on Wheels
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_cart.condition: Assemble and move a Cart Assembler contraption on a minecart.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_cart.purpose: Move a whole assembled build; chassis and glue expand your next mobile project.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_cart.tip: Put connected blocks over the assembler, position the cart and activate native assembly. Its native reverse operation can disassemble the result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_cart.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Build on Wheels”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_capture_heat.title: A Warm Welcome
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_capture_heat.condi: Capture a Blaze with an Empty Blaze Burner and fuel the resulting burner.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_capture_heat.purpo: Captured heat opens hot recipes; modest brass and copper support their next application.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_capture_heat.tip: Native capture accepts a Blaze or supported spawner. Ordinary fuel provides heat; Blaze Cake enables stronger heat where recipes require it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_capture_heat.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Warm Welcome”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_factory_recipe.con: Fulfil ingredient-gauge production and return its finished product to linked stock.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_factory_recipe.pur: Connect demand to production; precision mechanisms and sheets expand the factory you demonstrated.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_factory_recipe.tip: Link ingredient gauges to output stock, processing address and batch size. Native crafter auto-arrangement uses a recognized recipe and wrench-connected grid; consolidate fragments with a Re-Packager.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_factory_recipe.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Factory Knows”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_rail_couple.title: Getting Hitched
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_rail_couple.condit: Perform native train coupling or decoupling with a Track Coupler.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_rail_couple.purpos: Learn to change a train consist; track and casing support your own shunting yard.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_rail_couple.tip: Align bogey centers over both coupler points and orient carriages consistently. A wrench changes orientation; a signal starts the admissible operation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_rail_couple.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Getting Hitched”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_conductor.title: Conductor of Rails
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_conductor.conditio: Create a Conductor and successfully summon its train with a native Conductor Whistle.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_conductor.purpose: Give a train a useful service; the toolbox suits its conductor and track extends the route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_conductor.tip: Use installed conductor creation and train assignment. Remote redstone operation and toolbox carrying are additional roles; the whistle must commit a valid train summon request.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_conductor.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Conductor of Rails”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_route_planner.cond: Obtain a successful Navigator itinerary between distinct stations using chosen transfer constraints.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_route_planner.purp: Plan transfers using real services; displays and platforms make that route easier to use.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_route_planner.tip: Set minimum transfer time and allowed train categories. Permitted aliases group platforms; exclusions remove unwanted stations/trains. Enable desired native route updates.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_route_planner.rewa: 2 × Advanced Display Board; 24 × Station Platform; 140 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_route_planner.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Make the Connection”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_station_access.con: Operate a native train sliding access part and climb a Grab Bar or Bogie Step.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_station_access.pur: Make boarding and access practical; platforms and headlights finish the functional station.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_station_access.tip: Install windows, steps or slides on train/station; grab bars and bogie steps provide ladder-like access. Platforms frame the edge and crossing parts belong beside tracks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_station_access.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Step Aboard”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_photo_develop.cond: Develop exposed film through the installed mechanical filling sequence.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_photo_develop.purp: Connect chemical photography to mechanical processing; pipes and fresh color film support the next series.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_photo_develop.tip: Bundled photography compatibility uses water for black-and-white and three potion-fluid steps for color. Feed genuinely exposed film and follow the installed recipe.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_photo_develop.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Film on the Line”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_excavate.title: A Plane of Progress
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_excavate.condition: Mine a permitted block plane with a valid Excavation tool.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_excavate.purpose: Learn controlled plane mining without bypassing protections; a toolbox and sheets prepare the next engineering outing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_excavate.tip: Excavation I selects a face-directed3×3 plane; II selects 7×7. Pickaxes, shovels and axes follow native eligibility; the white highlight previews the area. Enchantment acquisition and rank access stay native.
jem.atlas.card.v3_eng_excavate.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Plane of Progress”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.title: Fine Print
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.condition: Carry a populated spell Scroll and Arcane Essence.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.purpose: Read the spell’s school, level, mana cost and cooldown before experimenting.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.tip: Look for spell scrolls in the installed magical loot and their listed native acquisition routes. A blank scroll does not count; examine the populated scroll’s tooltip.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.reward: 4 × Common Ink; 12 × Arcane Essence; 12 × Paper; 25 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg01.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fine Print”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg02.title: A Book of Your Own
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg02.condition: Place an Inscription Table and carry a survival Spell Book.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg02.purpose: Prepare your reusable spell workspace; supplies support your own first inscription.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg02.tip: Use the installed recipe for a starting spell book and the table. This task checks preparation; the next one checks a successful inscription.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg02.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Book of Your Own”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_inscribe.title: Between the Covers
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_inscribe.condition: Successfully inscribe a populated Scroll into a compatible Spell Book.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_inscribe.purpose: Make the prepared book useful; this rewards a real inscription rather than owning an empty book.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_inscribe.tip: Open the Inscription Table, use a populated scroll and a compatible book, then take the committed result. Follow the table’s actual compatibility rules.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_inscribe.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Between the Covers”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cast.title: Words That Work
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cast.condition: Complete one successful spell cast from a Scroll or Spell Book.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cast.purpose: Move from reading to casting; simple supplies let you continue experimenting.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cast.tip: Choose an affordable spell and its valid target. Credit is given after the native cast completes; a right-click with insufficient mana or an interrupted cast does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cast.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Words That Work”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.title: Written by Hand
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.condition: Create a populated spell Scroll in a Scroll Forge.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.purpose: Choose what to learn instead of relying entirely on found scrolls.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.tip: Use JEI for the installed forge recipe and supply its actual ink, paper and focus. Taking the forged nonempty scroll completes the task.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.reward: 2 × Blank Runestone; 4 × Uncommon Ink; 16 × Paper; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_forge.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Written by Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_rare_scroll.title: Better Ink, Bigger Ideas
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_rare_scroll.condit: Forge a populated spell Scroll of Rare quality or higher.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_rare_scroll.purpos: Learn the ink-quality pathway through a chosen spell, not an ink shopping list.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_rare_scroll.tip: Compare the installed forge recipes and the result’s native spell rarity. Choose a spell you can actually use; buying a loose rare ink bottle does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_rare_scroll.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Better Ink, Bigger Ideas”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_upgrade_spell.cond: Upgrade a spell through a successful Arcane Anvil operation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_upgrade_spell.purp: Develop a useful existing spell instead of collecting every school.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_upgrade_spell.tip: Use the native compatible-scroll upgrade shown by the Arcane Anvil. Take a result whose spell level is higher than the input.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_upgrade_spell.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Same Spell, New Tricks”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_imbue.title: A Trick up Your Blade
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_imbue.condition: Successfully imbue a compatible weapon with a spell.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_imbue.purpose: Combine spellcraft with equipment you already use.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_imbue.tip: Use the installed Arcane Anvil recipe and a compatible weapon. Take the result with a new usable spell entry; the weapon is never supplied by this reward.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_imbue.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Trick up Your Blade”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_erase.title: Room for Another Idea
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_erase.condition: Remove an installed spell using a Shriving Stone through the native supported operation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_erase.purpose: Learn how to revise a build safely rather than fearing the first choice.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_erase.tip: Read the stone’s installed use/recipe for the compatible item. Credit requires a real spell entry to be removed and the native cost to be paid.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_erase.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Room for Another Idea”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg09.title: Dressed for the Spell
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg09.condition: Equip one piece of school-specific spellcaster armor.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg09.purpose: Try a chosen school’s clothing before committing to a complete outfit.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg09.tip: Compare the item’s actual mana, protection and spell bonuses, then wear it in its armor slot. One supported school piece is enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_orb.title: A Little More Magic
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_orb.condition: Successfully apply a native Upgrade Orb to compatible equipment.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_orb.purpose: Choose a real improvement without receiving a free second orb.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_orb.tip: Follow the installed orb recipe and compatibility rules. The upgraded item must gain the chosen native upgrade after the operation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_accessory.title: A Small Charm
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_accessory.conditio: Equip a supported magical ring or amulet in its valid accessory slot.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_accessory.purpose: Make an accessory part of your build rather than leaving it in a chest.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_accessory.tip: Use the ring or amulet’s Curios slot and read its native effect. Ordinary clothing is not accepted as a ring or amulet.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_accessory.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Small Charm”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cauldron.title: A Stirring Discovery
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cauldron.condition: Brew a native elixir in an Alchemist Cauldron.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cauldron.purpose: Give magical preparation a consumable branch.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cauldron.tip: Choose an installed elixir recipe in JEI, provide its actual cauldron ingredients and take the completed drink. A placed empty cauldron is not enough.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_cauldron.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Stirring Discovery”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_elixir.title: Bottled Backup
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_elixir.condition: Finish drinking an Oakskin, Evasion or Invisibility Elixir.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_elixir.purpose: Learn a consumable’s practical use; refill the supplies after trying it.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_elixir.tip: Read the chosen elixir’s tooltip and finish its drinking action. This checks actual consumption, not carrying a bottle.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg13.title: A Needle for Secrets
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg13.purpose: Learn the native search tool before setting off for magical ruins.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg13.tip: Craft the Wayward Compass using its installed JEI recipe, then read its native target-selection tooltip. It locates supported structures; owning it does not prove visiting them.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg13.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Needle for Secrets”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_relocate.title: Here, There, Somewhere
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_relocate.condition: Relocate yourself successfully using a native teleportation spell.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_relocate.purpose: Use magic for a practical journey; the reward supports further experiments without granting a transport artifact.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_relocate.tip: Choose a native self-teleportation spell in your book or scroll and a valid destination. Credit follows the actual safe teleport, not the start of casting.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_relocate.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Here, There, Somewhere”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_eldritch.title: Some Pages Bite
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_eldritch.condition: Learn the native Eldritch knowledge from an Eldritch Manuscript.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_eldritch.purpose: Mark an earned knowledge unlock without handing out its rare source.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_eldritch.tip: Use the installed JEI recipe for the Eldritch Manuscript, then complete its native learning action. Credit follows the owning system’s knowledge change; a failed right-click does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_eldritch.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “Some Pages Bite”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg17.title: A Spell at Sword’s Length
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg17.condition: Land three positive melee hits on living non-player targets with a supported magical staff or blade.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg17.purpose: Try the melee side of magical equipment you already earned.
jem.atlas.card.v2_magic_mg17.tip: Use the held staff or blade’s actual combat controls. These are ordinary direct melee hits; casting, skill activation and killing a boss are not claimed by this task.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_repair.title: Good as New
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_repair.condition: Repair a damaged tool or weapon using a normal Anvil.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_repair.purpose: Keep a favorite item useful; the reward supplies a small further repair reserve.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_repair.tip: Use the installed anvil recipe and take a result with lower damage than the input. A rename without repairing damage does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_repair.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Good as New”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_enchant.title: A Little Enchantment
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_enchant.condition: Apply an enchantment at an Enchanting Table.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_enchant.purpose: Learn a useful everyday system alongside spells; lapis supports later choices.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_enchant.tip: Supply an eligible item and lapis, choose an available offer and finish the paid native operation. Retained table slots are convenience, not a separate requirement.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_enchant.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Little Enchantment”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_fieldwork.title: Magic Earns Its Keep
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_fieldwork.conditio: Use your spells to damage a hostile creature, heal missing health, and relocate yourself successfully.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_fieldwork.purpose: Show three genuinely different uses for your magic; an accessory choice rewards a versatile build.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_fieldwork.tip: Use any supported native spell for each role, in any order. Healing must restore health; relocation must move you through native spell logic. Ordinary food, melee and vanilla portals do not substitute.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_fieldwork.reward: 2 × Epic Ink; 48 × Arcane Essence; Choose one: 1 × Ring of Mana, 1 × Ring of Expediency, 1 × Amulet of Concentration; 350 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_dead_king.title: The Last Word
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_dead_king.conditio: Personally earn a legitimate victory over the Dead King.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_dead_king.purpose: An optional magical boss culmination rewards preparation without handing out its exclusive drops.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_dead_king.tip: Use the Wayward Compass’s supported Catacombs route and follow the native encounter rules. This is optional and not one of the twelve main eye targets.
jem.atlas.card.v2_mag_dead_king.reward: 4 × Epic Ink; 64 × Arcane Essence; 4 × Evasion Elixir; 450 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_occult_links.cond: Direct a creature with a Totem of Possession and view through a bound Beholder.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_occult_links.purp: Linked devices provide remote control and observation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_occult_links.tip: Bind the totem by striking, then hold it while watching its target; control costs durability. Bind Beholder with an Occult Gem and use that gem elsewhere in the same dimension.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_occult_links.rewa: 6 × Moth Ball; 4 × Black and White Film; 170 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_occult_links.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Another Point of View”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_moth_lighting.con: Mark a monster with Moth Dust and protect a light with Moth Balls.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_moth_lighting.pur: Moth tools help mark threats and preserve lighting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_moth_lighting.tip: Light attracts harmless Gloomoths followed by predators. Charged dust redirects predators toward a marked target; balls repel moths near light.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_moth_lighting.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Who Follows the Light”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_flight.con: Charge the darkness set and fly in shadow mode.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_flight.pur: Charged equipment unlocks flight with its own limits.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_flight.tip: Defeat Forsaken for Pure Darkness and convert it to Shadow Silk. A Gloomoth sacrifice creates Watcher; Vesper creates Forsaken. Wear hood/cloak together; darkness charges them and Darkened Apple extends active state.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_flight.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Wings Without Dawn”.
Bind a Biome Treat and finish local Crucible conversion.
The cauldron lets you deliberately change an allowed biome area.

Craft the sack from Sweet Tooth and drag food onto it; it feeds a hungry carrier. Eat a Biome Treat while fully starving in the desired biome, toss it into the crucible and fulfill all requests including its final rare item.
6 × Licoroot Sprout; 64 × White Kaolin Bricks; 240 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Biome by Recipe”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_field_draughts.c: Brew and drink one potion: Poison Resistance, Bug Pheromones or Soulsteal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_field_draughts.p: A specialized potion prepares you for a particular natural threat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_field_draughts.t: A rattlesnake rattle turns Poison into Poisonous Essence; a centipede leg leads to resistance. Cockroach wings give pheromones. A Soul Vulture heart relates to health theft. Lava Vision and Clinging are in the adjacent route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_field_draughts.r: 16 × Glass Bottle; 6 × Mosquito Repellent Stew; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_field_draughts.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Naturalist’s Cabinet”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.tit: The Price of a Distant Look
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.con: Complete a native Transmutation Table exchange spending its required experience.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.pur: Table exchange uses its native experience cost instead of free conversion.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.tip: A Capsid transforms the Carver for distant Farseer access; its arm makes the table. Usage teaches choices, and breaking the table destroys learned state: avoid casually relocating it.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.rew: 8 × Thrown Bottle o' Enchanting; 4 × Secret Purpur Door; 200 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_far_exchange.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Price of a Distant Look”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_mutable_material: Complete one transformation: Bunfungus rabbit, Mimicream item copy or glowing Rainbow Glass.
Unusual substances transform creatures, items and building materials.

Spores transform a rabbit; carrots pacify the fungal defender, which cannot breed. Mimicream copies supported damageable items with depleted durability, not a repaired copy. Rainbow Jelly colors reversibly; sponge removes creature color.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Things With a Previous Life”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_fungal_landscape: Grow five matching mushrooms on a Mungus and trigger its native biome conversion in a permitted plot.
A prepared Mungus changes terrain through its native ability.
Its beam grows mushrooms and matching food forms a colony. Death with five mushrooms converts nearby biome; poisonous potato reverses it. Spores also breed Mungi and transform other creatures.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Five Mushrooms, New Place”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_book_and_robes.con: While wearing Mage equipment, successfully use two different Magic Books: one combat and one support.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_book_and_robes.pur: Soul Gems and blood support further book experiments without granting a finished rare caster.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_book_and_robes.tip: Ice, tornado, mark, beam, spikes, black hole and Naginata books have distinct actions; Brace and Heal Ring support allies. Naginata has a native precision modifier. Mage gear affects damage/cooldowns; use installed values, not guessed percentages.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_book_and_robes.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Read Aloud”.
Successfully obtain Bottle o’ Lightning from a charged creeper.
Open the lightning school’s material route through a charged creeper.
Use an empty bottle on a charged creeper under the native rule. Prepare distance and defense; an ordinary creeper is not charged. The focus supports lightning-school forging.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Bottle the Storm”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_focus_blood.cond: Obtain a real blood vial through the heated alchemist-cauldron route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_focus_blood.purp: Learn the separate alchemical route for the blood-school focus.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_focus_blood.tip: Check the installed heated-cauldron recipe, allowed creature and empty bottle. Blood focus has a separate material loop; red dye is not a substitute.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_focus_blood.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Alchemy with Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_arcane_resources: Mine actual Arcane Debris with a suitable tool and smelt its salvage.
Prepare your own rare material for advanced magical crafting.

The debris is concealed in the Overworld and needs native Netherite-tier mining. At an Ancient Battleground, mining armor piles with the documented diamond pickaxe spawns an Ancient Knight; its material serves another upgrade branch.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Beneath the Ruins”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_book_translation: Complete the real written-book translation and priest exchange to obtain the villager spellbook.
Obtain an unusual spellbook through its real discovery and exchange sequence.
Start with the Evoker Fort’s written book. Its captive wandering trader provides translation, then bring the result to the Priest. This differs from Blaze manual drops and Evoker grimoire drops.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Lost in Translation”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_fire_ice.title: Two Kinds of Bad Weather
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_fire_ice.conditi: Successfully produce one concrete elemental outcome: Fireball explosion, Ray of Frost freeze or Chain Lightning connections.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_fire_ice.purpose: Distinguish explosion, freeze and chaining as three elemental outcomes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_fire_ice.tip: Fireball needs an actual impact/explosion; the frost ray can hit a block, but freezing needs an entity. Chain Lightning needs a valid initial target and its own chain. Pressing cast proves none of these results.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_fire_ice.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Two Kinds of Bad Weather”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_healing_blood.co: Restore missing health using Healing Circle or actual Blood Slash lifesteal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_healing_blood.pu: Produce actual restoration of missing health rather than an empty cast.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_healing_blood.ti: The circle must actually heal an eligible recipient. Blood Slash must deal damage with its projectile before lifesteal can heal; full health or an empty cast is not healing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_healing_blood.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Someone Feels Better”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_summon_root.cond: Successfully summon an owned Vex or restrain an eligible target with Root.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_summon_root.purp: Use an owned summon or target restraint with its actual restrictions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_summon_root.tip: Vex has owner and lifetime; its later kills are a separate result. Root creates its own restraint entity; targets excluded by the native tag cannot qualify.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_summon_root.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep Your Distance”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_shroud.title: A Shroud on the Shoulders
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_shroud.condition: After the native Eldritch unlock, successfully apply Abyssal Shroud to yourself.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_shroud.purpose: Apply earned Eldritch knowledge through a real temporary effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_shroud.tip: Meet Eldritch knowledge requirements and obtain the spell normally. Its native temporary effect is not immunity to every modded damage source.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_shroud.guide_hin: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Shroud on the Shoulders”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_blade_cast.title: The Blade Finishes the Sentence
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_blade_cast.condi: With Magic Blade learned, successfully trigger the selected spell through an actual compatible weapon swing.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_blade_cast.purpo: Connect a weapon swing with an eligible magical result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_blade_cast.tip: The skill respects cooldown and can reduce a spell below its valid level: failed attempts do not count. Hasty Casting and Rapid Chant separately change movement, preparation or channel behavior.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_blade_cast.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Blade Finishes the Sentence”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_mana_trade.title: The Price of Magic
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_mana_trade.condi: Restore health with Auto Heal and pay its actual resource cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_mana_trade.purpo: Match resource recovery with its actual health or mana cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_mana_trade.tip: Blood into Mana substitutes health for a mana cost and does not refill mana. Use paid Auto Heal for this goal. Mana Shield spends mana on defense; Second Wind has fatal-hit conditions and does not override actual JEM death/elimination. Reserve Mana, Connect to the Root and Magic Immunity have separate passive restrictions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_mana_trade.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Price of Magic”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_cancel_cast.cond: Successfully cancel a long cast with an allowed combat action before it completes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_cancel_cast.purp: Keep combat control by correctly cancelling a long cast.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_cancel_cast.tip: The integration permits appropriate guard or roll instead of conflicting animations. Cancellation, instant casting and completed channels are different states; first-person arm settings concern presentation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_cancel_cast.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Changed My Mind in Time”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_nether_ritual.co: Complete an available useful ritual at a table installed on its pedestal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_nether_ritual.pu: Prepare a ritual using its actual resource and receive a useful limited effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_nether_ritual.ti: Use a table on a pedestal and Ghostly Essence from ash ghosts. Soul Cleave can supply essence from mobs under native rules. Healing and cleansing are different operations; the ritual owns its daily reset.
jem.atlas.card.v3_magic_nether_ritual.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Ghostly Favor”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_home_enchantment_extra: Extract the first real enchantment from an item at a Grindstone and receive its Enchanted Book.
Move earned enchantments to another item; books and lapis support your next deliberate enchantment choice.

Sneak-right-click a Grindstone with the enchanted item in your main hand. The current handler removes the first displayed enchantment and produces its book; cost history refunds 70% of actually paid XP once. No selection menu is promised.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Back into a Book”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_revised_v2_bosses_comb: In battle mode complete a normal, sprinting and airborne attack with a supported weapon.
Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
The mode toggle defaults to R unless remapped. Use a supported ordinary sword and try the three contexts in a safe space. The airborne attack needs only a short jump.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Step Changes the Strike”.
