jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_sk17.tip: Keep the native Wither and dragon victory requirements. Prepare Voidrake materials, Void Scale Blocks, Dragon Heads and a Beacon for the native ritual. This encounter is optional for the twelve eyes.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_sk17.reward: 3 × Greater Invisibility Elixir; 8 × Chicken Wrapped In Bacon With Noodles; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_sk17.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Anybody Home?”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_uj02.title: Older Than Trouble
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_uj02.purpose: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_uj02.tip: This is an optional challenge in the creature’s native setting. Obtain access and summon it normally; it does not replace the main campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_uj02.reward: 3 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 8 × Roasted Chicken; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_uj02.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Older Than Trouble”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_wf05.title: A Chill Down the Spine
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_wf05.purpose: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_wf05.tip: This is an optional challenge in the creature’s native setting. Obtain access and summon it normally; it does not replace the main campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_wf05.reward: 3 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 8 × Roasted Chicken; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_wf05.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Chill Down the Spine”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_fight_guard_support.co: Have a village guard damage a monster that is targeting you.
jem.atlas.card.v2_fight_guard_support.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_fight_guard_support.ti: Stay near a guard without placing villagers at needless risk. This checks combat support, not hiring or rescue from a lethal hit.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_01.co: Obtain the canonical victory milestone for this world’s dragon.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_01.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_01.ti: Finish the real fight and normal ending. This reads existing progress; the quest does not unlock the End early.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_01.re: 24 × Enderiophage Rocket; 8 × Cooked Ender Dragon Meat; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_01.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Only the Beginning”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_02.co: Have the world campaign reveal its post-End route.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_02.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_02.ti: After the normal ending use the locator issued by the campaign itself. This quest does not create one.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_02.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “After the Credits”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_03.co: Record Ender Guardian defeated in the world’s post-End campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_03.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_03.ti: After revealing the route, find Ender Guardian using the native locator. It belongs to the campaign’s continuation.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_03.re: 1 × Ring of Recovery; 4 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_03.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Guardian of the Far Side”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_04.co: Record Endersent defeated in the world’s post-End campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_04.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_04.ti: Find the target with the normal post-End locator. The world campaign records the victory, not your inventory.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_04.re: 1 × Hook of the Depths; 16 × Abyss Bait; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_05.co: Record Shulker Mimic defeated in the world’s post-End campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_05.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_05.ti: Follow the normal locator after the continuation is revealed. An ordinary shulker does not replace this target.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_06.co: Record The Obliterator defeated in the world’s post-End campaign.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_06.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_06.ti: The campaign must first confirm Ender Guardian, Endersent and Shulker Mimic. Complete the final encounter normally.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_06.re: 1 × Amulet of Concentration; 48 × Enderiophage Rocket; 12 × Dragon Soufflé; 140 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_after_end_06.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “The End, Eventually”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_boss_loot_08.co: Record one completed raid in your personal event profile.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_boss_loot_08.pu: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_boss_loot_08.ti: Available only on a dedicated server with the event enabled. Join through its normal interface; ordinary singleplayer does not require this quest.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_boss_loot_08.re: 4 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 24 × Tracking Diamond Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_boss_loot_08.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Round Two”.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.title: Red Night
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.condi: Record one successful Blood Moon clear in your personal event profile.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.purpo: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.tip: Available only on a dedicated server with the event enabled. Join through its normal interface; ordinary singleplayer does not require this quest.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.rewar: 1 × Emerald Stoneplate Ring; 4 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v2_bosses_events_02.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Red Night”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_resistor.title: Polarity of Defense
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_resistor.conditio: Successfully use the Resistor Shield pulse in both polarities.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_resistor.purpose: Changing shield polarity offers different ways to control an enemy.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_resistor.tip: Obtain Heart of Iron from Magnetron; nearby anvils and sawmills strengthen its assembled limbs. Sneak-use the shield to switch: Azure repels, Scarlet attracts.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_resistor.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Polarity of Defense”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_raygun.title: Better by Beam
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_raygun.condition: Fuel a Raygun with a Uranium Rod and deal positive beam damage to a hostile creature.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_raygun.purpose: Reloading connects the powerful beam to a real fuel cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_raygun.tip: Defeat a Nucleeper before its charge completes to obtain a Fissile Core. The gun uses polymer and Uranium Rods. Its beam damages along its path; siren/Hazmat do not replace safety rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_raygun.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Better by Beam”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_arsenal.con: Use one technique: an Ortholance wave, Sea Staff bolts or Magic Conch allies.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_arsenal.pur: Water weapons offer different ways to control a fight.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_arsenal.tip: Obtain tools through real Deep One trades. Hold Ortholance to charge, fire Sea Staff bolts or summon temporary allies with Conch. Ink Bombs blind while Glow Ink Bombs glow; these are not wave damage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_arsenal.rew: 4 × Ink Bomb; 4 × Glow Ink Bomb; 160 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_water_arsenal.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Water Has a Point”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_arsenal.co: Use two different techniques: delayed dagger, Dreadbow volley or Burrowing Arrow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_arsenal.pu: Delayed attacks and special projectiles change attack timing and direction.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_arsenal.ti: The dagger leaves a delayed spectral strike. Shadow-Silk Dreadbow rains a volley; Corrodent-teeth Burrowing Arrows mine a limited number of blocks. Teeth also brew Haste.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_shadow_arsenal.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Delayed Reply”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_arsenal.con: Hit with a Shot Gum ricochet and use Sugar Staff or Frostmint Spear.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_arsenal.pur: Ricochets and distinct candy attacks help exploit target positioning.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_arsenal.tip: Load Shot Gum with Gumball Piles; shots rebound from walls. Sugar Staff follows Licowitch access. Frostmint makes spears and Elytra rockets, but explodes in Purple Soda.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_arsenal.rew: 24 × Gumball Pile; 12 × Purple Soda Bottle Rocket; 190 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_candy_arsenal.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Sweet Recoil”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_wild_gear.title: Loot With a Job
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_wild_gear.condit: Use two techniques: heavy-armor rolling, chained whip damage, skull parry or leggings wall-climb. Emu-leggings evasion also qualifies. The kimono does not clear an existing undead target and does not count for this goal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_wild_gear.purpos: Wildlife equipment grants abilities beyond ordinary armour.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_wild_gear.tip: Roller armor rolls but sinks; Murmur tendons make the whip and Skelewag skull provides parrying. Centipede legs make wall-climbing leggings; Emu leggings separately evade projectiles.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_wild_gear.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Loot With a Job”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_worm_aftermath.c: Defeat Void Worm normally and use its earned material in one utility.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_worm_aftermath.p: Using the drops turns a victory into useful new technology.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_worm_aftermath.t: Throw the capsid-made Mysterious Worm into the End void. Focus the head; segments can split the boss. A redstone biting beak and Dimensional Carver use earned trophies, never gifted by the journal.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_worm_aftermath.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “After the Long Shadow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_blood_line.title: Living Reload
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_blood_line.condi: Fuel Blood Sprayer and Hemolymph Blaster and deal positive damage with each.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_blood_line.purpo: Both living weapons require real refilling and use.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_blood_line.tip: An inflated mosquito supplies Blood Sacs and proboscis. Feeding on a warped fungal creature mutates it into Warped Mosco; muscle and sacs support the upgrade. Neither weapon nor rare-creature drops is gifted for a click.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_blood_line.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Living Reload”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_sea_defense.cond: Cause Exsanguination by blocking with Shield of the Deep or hit an aquatic monster with a Shark Tooth Arrow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_sea_defense.purp: Sea materials help you defend and retaliate underwater.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_sea_defense.tip: Frilled Sharks shed serrated teeth while hunting squid; other shark teeth support aquatic arrows. The shield acts on blocks; these arrows travel better underwater and favor aquatic targets.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_sea_defense.rewa: 20 × Shark Tooth Arrow; 12 × Prismarine Shard; 145 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_sea_defense.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Answer From Below”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_fireworks_escape: Stun a Wendigo, Wechuge or Skinwalker with a firework and retreat.
A suitable firework creates an opportunity to escape.
Wechuge and Wendigo threaten cold forests; Skinwalker disguises as a wolf and reveals with a screaming lunge. Fireworks create a temporary pause, not permanent safety.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Not Everyone Likes Fireworks”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_captain.co: Defeat a pillager captain with your tamed eagle participating.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_captain.pu: The Primal eagle joins a real fight as an ally.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_captain.ti: Use the raised tame eagle. Require a real captain and companion contribution to the same fight; merely standing near someone else’s victory is insufficient.
jem.atlas.card.v3_fauna_eagle_captain.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Winged Partner”.
Understanding weaknesses helps you vary tactics between enemies.

Options: shoot Boundroid winch; interrupt Notor scanning; ground Vesper by shield block; scare Corrodent with light; evade Hullbreaker after turning off lights; defeat Mine Guardian before its explosion. Each needs its actual result.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Everyone Has a Tell”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_cave_primitive_tactics: Try one path: club stun and salad stun relief, stew Rage or raw-food eating in Primordial Armor.
Prehistoric supplies and equipment change combat and eating strategies.

Heavy Bone makes the club and joins Tough Hide for armor. Salad clears stun, stew damage scales with missing health and armor pieces improve raw-meat recovery. These are distinct native uses, not a blanket food buff.
More details: unified guide → Items → “The Ancient School”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_quiet_dart.title: A Quiet Delivery
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_quiet_dart.conditi: Hit a hostile creature with a real poison-tipped dart from a Bamboo Blowgun.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_quiet_dart.purpose: Ordinary darts supply future ammunition preparation and cooked fish provisions another hunting trip.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_quiet_dart.tip: Use the native blowgun and dart recipes, choose poison ammunition and shoot a hostile creature. Player targets and command projectiles do not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_quiet_dart.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Quiet Delivery”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_first_recruit.cond: Hire a real recruit through its native screen and supply food and a shield.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_first_recruit.purp: A spare shield and ready sandwiches support provisioning the squad without granting a free new soldier.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_first_recruit.tip: Find an available recruit and pay its displayed quote. Native payment or an authorized server replacement is determined by the current trading owner. Villager Workers are not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_first_recruit.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Any Volunteers?”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_clear_orders.title: Orders Understood
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_clear_orders.condi: Assign your recruits to a group and execute one real group order.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_clear_orders.purpo: A Shieldman’s Table supports developing the squad and bread gives a simple provision reserve for future orders.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_clear_orders.tip: Use the native management screen and available follow, hold or move orders. PvP and a second player are unnecessary; server team diplomacy is an optional separate setting.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_clear_orders.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Orders Understood”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_blood_and_halo.con: Use a Blood Sword or Axe special action and equip an acquired Holy Robe piece.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_blood_and_halo.pur: Blood and Demon Flesh supply further blood equipment without replacing acquisition of Holy Robes.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_blood_and_halo.tip: Sword fires a piercing slash and Axe creates vortices; blood armor protects more at low health. Holy Robes have defense/fire-ring behavior. Do not deliberately lower health or obtain the robe as a free quest reward.
jem.atlas.card.v3_pet_blood_and_halo.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Blood and Fire”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_abyssal_forging.co: Complete a real smithing upgrade with the Terrible or Abyssal template and its matching addition.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_abyssal_forging.pu: Sharp Bones support further marine recipes and Luminescent Bubbles introduce a faster swimming route.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_abyssal_forging.ti: Enabled smithing recipes use a fin with the Horrific template and Abyssal Amethyst with the Abyssal template. Abyssal armor strengthens with negative effects, while delayed lethal damage does not prevent elimination from a server event.
jem.atlas.card.v3_era_abyssal_forging.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Forged by the Deep”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_book.cond: Learn an actual skill from a valid book and equip it in a compatible slot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_book.purp: Distinguish reading a book from learning and equipping its actual combat skill.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_book.tip: Find a skill-bearing book through normal adventures. Opening its screen is not learning: confirm the choice and inspect the skill slot. An empty book does not qualify.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_book.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Read, Then Learn”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_dodge_guard.con: Successfully dodge a physical attack using Roll or Step and block an attack with learned Guard.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_dodge_guard.pur: Alternate evasion and weapon guarding while accounting for armor weight and stamina.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_dodge_guard.tip: Learn and equip the skills. Dodge commonly uses Left Alt and guard uses the item-use control; check bindings. Armor weight affects stamina. Parrying and Impact Guard have their own weapon requirements.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_dodge_guard.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Missed Me”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_synergy.c: Equip one passive and trigger its actual benefit: Technician, Stamina Pillager or Death Harvest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_synergy.p: Pair a passive with the action that actually returns its combat resource.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_synergy.t: Technician rewards a timed dodge, Stamina Pillager a kill and Death Harvest an innate-skill kill. Choose an available route; collecting all three is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_synergy.r: 2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 12 × Nugget of Experience; 60 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_skill_synergy.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “It Comes Together”.
Successfully use Demolition Leap or a compatible Meteor Slam.
Add a deliberate combat movement technique with its own cost.
Learn a suitable skill, equip compatible gear and check its cost. Extra jumping, a charged leap and a descending slam are different actions; dangerous-height jumps are not required.
3 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Torch Iron Arrow; 60 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “One More Step”.
Place a dummy, strike it unarmored, equip a chestplate on it and strike it again.
Compare the same attack against different protection before a real expedition.

Compare the same weapon’s readouts. Click the body part to remove its armor; sneak and hit empty-handed to remove the dummy. Undead heads, turtle helmets and an illager banner change its simulated target type. A pumpkin makes a scarecrow, and a dispenser can place it.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Patient Teacher”.
Successfully use an obtained Infernal Forge, Void Forge, Void Core or Gauntlet of Guard native ground/control action.
Use earned forge and void artifacts to control space.

Infernal Forge uses a block for an area strike; Void Forge creates a rune fan. Void Core creates runes, Guard pulls entities and Maelstrom creates a vortex. Brontes is thrown. These are alternative actual actions; acquire the artifacts normally first.
2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Roasted Chicken; 90 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “The Ground Answers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_charge: Charge and successfully release an obtained Incinerator, Annihilator, Immolator or Bulwark ability.
Choose a safe moment for a powerful charged technique.

Incinerator releases a flame strike and can destroy dropped loot. Annihilator needs both hands. Immolator benefits from Blazing Brand; sneaking Bulwark of the Flame charges a target and gains a wall stun. Gauntlet of Bulwark pushes and applies Brand during charge, then rushes.
2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Roasted Chicken; 90 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Draw a Breath”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_stance: Use both distinct native functions of one obtained Soul Render, Tidal Claws or Ceraunus.
Choose between an earned weapon’s two real functions for the situation.

Soul Render switches rush to phantom-halberd spiral while sneaking. Tidal Claws combines right-click grappling with a tentacle attack. Ceraunus switches anchor throw to a wave fan; Astrape separately launches a lightning spear. If a combat addon is active, follow its actions 1/2/3: that addon owns the technique.
2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Roasted Chicken; 90 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Second Stance”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_ranged: Successfully use an obtained Cursed Bow, Wrath of the Desert, shoulder weapon or Laser Gatling special firing mode.
Manage an earned ranged artifact’s ammunition and special firing modes.

Cursed Bow fires three phantom arrows or two special-arrow shots. Wrath of the Desert makes three sandstorms. Void Assault fires howitzers; sneaking changes Wither Assault missiles to howitzers. Laser Gatling reloads from carried redstone. Hold Meat Shredder toward a target: it owns its hurt-frame behavior.
2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Roasted Chicken; 90 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “More than an Arrow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_sand.c: Successfully create a storm using an obtained Sandstorm in a Bottle or Ancient Spear.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_sand.p: Use a moving storm as its own tool rather than another ordinary melee hit.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_sand.t: The bottle makes two orbiting storms; Ancient Spear launches a storm with attack. Final Fractal benefits against high maximum health, while Zweiender rewards rear hits. Those are separate properties of the earned weapons, not a generic sword effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_sand.r: 2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Roasted Chicken; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_artifact_sand.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Dust in a Circle”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_forged_armor.co: Upgrade one Netherite piece with Ignitium and use its native feature.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_forged_armor.pu: Turn earned Ignitium into a particular armor piece’s useful function.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_forged_armor.ti: Supply your own template and ingot. Helmet uses Blazing Brand gaze; chestplate supports Flame Reflex and Elytra combination, and the set has its own Lava Walker behavior. Choose one active feature. Monstrous Helm separately activates below half health; deliberately risking death is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_forged_armor.re: 1 × Fireward Ring; 2 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_forged_armor.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fire, Tailored”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.title: A Step out of Trouble
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.conditi: Upgrade a Netherite armor piece with Cursium and successfully use its vision, dodge or backstep.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.purpose: Follow Cursium upgrading and use movement or vision without overriding death rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.tip: Obtain the template and ingot normally. Helmet reveals entities through walls, leggings can dodge, and boots reduce falls and backstep. Chestplate has native recovery followed by a blocking debuff: actual death still eliminates a hosted-fight participant.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.reward: 4 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 2 × Greater Invisibility Elixir; 130 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_cursium.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Step out of Trouble”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.title: In the Dark Below
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.condi: Successfully use equipment or food protection for abyssal threats.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.purpo: Match protection to a particular abyssal threat rather than armor rating alone.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.tip: Bloom Stone Pauldrons fire amethyst projectiles. Blessed Amethyst Crab Meat protects against Darkness, Abyssal Fear and Abyssal Burn. Sticky Gloves prevent Koboleton theft, Sturdy Boots help on powder snow, and Unbreakable Skull prevents one stun before cooldown. Choose an actual relevant activation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.rewar: 16 × Atlantean Diamond Arrow; 3 × Oakskin Elixir; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_abyss_kit.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “In the Dark Below”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ender_golem.pur: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: ender golem personally.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ender_golem.tip: Locate the named creature in its native structure and defeat it without changing campaign admission.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ender_golem.rew: 3 × Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Torch Iron Arrow; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ender_golem.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Guardian Before the Guardian”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_clawdian.title: Claw of the Acropolis
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_clawdian.purpos: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: clawdian personally.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_clawdian.tip: Locate the named creature in its native structure and defeat it without changing campaign admission.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_clawdian.reward: 3 × Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Torch Iron Arrow; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_clawdian.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Claw of the Acropolis”.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: kobolediator personally.
Locate the named creature in its native structure and defeat it without changing campaign admission.
3 × Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Torch Iron Arrow; 80 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_forest_be: Defeat one beast from this group: tree ent, cherry tree ent.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: tree ent, cherry tree ent.
Find the Ent in forests or the cherry variant in Cherry Groves. Both break leaves while pursuing; their offhand root slows struck targets.
More details: unified guide → Items → “An Angry Forest”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_hermit.co: Defeat one beast from this group: hermit king.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_hermit.pu: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: hermit king.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_hermit.ti: Look for the Hermit King on beaches. At half health it heals inside its shell; its helmet branch helps movement over sand.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_hermit.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Not Quite a House”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_gators.co: Defeat one beast from this group: vile gator, frigid gator.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_gators.pu: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: vile gator, frigid gator.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_gators.ti: Vile Gator lives in swamps and Frigid Gator in Ice Spikes. Both launch and poison; the offhand tooth gives attacks a poison chance.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_gators.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Mind the Teeth”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_phoenix.c: Defeat one beast from this group: phoenix, wind phoenix.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_phoenix.p: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: phoenix, wind phoenix.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_phoenix.t: Phoenix occurs in Badlands and Wind Phoenix on Stony Peaks. Its first death leaves a baby form: complete the native encounter. The feather is one-use death inventory retention, not immortality.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_phoenix.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Feathers Do Not Give Up”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_mushlin.c: Defeat one beast from this group: crimson mushlin king, warped mushlin king.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_mushlin.p: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: crimson mushlin king, warped mushlin king.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_mushlin.t: Find the king in Crimson or Warped Forest. Acid clouds constrain movement; the spore trophy releases a slowing harmful cloud on death and does not revive its holder.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_mushlin.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “King of Spores”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_moon_beas: Defeat one beast from this group: horseless headsman, the scarecrow.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: horseless headsman, the scarecrow.
During a full moon seek Horseless Headsman in taiga or Scarecrow on plains. Pumpkin minions join the fight; the pumpkin helmet’s strength condition is also the full moon.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Until Dawn”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_witch_doc: Defeat one beast from this group: witch doctor, woodland witch doctor.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: witch doctor, woodland witch doctor.

Look for Witch Doctor in Sparse Jungle or the woodland variant in old taiga. Its two invisibility changes leave helpers. The pendant has a resistance chance after kills, not a permanent guaranteed buff.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Doctor Was Here”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_moths.con: Defeat one beast from this group: luminous moth, albino moth.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_moths.pur: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: luminous moth, albino moth.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_moths.tip: Luminous Moth occurs in old spruce forests, Albino Moth in Dark Forest. Its offhand antenna reveals nearby creatures after its holder is hurt in darkness. The guide repeats some behavior text; do not invent extra attacks from that duplication.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_moths.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Do Not Follow the Light”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_relics.co: Use one obtained beast trophy in its actual active context.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_relics.pu: Match a trophy to water, cold or a particular combat trigger.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_relics.ti: Hold Yeti Horn offhand in cold biomes for recovery, or Viper Tooth underwater for sight and defense. Magic Root slows after a hit, Gator Tooth has a poison chance, and Jungle Pendant has a resistance chance after kills. Choose one actual effect, not any hit with any trophy.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_relics.re: 3 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_beast_relics.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Trophy Put to Work”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_weapon.con: Apply a working weapon coating and trigger its effect with a hit.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_weapon.pur: Test a finite coating on a real target and understand its side cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_weapon.tip: Bowlder Dust adds Armor Crumbling and durability cost, Serrated Shred bleeding, Venom Sack venom, and Wretched Fang darkness-linked damage/healing. Choose one and inspect its finite uses.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_weapon.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Edge with Character”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_fire.title: Fire with a Catch
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_fire.condi: Apply Magmadermis to a weapon or shield and trigger its real combat effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_fire.purpo: Match a fire coating to a burning target and shield durability cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_fire.tip: The weapon gains damage against burning targets but loses against others. The shield can ignite an attacker while blocking at a durability cost. Check the workshop for material and application.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_fire.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “Fire with a Catch”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_repair.con: Repair a suitable damaged item using Dragger Silk.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_repair.pur: Extend suitable equipment’s life through a distinct material repair method.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_repair.tip: In the Workshop, put Dragger Silk in slot 0 and eligible damaged equipment in slot 1. One silk restores 8–20 durability. Dragger spawning is denied, but the current Atlas contains the ordinary dragger_silk_recipe: use the effective recipe rather than enabling the mob.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_repair.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Thread and Edge”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_sustain.co: Obtain Warden Vein or Wrought Scale normally and test kill-based repair or reduced shield wear.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_sustain.pu: Maintain equipment through finite kill- or block-triggered effects.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_sustain.ti: Warden Vein repairs on kills; Wrought Scale may reduce blocking wear. Coatings have finite charges. Applying one is not proof its actual effect worked.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_coat_sustain.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Keep an Edge”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ore_acid.title: A Sour Yield
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ore_acid.condit: Process a supported ore with Acidic Bile and receive the result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ore_acid.purpos: Use acid as real ore processing with an actual output.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ore_acid.tip: This processes ore rather than coating a sword. Use an ore the installed item actually supports for increased yield; merely clicking or striking with acid does not count.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ore_acid.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Sour Yield”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_brush_shell.con: Coat a brush with Ammonite Shell and excavate a result from gravel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_brush_shell.pur: Turn a brush into a finite-use way to excavate gravel finds.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_brush_shell.tip: The coating has limited uses. Apply material following its native tooltip, then use that coated brush on eligible gravel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_brush_shell.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Not Just a Brush”.
Trigger one obtained Freezing, Seething or Repulsion totem’s actual function.
Choose a totem for its particular trigger and threat.
Freezing protects from freeze and supports frost attacks; Seething enhances nearby burning damage; Repulsion produces an attack-triggered wind response. Hold it offhand under its own condition.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Totem for the Weather”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_totem_empower.c: Empower a compatible totem with Semi-living Flesh and verify its empowered state.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_totem_empower.p: Compare a totem’s empowerment with its actual maximum-health cost.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_totem_empower.t: The empowerment costs maximum health while held. Read the cost first; the quest does not undo the tradeoff or require lethal risk.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_totem_empower.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Power Has a Price”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deep_alloy.cond: Trigger one owned Deep Alloy effect: work experience, kill repair or a sonic critical strike.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deep_alloy.purp: Try a distinct working or combat property of Deep Alloy.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deep_alloy.tip: Tools grant work experience and repair on kills. Armor has Warden’s Might under Blindness, and sword criticals may produce a sonic boom. Individual pieces have distinct conditions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deep_alloy.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Depth Answers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_elder_alloy.con: Upgrade Netherite equipment to Invulnerite at a smithing table and take the result
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_elder_alloy.pur: Improve your own equipment through the available Invulnerite smithing upgrade
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_elder_alloy.tip: Defeating the underground lair guardian releases its tangled Invulnerite ore. Craft nine nuggets into one chunk. Make the Invulnerite template with a Netherite template, a blank template and one nugget, then use it with Netherite equipment and an Invulnerite chunk
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_elder_alloy.rew: 1 × Oakskin Elixir, 2 × Roasted Chicken and 40 XP
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_elder_alloy.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Beyond Netherite”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_impact_gear.con: Use a Crushing Pauldron sprint contact hit or a Quake Boots shockwave after a safe fall.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_impact_gear.pur: Turn a safe sprint or short fall into a gear-specific impact.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_impact_gear.tip: The pauldron works during sprinting; boots use fall distance. Start from a small safe height against a hostile target. Merely wearing the gear is not enough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_impact_gear.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Shoulder or Heel”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_serrated_defens: Apply Serraxe bleeding or Forlorn Barrier’s retaliatory piercing fangs.
Compare bleeding offense with a barrier’s piercing counterattack.
Serraxe causes stronger bleeding against unarmored targets. The barrier releases piercing fangs, adds Armor Crumbling and enters cooldown; a plain block without its proc is not proof.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Fang in Reply”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tranquil_food.c: Successfully receive Tranquility from Heart of Tranquility or Leeching from eating a Leeching Sack.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tranquil_food.p: Distinguish tranquility from leeching-with-weakness across two consumables.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tranquil_food.t: The heart grants tranquility; the sack grants leeching together with weakness. Acidic Bile processes ore. The three consumables have different effects and limitations.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tranquil_food.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Be Still, Heart”.
Trigger an obtained Infernal Crown’s own fire bonus under an eligible native state.
Deliberately use an earned crown’s conditional fire bonus.
The crown increases offense while burning, with a further lava bonus. Do not enter lava without reliable protection; the goal never requires death or overriding server rules.
More details: unified guide → Items → “The Crown Is Still Hot”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tunnel_gore.tit: Do Not Stand in the Way
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tunnel_gore.pur: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: Tunnel Gore.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tunnel_gore.tip: Find its distinctive deep tunnel. Do not over-mine the lair: its native vulnerability uses three charges into Netherite blocks.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tunnel_gore.rew: 2 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_tunnel_gore.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Do Not Stand in the Way”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_grave_construct: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: Grave Construct.
Build its native bone-block/Breacher-skull ritual using the installed scheme. Account for its second phase and totems; the quest does not summon it for you.
2 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_wretch.title: Do Not Crunch Nearby
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_wretch.purpose: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: a Wretch.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_wretch.tip: With the installed integration it follows the native post-Forsaken rule. Eating nearby attracts it; three successful bite blocks break teeth and interfere with its healing bite.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_wretch.reward: 2 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_wretch.guide_hi: More details: unified guide → Items → “Do Not Crunch Nearby”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_quake_ride.cond: Feed a Quake cactus, mount it and perform its actual area attack.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_quake_ride.purp: Turn accepted feeding into controlled temporary combat transport.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_quake_ride.tip: Look for Quake in desert terrain. Its temporary mount state and area strike belong to the native mechanic; owning cactus is not enough.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_quake_ride.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Ground Beneath the Saddle”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_soul_pearl.cond: Bind an eligible living target to a Soul Pearl and relocate it with a throw.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_soul_pearl.purp: Relocate an eligible bound target while preserving native world restrictions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_soul_pearl.tip: Sneak-right-click a target with Soul Pearl, then throw it. Summoner Pearl instead relocates nearby targets at impact. Both retain native exclusions and server teleport rules.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_soul_pearl.rewa: 2 × Invisibility Elixir; 12 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_soul_pearl.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Come Over Here”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ancient_pearl.c: Successfully summon and recall a friendly Enderman using an Ancient Pearl.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ancient_pearl.p: Summon and recall your own temporary End helper.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ancient_pearl.t: Obtain the pearl from an End Islands Enderman. Recalling is a separate right-click interaction with the helper, not an ordinary hostile Enderman.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ancient_pearl.r: 2 × Invisibility Elixir; 12 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_ancient_pearl.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Helper from the Edge”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_pearl_control.c: Apply Icy Pearl to an eligible enemy or use Bubble Pearl’s gravity-free travel.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_pearl_control.p: Choose a pearl for its trajectory, control or protective effect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_pearl_control.t: Icy Pearl freezes near impact; Bubble Pearl flies without normal drop. Crimson and Warped grant Strength or Resistance after teleporting; read the actual selected type.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_pearl_control.r: 2 × Invisibility Elixir; 12 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_pearl_control.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Chilly Journey”.
Cause an actual random target teleport using Corrupted Pearl, Corrupted Blade or Corrupted Shield.
Use unpredictable enemy relocation as a distinct mechanic.
Pearl teleports on impact, blade teleports the struck entity and shield teleports its attacker. Protected creatures and arena restrictions cannot be bypassed.
2 × Invisibility Elixir; 12 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 70 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “An Enemy Was Here”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.title: Look Calmly
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.condition: Equip an Enderman hood in its allowed slot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.purpose: Use protection against stare provocation while respecting other Enderman threats.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.tip: Rare hoods come from Badlands, Snowy and Savanna Endermen. The native slot is chest; protection concerns stare provocation, not all attacks or universal invisibility.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.reward: 2 × Invisibility Elixir; 12 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 70 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_hood.guide_hint: More details: unified guide → Items → “Look Calmly”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.title: Flowers of the Arrow
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.condit: Create an actual Vine Bow flower field.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.purpos: Manage a flower field and its selected healing, control or damage mode.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain trades healing for faster damage; Grace cleanses allies; Bounty adds kill-loot chances; Chaos creates a rooting parasite blossom and an ending ally buff.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.reward: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_vine.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “Flowers of the Arrow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.title: The Ground Is Restless
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.condi: Create an actual Earth Bow tremor.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.purpo: Use moving earth for offense or support through its selected rune.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain spreads spikes; Grace launches an ally with protection and slow fall; Bounty concentrates a central spike; Chaos chains spikes through hostiles.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.rewar: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_earth.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Ground Is Restless”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.title: Winter’s Arrow
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.conditi: Release actual homing frost arrows with Ice Bow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.purpose: Choose between frost projectiles and a control wall.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain concentrates shots; Grace stacks slowness; Bounty adds weaker arrows; Chaos creates an ice wall blocking entities and projectiles.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.reward: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_ice.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “Winter’s Arrow”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.title: A Buzzing Argument
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.conditi: Summon actual attacking bees with Bee Bow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.purpose: Test actual support, attacks or fields from summoned bees.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain homes bees; Grace gives an ally a hit-blocking bee; Bounty creates a temporary attacking hive; Chaos creates a healing/slowing honey storm with explosive bees.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.reward: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bee.guide_h: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Buzzing Argument”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bubble.cond: Successfully fire Bubble Bow underwater with its native projectile without ordinary water drag.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bubble.purp: Use an underwater bow’s trajectory and distinct aquatic support.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bubble.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain fires axolotls; Grace protects a bubble column with an axolotl and Resistance; Bounty creates a swarm; Chaos sends a damaging knockback wave.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bubble.rewa: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_bubble.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Bow Stayed Dry”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_blossom.con: Create an actual Blossom Bow storm.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_blossom.pur: Control a blossom storm area or orbiting koi protection.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_blossom.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain enlarges a stationary storm; Grace gives allies speed/haste; Bounty makes several high-entry-damage fields; Chaos creates orbiting koi that damage and reflect projectiles.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_blossom.rew: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_blossom.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Battle in Bloom”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.title: The Shot Answers
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.condit: Summon an Echo Bow magical bow and have it actually mirror a shot.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.purpos: Connect your shot with an actual summoned bow’s response.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain focuses the last target and adds kill explosions; Grace charges from an offhand potion and may help allies; Bounty mirrors a different offhand bow; Chaos creates a black hole expanding on kills.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.reward: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_echo.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Shot Answers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_cosmic.cond: Attach an actual damaging Cosmic Bow constellation.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_cosmic.purp: Connect targets with a constellation or apply a distinct star mode.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_cosmic.tip: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain shares damage across tethered targets; Grace buffs allies and gives protective cocoons; Bounty charges an airborne star with optional swing detonation; Chaos captures/refires projectiles and stacks draw speed.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_cosmic.rewa: 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 2 × Evasion Elixir; 75 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_cosmic.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “Draw a Constellation”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_workbench.c: Apply an enchanted string or reinforced frame to an obtained unique bow at an anvil.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_workbench.p: Make a deliberate irreversible improvement to a found bow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_workbench.t: Bows, upgrades and etchings appear in chests at differing rates. Read the Alt tooltip first: string/frame upgrades are irreversible. Use a real obtained bow, not an empty placeholder.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_workbench.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A String Remembers”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.title: A Different Hand
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.condit: Install a rune on a unique bow and successfully use that bow’s changed function.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.purpos: Change your bow’s function with a rune and test its new result.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.tip: Pain, Grace, Bounty and Chaos alter each bow differently; read that bow’s branch. A new etching replaces the previous rune. Grace often helps allies, so testing it as ordinary enemy damage is incorrect.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.reward: 3 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 12 × Tracking Diamond Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bow_rune.guide_: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Different Hand”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_tools.con: Successfully place light with an arrow or extinguish fire with a special arrow.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_tools.pur: Replace a distant approach with a suitable lighting or extinguishing projectile.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_tools.tip: Torch/Lantern Arrow places light at a suitable impact surface. Extinguishing Arrow puts out fire and converts affected lava to obsidian. Atlantean Arrow separately avoids ordinary underwater slowdown.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_tools.rew: 24 × Torch Iron Arrow; 16 × Atlantean Iron Arrow; 60 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_tools.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “An Arrow with a Job”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arrow_transport: Leash an eligible creature with a Leashing Arrow or apply love mode with a Breeding Arrow.
Use safe transport and husbandry arrows against their actual eligible targets.
Leashing Arrow excludes villagers. The padded breeding arrow should not damage animals. Tracking Arrow follows the last mob hit: hit the intended target first.
16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 4 × Roasted Chicken; 60 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Without a Sharp Edge”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_siege_repair.co: Successfully repair a damaged ballista or catapult with its native materials.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_siege_repair.pu: Keep your own siege engine working through real repair after damage.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_siege_repair.ti: Native repair uses iron nuggets and planks. Catapult movement aims, right-click previews trajectory and Space loads/fires; ballista has right-click precision aiming. Check remapped controls.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_siege_repair.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Engine Will Last”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_clear.con: Complete an actual trial-spawner cycle and receive its native reward.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_clear.pur: Complete a native trial cycle and distinguish its enhanced conditions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_clear.tip: Find Trials Chambers. Normal and Cursed cycles differ: Cursed increases difficulty at activation. Keys and rewards must come from the native mechanic, not this quest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_clear.rew: 3 × Oakskin Elixir; 24 × Torch Iron Arrow; 90 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_clear.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Chamber Accepted”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_mace_smash.cond: Craft a mace from a Heavy Core and Breeze Rod and land a real falling smash.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_mace_smash.purp: Connect the mace’s rare materials with its actual falling smash.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_mace_smash.tip: Dangerous height is unnecessary. Density boosts falling damage, Breach penetrates armor and Wind Burst adds smash-triggered wind. A Breeze Rod separately crafts four Wind Charges.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_mace_smash.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Better View from Above”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_effects.c: Trigger an actual secondary action of Infested, Ooze or Weave.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_effects.p: Test a special effect’s secondary result at its actual trigger.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_effects.t: Infested can release silverfish on damage; Ooze creates slimes after its bearer dies; Winded does not create a wind cloud and does not count for this goal. Weave interacts with attack-triggered webs. Use a suitable ordinary mob; player death is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_effects.r: 2 × Invisibility Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 60 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_trial_effects.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Potion Has a Condition”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_heavy_school.co: Successfully execute Ruin Greatsword’s rising technique or charged Duskfire.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_heavy_school.pu: Choose a moment for a heavy clash or full charge.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_heavy_school.ti: Ruin Greatsword uses Key3 for its rising clash. Duskfire needs full energy, both mouse buttons to charge then release the combined mouse-button hold; native bindings and earned ownership remain.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_heavy_school.re: 3 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Chicken Wrapped In Bacon With Noodles; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_heavy_school.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “A Weighty Word”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_agile_school.co: Execute an actual Ancient Echo Blades, Vanguard Saber, Exile or Queen’s Short Blade technique.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_agile_school.pu: Learn the chosen blade’s launcher, finisher or damage replay.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_agile_school.ti: Echo distinguishes tap/hold Key3 for launcher/finisher. Vanguard uses Key3 for guard breaking; Exile combines left attack with Key3. Queen replays earlier damage on its next strike after Key3. The selected weapon’s actual result is checked.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_agile_school.re: 3 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Chicken Wrapped In Bacon With Noodles; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_agile_school.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Strike Continues”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_risky_school.co: Successfully activate Wild Claws or Blood Mania and complete its native action.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_risky_school.pu: Balance a powerful weapon state against its actual health risk.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_risky_school.ti: Wild Claws improves movement/attacks and control resistance but increases incoming damage. Blood Mania releases blood waves while draining health. Start safely; lethal risk is not required.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_risky_school.re: 3 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 6 × Chicken Wrapped In Bacon With Noodles; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_risky_school.gu: More details: unified guide → Items → “Power Cuts Both Ways”.
Grapple yourself to a block or pull an eligible target with an Undying Tentacle.
Use an earned trophy for actual target-dependent grappling.
Earn the trophy from the real Kraken. The target selects the function: a block pulls the player, an entity is pulled toward the player. Native movement restrictions remain.
4 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Atlantean Diamond Arrow; 100 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Do Not Let Go”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_bone_trophy_cra: Craft your own Kraken Trident or a Dragon Bones armor piece through its real recipe.
Process a legitimately earned trophy into chosen useful equipment.
Earn teeth/bones through their actual encounters. Trident and bone armor are different trophy-processing routes; this quest gives supporting consumables, not another finished boss weapon.
3 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 8 × Chicken Wrapped In Bacon With Noodles; 100 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Bones Put to Use”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arid_variants.c: Defeat one listed local variant: red mummy, arid yeti.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arid_variants.p: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one listed local variant: red mummy, arid yeti.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arid_variants.t: Red Mummy lives in Badlands with the amulet branch; Arid Yeti lives in savanna and throws mud instead of frost breath. Their trophies retain their own conditions.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arid_variants.r: 3 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_arid_variants.g: More details: unified guide → Items → “Not Quite Wasteland”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_reef_viper.cond: Defeat one listed local variant: coral sea viper.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_reef_viper.purp: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one listed local variant: coral sea viper.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_reef_viper.tip: Coral Sea Viper lives by coral reefs and displaces swimmers. It is a separate variant, not a replacement for the cold Sea Viper campaign gate.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_reef_viper.rewa: 3 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 85 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_reef_viper.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Reef Moves”.
Defeat one listed local variant: bogged bone stalker.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one listed local variant: bogged bone stalker.
Bogged Bone Stalker hides and blinds. Bone Rattle is a one-use after-death response, not an extra life.
3 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 85 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Shadow over the Marsh”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_nether_variants: Defeat one listed local variant: basalt executioner, soul furnace.
Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one listed local variant: basalt executioner, soul furnace.
Basalt Executioner occurs in Basalt Deltas and Soul Furnace in Soul Sand Valley. Helpers/trophies follow native conditions; these do not replace the specific ordinary campaign flags.
3 × Evasion Elixir; 16 × Tracking Iron Arrow; 85 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Heat of a Different Color”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_sculk_vault.con: Open the sealed passage with a Soul Key and obtain real loot from the protected Ancient Vault.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_sculk_vault.pur: Complete the actual opening of a protected underground vault.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_sculk_vault.tip: Key and protected chest are distinct route stages. Breaking a Stalker statue may release it; a Corrupted Skeleton can reform from bones. Its first collapse is not final defeat.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_sculk_vault.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Key Has Soul”.
Process Mossy Fluorite at a grindstone and craft a Neon Lamp from its crystals.
Turn a found mineral into working light through its processing route.
Use the native material and effective lamp recipe. Heart Goo separately comes from a Sculk Heart; it is not a random drop from every infected block.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Light from Moss”.
Process Frozen Rotten Flesh and brew a Freeze potion through its native recipe.
Use an unusual cold drop in actual cooking and brewing.
Frostbitten supplies the material; native processing includes cooking flesh or brewing. Freeze immobilizes its target. Channeled is different: it attracts natural lightning to a player during storms.
3 × Oakskin Elixir; 16 × Freezing Iron Arrow; 75 XP.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Not All Rot Is Waste”.
Cause a Burned to change into its obsidian form with water and defeat that form.
Deliberately change an enemy’s state, then adapt your combat approach.
Obsidian form has projectile immunity and different mobility; lava can reignite it. Immortal separately changes with thunderstorms/lightning: its loot is not identical in every weather.
More details: unified guide → Items → “Water Changes the Fight”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.title: The Chest Did Not Explode
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.condi: Defeat Dead Beard before self-destruction and open his actual treasure chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.purpo: Finish the fight in time to preserve its actual treasure.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.tip: The captain may explode and lose the ordinary reward. A no-hit fight is unnecessary: earn the real victory and use its native dropped chest.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.rewar: 2 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 16 × Atlantean Diamond Arrow; 100 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_deadbeard.guide: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Chest Did Not Explode”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_web_escape.cond: Actively escape Webbed before its natural expiry.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_web_escape.purp: Actively escape control instead of waiting for its timer.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_web_escape.tip: Follow the installed effect’s displayed escape controls. Waiting for expiry does not count; a rare unfinished spider is unnecessary.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_web_escape.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “I Am Not a Fly”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_guard_team.cond: Successfully create a guard from an eligible villager and assign a real patrol position.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_guard_team.purp: Create a real defender and assign a working patrol position.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_guard_team.tip: Sneak-use an appropriate sword/crossbow on an eligible unemployed villager/nitwit. Use native patrol controls. Hero of the Village enables follow/bell rally; clerics, smiths and spare food support guards only under enabled native settings.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_guard_team.guid: More details: unified guide → Items → “The Watch Is Ready”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_haunted_duo.con: Defeat both Beheaded Knight and Resurrected Knight.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_haunted_duo.pur: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: both Beheaded Knight and Resurrected Knight.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_haunted_duo.tip: This native paired challenge has two separate defeat conditions. It does not replace Bone Stalker or Overgrown Colossus and does not add a mandatory campaign eye.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_haunted_duo.rew: 3 × Greater Oakskin Elixir; 3 × Greater Evasion Elixir; 120 XP.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_haunted_duo.gui: More details: unified guide → Items → “Who Lost Their Head?”.
jem.atlas.card.v3_combat_nightfall_forms: Hit a hostile mob with Kusabimaru’s Dragon Flash or Ghiza’s Wheel’s innate dash. One technique is enough.
Two native alloys support the next Nightfall weapon school; weapons and skills remain earned through their own progression.

In battle mode, grounded Kusabimaru uses Dragon Flash through its assigned special input; airborne and dash contexts use other moves. Ghiza’s Wheel uses the weapon-innate-skill key; holding continues the attack and drains stamina. Read the weapon’s actual binding names, then find its native recipe in JEI.
More details: unified guide → Items → “A Master’s Signature”.
